Rad9 は DSB の末端での Sgs1 の結合を妨げて Sgs1/Dna2: Rad9 blocks Sgs1 binding at DSB ends and limits Sgs1/Dna2 resection (25637499). When Rad9 binding to DNA ends is reduced, the inhibition of Sgs1-Dna2 activity is relieved (26584331)
Rad9 はクロマチン上で NuA4 のアセチル化活性を試験管内で抑える。G1: Rad9 inhibits NuA4 acetyltransferase activity on chromatin in vitro. In G1, Rad9 and NHEJ factors prevent recruitment of NuA4 to DSBs (34543274)
Rad9 は切断の後にリン酸化されて切断部位に結合するが、mec1Δ やキナーゼ: Rad9 is phosphorylated after cleavage and binds the break site, but in mec1Δ or kinase-dead mec1 both phosphorylation and binding are strongly reduced. Mec1 phosphorylates in vitro the S/TQ motifs phosphorylated in vivo, and multiple S/TQ mutations impair binding to the break site. Mec1 promotes Rad9 binding to damage sites, leading to full phosphorylation and binding to Rad53 (15060150)
Ram1-Ram2 はファルネシル転移酵素で Ras の膜局在に要る（17630: Ram1-Ram2 is a farnesyltransferase required for membrane localization of Ras (1763050). ram2 mutants also lack Ras2 farnesylation activity (2124698)
Rap1 は ATF1 の活性化に必須な 18 bp の配列に結合し、ATF1: Rap1 binds an 18 bp sequence essential for ATF1 activation, and transcriptional activation of ATF1 depends on Rap1 (10487921)
Rap1 は Tel1 と Mec1 によって S731 がリン酸化され、DNA: Rap1 is phosphorylated at S731 by Tel1 and Mec1, which increases upon DNA damage and telomere shortening. Impaired phosphorylation weakens Rap1-Rif1 binding and disturbs end protection. S731D strengthens binding to Rif1 (28575419)
Rap1 結合ドメインを変えた Taf4・Taf5 は Rap1 への親和性が下: Taf4 and Taf5 with altered Rap1-binding domains have lower affinity for Rap1, and transcription of ribosomal protein genes is selectively impaired (20189987)
Rav1・Rav2 を FLAG で精製した RAVE 複合体に V1 サブユニ: The RAVE complex purified with FLAG-tagged Rav1 and Rav2 contains the V1 subunits Vma1p and Vma2p (28643238)
Rav2 は Rav1 の N 末端ドメインに結合する（共免疫沈降・ツーハイブリ: Rav2 binds the N-terminal domain of Rav1 (co-immunoprecipitation, two-hybrid, pull-down) (26405040)
Rax1 は二極出芽の遠位の目印 Bud8 の局在に必要（14980713）: Rax1 is required for localization of Bud8, the distal landmark of bipolar budding (14980713)
Rax1p と Rax2p の局在は相互依存で、酵母から共精製される。Bud8p: Localization of Rax1p and Rax2p is interdependent, and they co-purify from yeast. Bud8p and Bud9p also co-purify with Rax1p (15356260)
Rba50 は Rpb3 と、Gpn2 は Rpb12 と結合し、Rpb3 サブ: Rba50 binds Rpb3 and Gpn2 binds Rpb12, acting in assembly of the Rpb3 subcomplex (29661922)
Rbg1 と Tma46 の C 末端領域の複合体の結晶構造を決め、Tma46: The crystal structure of the complex between Rbg1 and the C-terminal region of Tma46 was solved; Tma46 contributes to the GTPase activity and function of Rbg1 (23002146)
Rbg2・Gir2 は単独では不安定だが、複合体を作って互いを安定化し、アミノ酸: Rbg2 and Gir2 are unstable on their own but form a complex that stabilizes both, and this is strongly enhanced upon amino acid starvation (23899355)
Rbl2 は生体内で β チューブリンに結合し、過剰な β チューブリンによる致: Rbl2 binds β-tubulin in vivo and suppresses the lethality caused by excess β-tubulin (7634332)
Rbp1 はミトコンドリアのポリン（POR1）mRNA の分解を速めてその量を下: Rbp1 accelerates decay of the mitochondrial porin (POR1) mRNA and lowers its level. Decay is mediated by Xrn1. Rbp1 binds Dhh1 directly (16885161)
Rbp29（Sgn1）は Pab1 と RNA 依存に共免疫沈降し、poly(A: Rbp29 (Sgn1) co-immunoprecipitates with Pab1 in an RNA-dependent manner and binds poly(A) (10764794)
Rbp95 は Npa1 複合体の多くの構成要素とリボソームタンパク質 Rpl3: Rbp95 is genetically and physically linked to many components of the Npa1 complex and to the ribosomal protein Rpl3 (36018804)
Rbs1 の過剰発現で RPB10 mRNA と Rpb10 タンパク質が増える: Overexpression of Rbs1 increases RPB10 mRNA and Rpb10 protein. Rbs1 binds directly to the 3'UTR of RPB10 mRNA (33231687)
Rce1 の阻害剤で GFP-Ras の細胞膜の局在が崩れ、RCE1 の増量で抑: An Rce1 inhibitor disrupts plasma membrane localization of GFP-Ras, which is suppressed by increased RCE1 dosage. Genetic loss of CaaX cleavage mislocalizes GFP-Ras2 to ER-positive puncta (20162532)
Rcf1 は Cox13 と Rcf2 の複合体への組み込みと、一部の複合体 I: Rcf1 is required for incorporation of Cox13 and Rcf2 into the complex and for formation of respiratory supercomplexes by a subset of complex IV (22342701)
Rcf2 と Rcf3 は新しく合成されたミトコンドリアのコードするタンパク質（: Rcf2 and Rcf3 bind newly synthesized mitochondrially encoded proteins (such as Cox3) and contribute to complex IV assembly (34450214)
Rcf2 と Rcf3 は新生の Cox3 などのミトコンドリアでコードされるタ: Rcf2 and Rcf3 bind nascent mitochondrially encoded proteins such as Cox3 and contribute to complex IV assembly (34450214)
Rck1 は Ubp3 と直接結合して Ubp3 のリン酸化を活性化する。UBP: Rck1 binds Ubp3 directly and activates Ubp3 phosphorylation. In the absence of UBP3, the increase in Ras2 caused by RCK1 overexpression does not occur (26657849)
Rcl1 の核内輸送は Bms1 に依存し、両者は同じ段階でプレリボソームに載る: Nuclear import of Rcl1 depends on Bms1, and both load onto pre-ribosomes at the same step (25064857)
Rcl1・U3 snoRNA・GTP の Bms1 への結合は強く共役し、Rcl: Binding of Rcl1, U3 snoRNA and GTP to Bms1 is tightly coupled, suggesting that Rcl1 activates Bms1 by promoting GDP/GTP exchange (16376378)
Rcn1 は Mck1 にリン酸化されると SCF-Cdc4 で分解され、これが: When phosphorylated by Mck1, Rcn1 is degraded by SCF-Cdc4, which relieves inhibition of calcineurin. Degradation is promoted by Ca2+ (17954914)
Rcn2 はカルシニューリンの触媒サブユニットのうち Cmp2 に優先して結合し: Rcn2 binds preferentially to Cmp2 among the calcineurin catalytic subunits and partially inhibits calcineurin. This binding and the reduced activity are important for suppression of vps13Δ (33530471)
Rco1 の SID は Eaf3 の H3K36 メチル化ペプチドへの選択的な: The SID of Rco1 allosterically promotes selective binding of Eaf3 to H3K36-methylated peptides (25578729)
Rcp10p（Ysf3）は SF3b の p10 で、Cus1p の量を保つのと: Rcp10p (Ysf3) is the p10 of SF3b and is required for maintaining Cus1p levels and for U2 snRNP incorporation (16314500)
Rcr1 はエクソマーで細胞膜に運ばれる Rsp5 のアダプターで、カルシニュー: Rcr1 is an Rsp5 adaptor delivered to the plasma membrane by exomer and is induced through the calcineurin/Crz1 pathway. With external calcium, Rcr1 ubiquitinates Chs3 and reduces it (32421152)
Rcr2 はユビキチンを選別の信号として液胞へ運ばれる。本文: rsp5-1 の: Rcr2 is delivered to the vacuole using ubiquitin as a sorting signal. Main text: at the semi-permissive temperature of rsp5-1, Rcr2 is rerouted to the plasma membrane, and without the PY motif (Rsp5 binding) it does not reach the vacuole (32421152)
Rdi1 は Cdc42・Rho1・Rho4 とだけ結合し、それぞれ別の仕組みで: Rdi1 binds only Cdc42, Rho1 and Rho4 and regulates each by a different mechanism. After extraction from the membrane by Rdi1, Rho4 is degraded by a novel mechanism involving Ygk3, vacuolar proteases and the proteasome
Rdi1 を過剰発現すると細胞の形の異常、ALP の選別の遅れ、液胞の断片化が起: Overexpression of Rdi1 causes abnormal cell morphology, delayed ALP sorting and vacuole fragmentation, which is linked to reduced membrane localization and activation of Cdc42 and Rho1. Rdi1 binds Rho GTPases and inhibits vacuolar membrane fusion (21171963). Consistent with the UniProt direction (inhibition)
Rdr1 は PDR5 を含む 5 つの遺伝子の転写を抑える。Δrdr1 で P: Rdr1 represses transcription of five genes including PDR5. PDR5-lacZ activity increases in Δrdr1 (11882665)
Rds3 の最初の亜鉛フィンガーの上流の変異で Ist3 が条件的に外れ、Rse: Mutations upstream of the first zinc finger of Rds3 conditionally release Ist3 and also weaken binding to Rse1 (14517302)
Rea1 と Rix1 複合体（Rix1-Ipi1-Ipi3）は核質の 60S: Rea1 and the Rix1 complex (Rix1-Ipi1-Ipi3) are components of nucleoplasmic 60S precursor particles (15260980)
Rea1 の MIDAS が Rsa4 に結合し、その結合が pre-60S か: The MIDAS of Rea1 binds Rsa4, and this binding is essential for ATP-dependent release of factors from pre-60S (19737519)
Rec102・Rec104・Spo11 は減数分裂で互いに相互作用し、三量体を作: Rec102, Rec104 and Spo11 interact with each other in meiosis and are thought to form a trimer (12897161)
Rec102・Rec104・Spo11 は減数分裂で互いに相互作用する。Rec1: Rec102, Rec104 and Spo11 interact with each other in meiosis. Rec104-Rec102 binding occurs even without Spo11 (12897161)
Rec114 の局在はほかの DSB 因子に依存しないが、Mei4 の局在は R: Localization of Rec114 does not depend on other DSB factors, whereas localization of Mei4 depends strongly on Rec114 and Mer2 (17558514)
Rec8 の複数のリン酸化部位と CK1δ/ε・DDK の 2 つのキナーゼが: Multiple phosphorylation sites of Rec8 and two kinases, CK1δ/ε and DDK, are required for Rec8 cleavage and nuclear division in meiosis I. In the main text, DDK and Hrr25 bind and phosphorylate Rec8 from S phase and prophase, and chromatin-bound Rec8 with both kinases blocked is a poor separase substrate in vitro (20230747)
Rec8 の複数のリン酸化部位と CK1δ/ε（Hrr25）・DDK の 2 つ: Multiple phosphorylation sites of Rec8 and two kinases, CK1δ/ε (Hrr25) and DDK, are required for Rec8 cleavage and nuclear division in meiosis I. Phosphomimetic Rec8 is cleaved even when the kinases are blocked (20230747). In meiosis II, Hrr25 phosphorylates Rec8 and at the same time removes shugoshin-PP2A from kinetochores to prepare for cleavage (28017619)
Red1 のリン酸化は CDC28 に依存する部分と依存しない部分があり、リン酸: Phosphorylation of Red1 has CDC28-dependent and CDC28-independent parts, and loss of phosphorylation does not impair its meiotic function (21173162)
Red1 は Mek1 の基質ではなく、野生型レベルの Mek1 のキナーゼ活性: Red1 is not a substrate of Mek1, and RED1 is required for wild-type levels of Mek1 kinase activity. Activation of Mek1 requires HOP1, the Red1/Hop1 complex and the Mek1 FHA domain, and a constitutively active mek1 mutant bypasses the requirement for RED1 (14595109)
Reg1 は Glc7 を Snf1 複合体に連れてきて、活性化した Snf1: Reg1 brings Glc7 to the Snf1 complex and returns activated Snf1 to the autoinhibited state (10648618). When glucose is abundant, Reg1-Glc7 and Sit4 dephosphorylate Snf1 T210 (24019512)
Reg2 は Snf1 T210 の脱リン酸化に関わり、リン酸化された Snf1: Reg2 is involved in dephosphorylation of Snf1 T210 and binds phosphorylated Snf1. reg2-deficient strains subjected to prolonged glucose starvation are delayed in T210 dephosphorylation and growth recovery when glucose is restored (27107116)
Rei1 と Jjj1 は直接結合する。Jjj1 の C 末端の電荷に富む領域が: Rei1 and Jjj1 bind directly. The charge-rich C-terminal region of Jjj1 mediates the binding and is required for 60S formation in vivo (19901025)
Rfa2 と Dun1 は生体内で DNA 損傷でリン酸化され、試験管内で Te: Rfa2 and Dun1 are phosphorylated in vivo upon DNA damage and are substrates of Tel1 and Mec1 in vitro (12967660)
Rfa2 は試験管内で Tel1 と Mec1 の基質になる（12967660）: Rfa2 is a substrate of Tel1 and Mec1 in vitro (12967660)
Rfu1 は単量体のユビキチンと遊離のユビキチン鎖の量を調節し、脱ユビキチン化酵: Rfu1 regulates the levels of monomeric ubiquitin and free ubiquitin chains and acts as an inhibitor of the deubiquitinating enzyme Doa4. Doa4 and Rfu1 are partly responsible for the rapid decrease of free ubiquitin chains upon heat shock (19410548). Consistent with the GO direction (inhibition)
Rga1 は HOG 経路の中の Cdc42 を下げるが、接合経路の Cdc42: Rga1 lowers Cdc42 in the HOG pathway but not Cdc42 in the mating pathway. With RGA1 lacking the C-terminal GAP domain, the mating MAPK is activated under high osmolarity (34680163)
Rga1 は Nba1・Nis1 と相互作用して直前と古い分裂部位に一時的に局在: Rga1 interacts with Nba1 and Nis1 and localizes transiently to the immediately preceding and older division sites. The LIM domain of Rga1 is required for binding Nba1, and loss of this binding makes Rga1 leave the previous division site early and disturbs bud site selection in daughter cells
Rga1 は Rga2 と同じく Cdc28 による抑制のリン酸化を受け、高浸透: Like Rga2, Rga1 undergoes inhibitory phosphorylation by Cdc28 and is dephosphorylated and activated under high osmolarity (34680163)
Rga1 は試験管内で Hog1 にリン酸化されるが、その直接のリン酸化は体内の: Rga1 is phosphorylated by Hog1 in vitro, but this direct phosphorylation is not required for its function in vivo. Rga1 undergoes inhibitory phosphorylation by Cdc28 and is dephosphorylated and activated under high osmolarity. Hog1 prevents phosphorylation by Cdc28 and allows dephosphorylation by PP2A, thereby activating Rga1 (34680163)
Rga2 の CDK 部位は Pho85 と Cdc28 に体内・試験管内でリン: The CDK sites of Rga2 are phosphorylated by Pho85 and Cdc28 in vivo and in vitro, and mutating them abolishes G1-specific phosphorylation. Phosphorylation inhibits Rga2 activity and allows proper activation of Cdc42 (17853895)
The CDK sites of Rga2 are phosphorylated by Pho85 and Cdc28 in vivo and in vitro, and mutation abolishes G1-specific phosphorylation. Phosphorylation by CDK inhibits Rga2 activity (17853895)
Rgc1（Ypr115w）と Rgc2（Ask10）は Fps1 グリセロールチ: Rgc1 (Ypr115w) and Rgc2 (Ask10) are positive regulators of the Fps1 glycerol channel. In rgc1/2Δ, Fps1 function is lost and glycerol accumulates, which is restored by Fps1 overexpression. Regulation by Rgc1/2 appears to be indirect, but it regulates channel activity rather than Fps1 expression, folding or localization (19956799)
Rgc2 は浸透圧ストレスのないとき Fps1 の C 末端に PH ドメインで: In the absence of osmotic stress, Rgc2 binds the C-terminus of Fps1 through its PH domain and keeps the channel open. When Hog1 is activated under high osmolarity, Rgc2 is rapidly released from Fps1 and the channel closes. Hog1 is recruited to the N-terminus of Fps1 and from there phosphorylates Rgc2 at many sites (24298058). Phosphorylation of Rgc1 and Rgc2 by Hog1 causes their release from Fps1 and closure of the channel (26024902)
Rgc2 は浸透圧ストレスのないとき Fps1 の C 末端の細胞質ドメインに結: In the absence of osmotic stress, Rgc2 binds the C-terminal cytoplasmic domain of Fps1 and keeps it open (24298058). Rgc1 and Rgc2 (Ask10) are positive regulators of Fps1; rgc1/2Δ accumulates glycerol, which is restored by Fps1 overexpression. Rgc1/2 regulate channel activity rather than Fps1 expression, folding or localization (19956799)
Rgd1 は Rho2・Rho3・Rho4 の活性型と two-hybrid で: Rgd1 binds the active forms of Rho2, Rho3 and Rho4 in two-hybrid assays and stimulates the GTPase activity of Rho3 and Rho4 in vitro (no effect on Rho2). rho3Δ rgd1Δ grows much worse than either single mutant, suggesting that it also acts as a GAP in vivo (10526184). As a GAP it inhibits. Consistent with the current direction (inhibition)
Rgm1 を含む 26 の転写因子が CMK2 の転写を正に制御する（40816: 26 transcription factors including Rgm1 positively regulate CMK2 transcription (40816512)
Rgs2 を欠くとグルコースによる cAMP の増加が強まり、過剰発現で弱まる。: Loss of Rgs2 enhances the glucose-induced increase in cAMP, and overexpression weakens it. Rgs2 directly activates the GTPase of Gpa2 and negatively regulates glucose-induced cAMP signaling (10523302)
Rgt1 は HXT3 プロモーターの複数の部位に体内で結合して転写を相乗的に抑: Rgt1 binds multiple sites in the HXT3 promoter in vivo and represses transcription synergistically. Hyperphosphorylated Rgt1 at high glucose does not bind DNA (12861007)
Rgt1 はグルコースがないときだけ Std1・Mth1 と two-hybri: Rgt1 binds Std1 and Mth1 in two-hybrid assays and co-precipitates in vivo only in the absence of glucose. In the std1 mth1 double mutant, repression of HXT by Rgt1 is lost and Rgt1 becomes constitutively phosphorylated (14508605)
Rgt1 はグルコースがないときは HXT 遺伝子のリプレッサー。高濃度のグルコ: Rgt1 is a repressor of HXT genes in the absence of glucose. At high glucose it is phosphorylated and converted into an activator, and it is required for maximal induction of HXT1. Since it does not bind the HXT1 promoter at high glucose, the mechanism is thought to be indirect (12527758)
Rgt2 の細胞表面の量は yck1Δ yck2ts で大きく減る（エンドサイト: Cell surface levels of Rgt2 are strongly reduced in yck1Δ yck2ts (not due to degradation by endocytosis). Rgt2 is phosphorylated in a Yck-dependent manner at C-terminal Yck sites, and this glucose-induced modification is essential for its stability and function (35102180). This phosphorylation is required for binding of the corepressors (Mth1, Std1) and for HXT expression (27630263)
Rho ファミリーの GTPase Cdc42 は細胞膜ストレスによる TORC: The Rho-family GTPase Cdc42 contributes to activation of TORC2-Ypk1/2 signaling by plasma membrane stress (35912799)
Rho1 と Pkc1 はセプチンリングを安定させ、その一部は F-BAR タン: Rho1 and Pkc1 stabilize the septin ring, partly through phosphorylation of the F-BAR protein Syp1. Pkc1-dependent phosphorylation of two serines releases Syp1 from the bud neck (26179915)
Rho1 の GAP である SAC7・BEM2 を壊すと Slt2 が常に活性: Disruption of SAC7 and BEM2, GAPs for Rho1, causes constitutive activation of Slt2. They negatively regulate the cell wall pathway (10625705)
Rho1 は G1/S 移行期に出芽予定部位で Cln2-Cdc28 によって活: Rho1 is activated at the presumptive bud site at the G1/S transition by Cln2-Cdc28, acting through Tus1, a GEF for Rho1 (18256282)
Rho1 は GST-Ste4 と結合し、Gβγ-Rho1 の結合を壊す STE: Rho1 binds GST-Ste4, and STE4 mutations that disrupt Gβγ-Rho1 binding reduce localization of Rho1 to the projection tip (12660244)
Rho1 は高い温度でのフォルミンの活性化に必要で、アクチン骨格への主な効果器: Rho1 is required for formin activation at high temperature and acts through Pkc1, its main effector on the actin cytoskeleton. Pkc1 also activates the MAPK pathway, but this pathway does not act in formin activation. In the main text, activated Pkc1 allows rho1-2 cells to form cable-like filaments upon Bni1 overexpression even at 37 degrees
Rho3 と Rho4 の必須の働きはフォルミン Bni1 と Bnr1 の活性: The essential function of Rho3 and Rho4 is activation of the formins Bni1 and Bnr1; making either formin constitutively active makes Rho3 and Rho4 dispensable. The main text proposes that Rho3 (and secondarily Rho4) releases the interaction between the RBD and DAD of Bni1
Rho3 の効果器ドメインの変異解析で、小胞を母細胞から芽へ運ぶ働きは Myo2: Mutational analysis of the effector domain of Rho3 indicates that its function in transporting vesicles from the mother cell to the bud is mediated by Myo2 (10588647). Rho3 binds Myo2 in two-hybrid assays and with purified proteins, and effector domain mutations abolish the binding (10207081)
Rho5 は Dck1 と Lmo1 からなる 2 量体の GEF で活性化され: Rho5 is activated by a dimeric GEF composed of Dck1 and Lmo1. Translocation of Rho5 to mitochondria under stress depends on both subunits (35887245)
Rib3 の Cys56 が試験管内で Grx2 依存に可逆的に S-グルタチオ: Cys56 of Rib3 is reversibly S-glutathionylated in a Grx2-dependent manner in vitro (21565288)
Ric1 は Rgp1 と固い複合体をつくり、Ric1-Rgp1 は Ypt6: Ric1 forms a tight complex with Rgp1; Ric1-Rgp1 binds Ypt6 in a nucleotide-dependent manner, and the purified complex stimulates guanine nucleotide exchange on Ypt6 in vitro. Loss of RIC1 or RGP1, like ypt6, blocks Snc1 recycling, which is restored by YPT6 overexpression (10990452). Consistent with the GO direction (activation)
Rie1 の結合相手として RRM タンパク質 Sgn1 を同定。どちらも Im: The RRM protein Sgn1 was identified as a binding partner of Rie1. Both are involved in timely expression of Ime1 (37638885)
Rif1 と Rif2 は DNA 末端への Tel1 の集まりを抑え、MRX: Rif1 and Rif2 suppress the accumulation of Tel1 at DNA ends but not the accumulation of MRX. Rif2 competes with Tel1 for binding to the C-terminus of Xrs2 (19217405). rif2-S6E, which strengthens Rif2-Rad50 binding, suppresses Tel1 binding to DSBs and lowers Tel1 activation (38180815). In a reconstituted system, Rif2 inhibits MRX-dependent Tel1 kinase activity and releases the ATP-bound form of Rad50 (31640985)
Rif1 と Rif2 は別々の仕組みで DNA 末端への Tel1 の集まりを: Rif1 and Rif2 suppress the accumulation of Tel1 at DNA ends by separate mechanisms but do not suppress MRX accumulation. The function of Rif1 is weaker than that of Rif2 at short telomeric sequences and partly depends on Rif2 (19217405)
Rif2 の N 末端の BAT モチーフはテロメアの伸長と Tel1 の活性を: The N-terminal BAT motif of Rif2 suppresses telomere elongation and Tel1 activity and also blocks NHEJ and 5′ end resection. It inhibits the ability of MRX to hold DNA ends through direct binding to the ATP-bound head of Rad50 (33980827). Rif2 accumulates at DSBs, enhances ATP hydrolysis by MRX and weakens the end-tethering function of MRX (26901759)
Rif2 は Mre11 のエンドヌクレアーゼの活性を抑え、sae2Δ で MR: Rif2 inhibits the endonuclease activity of Mre11 and is the reason MRX persists at DSBs in sae2Δ. Residues of Rad50 required for Rad50-Rif2 binding were identified, and Rif2 is proposed to stabilize, opposite to Sae2, a cleavage-incompetent form of Mre11-Rad50 (33789097)
Rim101 の切断による活性化と NRE での抑制には Dfg16・Ygr12: Dfg16, Ygr122w and ESCRT are required for activation of Rim101 by cleavage and for repression at the NRE (16024810)
Rim101 は生体内で抑制因子として働き、抑える標的 NRG1・SMP1 のプ: Rim101 acts as a repressor in vivo and binds the promoters of its repressed targets NRG1 and SMP1. Deletion of nrg1 and smp1 suppresses the defects of rim101Δ (12509465)
Rim101 acts as a repressor in vivo and binds the promoters of its repressed targets NRG1 and SMP1 (12509465)
Rim11（GSK3）は Ume6 に結合してリン酸化し、GSK3 部位の置換で: Rim11 (GSK3) binds and phosphorylates Ume6, and substitution of the GSK3 sites impairs Ume6-Ime1 binding and expression of meiotic genes (9372955). Under nitrogen limitation, phosphorylation of Ume6 increases, depends on Rim11 and Mck1, and is required for Ume6-Ime1 binding and activation of meiotic genes (10891485)
Rim15 がエンドスルフィン Igo1/2 をリン酸化し、Igo1/2 が P: Rim15 phosphorylates the endosulfines Igo1/2, and Igo1/2 directly inhibit PP2A-Cdc55
Rim15 にリン酸化された Igo1/2 が PP2A-Cdc55 を直接抑え: Igo1/2 phosphorylated by Rim15 directly inhibit PP2A-Cdc55, maintaining the phosphorylated form of Gis1
Rim15 にリン酸化されたエンドスルフィン Igo1/2 が PP2A-Cdc: When the endosulfines Igo1/2 phosphorylated by Rim15 inhibit PP2A-Cdc55, Gis1 is kept in its phosphorylated form and is recruited to the promoters of nutrient-regulated genes to activate transcription (23273919)
Rim15 の核への集積は、Sit4 によらない TOR の下流の枝と Sch9: Nuclear accumulation of Rim15 is inhibited both by a Sit4-independent branch downstream of TOR and by Sch9 (14690612)
Rim15 は TORC1 と Ras/cAMP/PKA に抑えられるキナーゼで: Rim15 is a kinase inhibited by TORC1 and Ras/cAMP/PKA and is the downstream effector of the signal for degradation of Hxt3 and Hxt7 (23227176)
Rim15-Igo1,2 の経路は G1 期の初めに強まり、PP2A-Cdc55: The Rim15-Igo1,2 pathway is enhanced in early G1 and promotes START by preventing dephosphorylation of Whi5 by PP2A-Cdc55 (28600888)
Rim15-Igo1,2 は PP2A-Cdc55 による Whi5 の脱リン酸: Rim15-Igo1,2 promotes START by preventing dephosphorylation of Whi5 by PP2A-Cdc55, and Cln3-Cdk1 inhibits Rim15 activity (28600888). The summary does not state direct inhibition by phosphorylation. BioGRID 28496991 is a paper on Sic1, and Rim15 does not appear in its abstract
Rim1p（Rim101）は C 末端で切断され、rim8・rim9・rim13: Rim1p (Rim101) is cleaved at its C-terminus, and cleavage is blocked in rim8, rim9 and rim13 mutants. Expression of a C-terminally truncated form suppresses the rim8, rim9 and rim13 mutations. Cleavage is promoted by alkaline conditions (9017390)
Rim20 は Rim101 と相互作用し、C 末端の切断による Rim101: Rim20 interacts with Rim101 and is required for activation of Rim101 by C-terminal cleavage (15371534). Rim20 is required for alkaline-induced cleavage of Rim101 and accumulates in endosomal puncta under alkaline conditions (16407402)
Rim21・Dfg16・Rim9 は複合体をつくり、rim9Δ で Rim21: Rim21, Dfg16 and Rim9 form a complex, and the level of Rim21 is strongly reduced in rim9Δ (23019326)
Rim21・Dfg16・Rim9 は複合体を作り、dfg16Δ で Rim21: Rim21, Dfg16 and Rim9 form a complex, and the level of Rim21 is strongly reduced in dfg16Δ. Dfg16 maintains the level and plasma membrane localization of Rim21 (23019326)
Rim4 の Bmh1/2 結合部位は PKA がリン酸化し Cdc14 が脱リ: The Bmh1/2-binding site of Rim4 is phosphorylated by PKA and dephosphorylated by Cdc14, regulating formation, localization, function and stability of Rim4-Bmh1/2 (37659077)
Rip1 はマトリックスで成熟したのち Bcs1 ATPase によって内膜を越: Rip1 matures in the matrix and is then translocated across the inner membrane by the Bcs1 ATPase to be incorporated into the bc1 complex (22927643)
Rix7 は Nsa1 と遺伝的に相互作用し、rix7 変異では Nsa1 が: Rix7 interacts genetically with Nsa1, and in rix7 mutants Nsa1 is not released from pre-60S (18559667)
Rkm1 は 40S リボソームタンパク質 S18-A/B のリシン 48 をモ: Rkm1 monomethylates lysine 48 of the 40S ribosomal protein S18-A/B (22522802)
Rkm1 は uL14（Rpl23）のリシンメチル化酵素で、Bcp1・uL14: Rkm1 is the lysine methyltransferase for uL14 (Rpl23); it forms a ternary complex with Bcp1 and uL14, protects uL14 and is transported with it into the nucleus. Misfolded uL14 is retained by Rkm1 and does not enter pre-60S. In rkm1Δ alone newly made uL14 is not reduced, but in bcp1ts rkm1Δ it nearly disappears (39007857). The methylation sites are K106 and K110, and ribosomal complex formation is unchanged in rkm1Δ (17327221)
Rlp24 は Drg1 を前駆 60S 粒子へ呼び込み、その ATPase 活: Rlp24 recruits Drg1 to pre-60S particles and stimulates its ATPase activity. ATP hydrolysis at the second AAA domain is required for release of the shuttling protein, and in vitro Drg1 extracts only Rlp24 from pre-60S (23185031). Consistent with the UniProt direction (activation)
Rmd9 は 15S の 3′ 末端領域に結合し、rmd9 と dss1 の遺伝: Rmd9 binds the 3′ end region of 15S, and the genetic interaction between rmd9 and dss1 indicates that it limits mtEXO activity in processing of the 3′ spacer (38599301)
Rme1 は IME1 の上流の 2 か所に結合し、両方とも IME1 の抑制に: Rme1 binds two sites upstream of IME1, both of which are required for repression of IME1. Rme1 represses IME1 directly (9580682)
Rmi1 は Sgs1-Top3 と複合体を作り、組換えタンパク質で直接結合する: Rmi1 forms a complex with Sgs1-Top3 and binds directly as recombinant protein (15899853)
Rmi1 は Top3 と安定な複合体を作り、超らせんの弛緩活性と一本鎖 DNA: Rmi1 forms a stable complex with Top3 and enhances its supercoil relaxation activity and single-stranded DNA binding (17693398)
Rmt2 がリボソームタンパク質 L12 の Arg67 をメチル化する（δ-N: Rmt2 methylates Arg67 of the ribosomal protein L12 (δ-N-monomethylarginine) (11856739)
Rmt2 はリボソームタンパク質 L12 の Arg67 をメチル化する。野生株: Rmt2 methylates Arg67 of the ribosomal protein L12. L12 from wild-type cells also contains monomethylarginine (11856739)
Rna14 の C 末端の領域が Rna15 と結合し、Rna14 と Rna1: The C-terminal region of Rna14 binds Rna15, and the crystal structure of the complex of the hinge regions of Rna14 and Rna15 was determined (22513198)
Rnh201 単独・Rnh203 との組では基質結合も活性もなく、複合体に入って: Rnh201 alone, or together with Rnh203, shows neither substrate binding nor activity; it works only once in the complex (22004424)
Rnt1 が BDF2 mRNA のステムループを切って発現を下げる（RMD）。: Rnt1 cleaves a stem-loop in the BDF2 mRNA and lowers its expression (RMD). This is enhanced under salt stress (25232960)
Rnt1 の生体内の切断部位を地図にし、標的の YDR514C の変異が rnt: In vivo Rnt1 cleavage sites were mapped, and mutation of the target YDR514C suppresses the poor growth of an rnt1 deletion. Rnt1 is thought to repress expression of YDR514C (42148733)
Rny1 は小胞体からゴルジ体へ運ばれるとき、COPII 小胞への積み込みにアダ: When Rny1 is transported from the endoplasmic reticulum to the Golgi, it uses the adaptor Erv29 for loading into COPII vesicles (24102742)
Rod1 は Snf1 と PP1 の Glc7/Reg1 からなるグルコースの: Rod1 is a direct target of the glucose signaling pathway composed of Snf1 and the PP1 Glc7/Reg1. Glucose promotes dephosphorylation of Rod1 and its release from 14-3-3, allowing ubiquitination by Rsp5 (22249293)
Rog1 は Rsp5 に直接結合し、結合は GSK-3 に依存。npi1 変異: Rog1 binds Rsp5 directly, and the binding depends on GSK-3. In the npi1 mutant (reduced RSP5 expression) Rog1 is stabilized (10958669)
Rog3/Art7 も Ste2 の脱感作と取り込みに働き、N 末端のアレスチン: Rog3/Art7 also acts in desensitization and internalization of Ste2, and the N-terminal arrestin region alone is sufficient to drive adaptation (24820415)
Rom1・Rom2 は Rho1 の GDP/GTP 交換因子。両方を壊すと致死: Rom1 and Rom2 are GDP/GTP exchange factors for Rho1. Disrupting both is lethal, and the exchange activity was shown for the DH domain of Rom2 (8641285)
Rom2 の DH ドメインは Rho1 特異的な GDP/GTP 交換活性を持: The DH domain of Rom2 has Rho1-specific GDP/GTP exchange activity (GEF)
Roq1 は Ynm3（Nma111）に切断され、切断型 Roq1 が Ubr1: Roq1 is cleaved by Ynm3 (Nma111), and the cleaved form of Roq1 alters the substrate specificity of Ubr1 (29861160)
Rox1 と Tup1・Ssn6 は DAN/TIR 遺伝子の好気での完全な抑制: Rox1 and Tup1-Ssn6 are required for complete aerobic repression of the DAN/TIR genes (11238402)
Rox1 は ATF1 プロモーターの酸素調節領域に結合し、rox1・tup1・: Rox1 binds the oxygen-regulated region of the ATF1 promoter, and disruption of rox1, tup1 or ssn6 increases aerobic expression of ATF1 (10487921)
Roy1 は GDP 型と空の Ypt52 に結合し、活性型（GTP 型）Ypt: Roy1 binds the GDP-bound and nucleotide-free forms of Ypt52 and inhibits formation of active (GTP-bound) Ypt52 (21389113)
Roy1 は生理的条件で Ypt52 に結合し、その結合に Skp1 が欠かせな: Roy1 binds Ypt52 under physiological conditions, and Skp1 is indispensable for this binding (21389113)
Rpa12p は Msn4p と相互作用し、Msn4p が AYR1 のプロモー: Rpa12p interacts with Msn4p and prevents Msn4p from binding the AYR1 promoter (27637775)
Rpa135 の Zn 結合ドメインは最大サブユニット Rpa190 を RNA: The Zn-binding domain of Rpa135 is required for incorporation of the largest subunit Rpa190 into the RNA polymerase I complex (14555487)
Rpa34 は Rpa49 の N 末端領域に結合し、その領域を欠く rpa49: Rpa34 binds the N-terminal region of Rpa49 and is lost from the polymerase in rpa49 mutants lacking that region (18086878)
Rpa43/Rpa14 のストークが Pol I から突き出ている（219831: The Rpa43/Rpa14 stalk protrudes from Pol I (21983101)
Rpb4 と Rpb7 はヘテロ二量体を作る。ツーハイブリッドで互いの結合に要る: Rpb4 and Rpb7 form a heterodimer. The regions required for their mutual binding were determined by two-hybrid analysis (15913559)
Rpb4 は Ssu72 と Fcp1 の CTD への会合・呼び込み・接近に重: Rpb4 is important for the association, recruitment and access of Ssu72 and Fcp1 to the CTD, which correlate well with the levels of Ser5P and Ser2P, respectively (25416796)
Rpb6 の変異で Pol II から Rpb4・Rpb7 が失われ、Rpb6: Mutations in Rpb6 cause loss of Rpb4 and Rpb7 from Pol II, and Rpb6 binds Rpb4 directly (12697831)
Rpb8 と YGR089W（NNF2）の産物がツーハイブリッドで結合。ygr0: Rpb8 and the product of YGR089W (NNF2) interact in two-hybrid assays. ygr089Δ aggravates the growth defect of rpb8 mutants (11486042)
Rpb8 の欠損変異は Rpa190・Rpb1・Rpc160 の保存断片とのツー: Deletion mutations in Rpb8 impair two-hybrid interaction with conserved fragments of Rpa190, Rpb1 and Rpc160 (11486042)
Rpc53・Rpc82・Ret1 が栄養に依存する SUMO の標的で、窒素飢餓: Rpc53, Rpc82 and Ret1 are nutrient-dependent SUMO targets and are rapidly deSUMOylated upon nitrogen starvation or TORC1 inhibition (28096404)
Rpd3 と Ume6 は発酵中に VTH2 の長いアイソフォームを抑える（25: Rpd3 and Ume6 repress the long isoform of VTH2 during fermentation (25728275)
Rpd3 は Rad53 を脱アセチル化して過剰な活性化を防ぎ、チェックポイント: Rpd3 deacetylates Rad53 to prevent its excessive activation and promotes checkpoint adaptation. In rpd3Δ, Rad53 acetylation and kinase activity increase, and substitution of the acetylation sites suppresses the adaptation defect (23979600)
Rpd3L deacetylates Ino80 K929 and H2A.Z, prevents incorporation of H2A.Z into chromatin and represses transcription of autophagy genes. TORC1 enhances this deacetylation (36888706)
Rpd3L は Ino80 の K929 を脱アセチル化し、Ino80 をオート: Rpd3L deacetylates K929 of Ino80 and protects Ino80 from autophagic degradation. Stabilized Ino80 removes H2A.Z from autophagy-related genes and represses transcription. TORC1 enhances this deacetylation, and when TORC1 is blocked by nitrogen starvation or rapamycin, Rpd3L is inhibited (36888706)
Rpd3L 複合体の Pho23 は ATG9 を含む複数の ATG 遺伝子の転: Pho23 of the Rpd3L complex represses transcription of several ATG genes including ATG9. Deletion of pho23 or overexpression of Atg9 increases autophagosomes (25046109)
Rpd3L 複合体の構成要素として Rpd3・Rxt3 などが同定された（163: Rpd3, Rxt3 and others were identified as components of the Rpd3L complex (16314178)
Rpd3L 複合体の構成要素として Rpd3・Sds3・…・Rxt2 などを質量: Rpd3, Sds3, …, Rxt2 and others were identified by mass spectrometry as components of the Rpd3L complex (16314178)
Rpd3L 複合体の構成要素に Rpd3・Sin3・Sap30 などが含まれる（: Components of the Rpd3L complex include Rpd3, Sin3 and Sap30 (16314178)
Rpd3S の触媒活性が IME1 と IME2 の転写を活性化する。本文: r: The catalytic activity of Rpd3S activates transcription of IME1 and IME2. Main text: IME1 transcription is reduced in rco1Δ (24358376)
Rph1 と Gis1 は URS(PHR1) を介して PHR1 の発現を調節: Rph1 and Gis1 regulate PHR1 expression through URS(PHR1), and deletion of both is required for complete derepression of PHR1 in the absence of damage (10523651)
Rph1 は DNA 損傷ストレスでプロテアソームではなくオートファジーで分解さ: Rph1 is degraded by autophagy rather than the proteasome under DNA damage stress. Gcn5 directly acetylates Rph1 in vitro and in vivo, and SAGA is required for autophagic degradation of Rph1. Acetylation is essential for binding of Rph1 to Nup1 (28334815)
Rph1 は H3 K36me3/me2 に特異的な脱メチル化酵素で、生化学と: Rph1 is a demethylase specific for H3 K36me3/me2 and, from biochemistry and ChIP, directly regulates K36 methylation in transcribed regions. Rph1 and Jhd1 are required for Pol II binding to genes and assist elongation by antagonizing repressive K36 methylation by Set2 (17525156)
Rph1 は不安定なタンパク質で、Rad53 が Rph1 の量を下げる。DNA: Rph1 is an unstable protein, and Rad53 lowers its level. Upon DNA damage Rph1 is released from chromatin and transcriptional repression is relieved (23985319). DNA damage-induced phosphorylation of Rph1 depends on Rad53 kinase activity (11809875)
Rpl1ab の K46 がメチル化され、37 のメチル基転移酵素の欠失株のうち: K46 of Rpl1ab is methylated, and among 37 methyltransferase deletion strains only deletion of YLR137W (RKM5) abolishes it. Recombinant Rkm5 methylates it in vitro (21460220)
Rpl4 の長い内部ループの C 末端側に専用の結合相手 Acl4 が結合する。: A dedicated binding partner, Acl4, binds the C-terminal side of the long internal loop of Rpl4. Acl4 captures nascent Rpl4 co-translationally and accompanies it to nuclear pre-60S (26447800)
Rpl42ab の K40 のメチル化は Ybr030w（Rkm3）、K55 は: Methylation of K40 of Rpl42ab depends on Ybr030w (Rkm3) and that of K55 on Set7 (Rkm4) (18957409)
Rpm2 は Dcp2 とツーハイブリッドで結合し、P ボディに集まる（1726: Rpm2 binds Dcp2 in two-hybrid assays and accumulates in P bodies (17267405)
Rpm2 は核で転写活性化因子として働き、TOM40 などの mRNA 量と T: Rpm2 acts as a transcriptional activator in the nucleus and raises mRNA levels such as TOM40 and the protein level of Tom40 (16024791)
Rpn14 は Rpt6 の C 末端の 4 本ヘリックス束に選択的・高親和性で: Rpn14 binds selectively and with high affinity to the C-terminal four-helix bundle of Rpt6 (23562395)
Rpn4 は PACE に結合し、PACE を持つ lacZ と RPT4・RP: Rpn4 binds PACE and increases expression of a PACE-containing lacZ and of reporters with the RPT4 and RPT6 promoters (10350051)
Rpn4 はミスフォールドタンパク質に応じて TMC1 の転写を誘導する（272: Rpn4 induces transcription of TMC1 in response to misfolded proteins (27226598)
Rpn4 は体内・試験管内で Ubr2 の生理的な基質で、E2 の Rad6 も: Rpn4 is a physiological substrate of Ubr2 in vivo and in vitro, and the E2 Rad6 is also required for ubiquitin-dependent degradation of Rpn4 (15504724). Ubr2 and Rad6 are the E3 and E2 for Rpn4 ubiquitination, and Mub1 was the missing factor (18070918)
Rpn6 の保存された面が 20S の α 環の Pre8（α2）と ATPas: A conserved surface of Rpn6 contacts Pre8 (α2) of the 20S α ring and Rpt6 of the ATPase ring (22187461)
Rpn6 は Rpn3・Rpn7・Rpn12・Sem1 の lid への組み込み: Rpn6 is required for incorporation of Rpn3, Rpn7, Rpn12 and Sem1 into the lid (15611133)
Rpn8 の C 末端 30 残基が Pih1 の C 末端に結合し、Pih1: The C-terminal 30 residues of Rpn8 bind the C-terminus of Pih1 and mediate ubiquitin-independent degradation of Pih1 (27053109)
Rpn9 は Rpn10 を 26S プロテアソームに組み込むのに必要（1049: Rpn9 is required for incorporation of Rpn10 into the 26S proteasome (10490597)
Rpo41 の転写産物を Mip1 が伸ばせる。Rpo41 は複製起点とプロモー: Mip1 can extend transcripts made by Rpo41. Rpo41 makes primers for Mip1 at replication origins and promoters (in vitro) (26184436)
Rpo41 は単独でもプロモーターから開始できるが、閉じた鋳型では Mtf1 が: Rpo41 can initiate from a promoter on its own, but on closed templates Mtf1 is required, and Mtf1 assists promoter melting (not recognition) (15342628)
Rps10A・Rps10B は試験管内で Gcn1 と RNA に依らず共沈する: Rps10A and Rps10B co-precipitate with Gcn1 in vitro independently of RNA. eIF2α phosphorylation is reduced in rps10BΔ (25437641)
Rps19 を減らすと異常な pre-40S が核にたまり、Enp1・Tsr1・: Depletion of Rps19 causes accumulation of aberrant pre-40S in the nucleus that does not bind Enp1, Tsr1 or Rio2 (16159874)
Rpt3 への ATP の結合で ATPase の環が形を変え、Nas6 が新し: ATP binding to Rpt3 changes the conformation of the ATPase ring and releases Nas6 from newly made proteasomes (30625330)
Rrb1 は核抽出液で Rpl3 と物理的に結合し、過剰発現で遊離 Rpl3 が: Rrb1 physically binds Rpl3 in nuclear extracts, and its overexpression increases free Rpl3 and causes it to accumulate in the nucleus. RPL3 expression also increases (11158312)
Rrd1 は Tap42-Sit4 と、Rrd2 は Tap42-PP2Ac 複: Rrd1 binds specifically to Tap42-Sit4 and Rrd2 to the Tap42-PP2Ac complex. The binding is disrupted by rapamycin (15689491)
Rrm3 の 186-212 残基は複製ストレス下の DNA 合成の制御に要り、: Residues 186-212 of Rrm3 are required for control of DNA synthesis under replication stress and are also important for binding to Orc5 of ORC (27923055)
Rrn3 の量を変えると Pol I-Rrn3 複合体の数とそれに応じて rRN: Changing the level of Rrn3 changes the number of Pol I-Rrn3 complexes and, accordingly, transcription of rRNA genes (20421203). Only Pol I in a complex containing the initiation factor Rrn3 can initiate transcription (9649439)
Rrp14 は Ebp2 と two-hybrid で結合し、Utp11・Faf: Rrp14 binds Ebp2 in two-hybrid assays and also binds Utp11 and Faf1 (17804645)
Rrp43p は Rrp46p を介してエキソソームと結合し、ts 変異体は R: Rrp43p binds the exosome through Rrp46p, and a ts mutant does not bind Rrp46p (12364597)
Rrp44-Rrp41-Rrp45 複合体の結晶構造で、ヌクレアーゼ Rrp44: The crystal structure of the Rrp44-Rrp41-Rrp45 complex shows how the nuclease Rrp44 binds the exosome core (19879841)
Rrp44-Rrp41（Ski6）-Rrp45 複合体の結晶構造（1987984: Crystal structure of the Rrp44-Rrp41 (Ski6)-Rrp45 complex (19879841)
Rrp5 と DEAD-box の Has1 の相互作用が、Rrp5 が離れない: The interaction between Rrp5 and the DEAD-box protein Has1 is suggested to be involved in the accumulation of snR30 when Rrp5 fails to be released (27280440)
Rrs1 は GSK-3 相同体 Rim11 と Mrk1 と相互作用し、Rrs: Rrs1 interacts with the GSK-3 homologs Rim11 and Mrk1, and mutation of the GSK-3 phosphorylation consensus in Rrs1 abolishes the binding (25035982)
Rrs1 を餌にした 2 ハイブリッドで Rpf2 を得た。Rpf2 も rpL: Rpf2 was obtained in a two-hybrid screen with Rrs1 as bait. Rpf2 also binds rpL11 and is required for processing of 27SB pre-rRNA into 25S rRNA (12048200)
Rrt6 は Erp3・Erp5・Emp24 と αβγδ 複合体を作る（242: Rrt6 forms an αβγδ complex with Erp3, Erp5 and Emp24 (24217251)
Rrt6 はグリセロールで誘導され、Erp3・Erp5・Emp24 と αβγδ: Rrt6 is induced by glycerol and forms an αβγδ complex with Erp3, Erp5 and Emp24. All p24α/γ forms bind p24β and δ (24217251)
Rrt6 is induced by glycerol and forms an αβγδ complex with Erp3, Erp5 and Emp24 (24217251)
Rsa3 は Dbp6 と共沈する。rsa3 null は dbp6 と合成致死: Rsa3 co-precipitates with Dbp6. An rsa3 null is synthetically lethal with dbp6 (15126390)
Rsc1 型 RSC がオートファジーの誘導に働き、ATG8 mRNA の十分な: Rsc1-type RSC acts in induction of autophagy and is required for sufficient expression of ATG8 mRNA and for stability of the Atg8 protein (26212438)
Rsc2 の BAH ドメインは精製した H3 に試験管内で結合し、ヌクレオソー: The BAH domain of Rsc2 binds purified H3 in vitro and also binds nucleosomes (23907388)
Rsc3 と Rsc30 は RSC の構成要素で、安定なヘテロ 2 量体を作る: Rsc3 and Rsc30 are components of RSC and form a stable heterodimer (11336698)
Rsc7/Npl6 と Rsc14/Ldb7 は Rsc3・Rsc30・Htl1: Rsc7/Npl6 and Rsc14/Ldb7 associate physically and functionally with Rsc3, Rsc30 and Htl1 to form a module (16204215)
Rsc7・Rsc14 が Rsc3・Rsc30・Htl1 と RSC のモジュー: Rsc7 and Rsc14 form an RSC module with Rsc3, Rsc30 and Htl1. Deletion of Rsc14 abolishes incorporation of Rsc3 and Rsc30 (16204215)
Rsp5 と Rod1 は Jen1 のグルコースによる取り込みと取り込み後の液: Rsp5 and Rod1 are required for glucose-induced internalization of Jen1 and for its post-internalization sorting to the vacuole (25380227). The C-terminus of Jen1 is required for binding to Rod1 and for glucose-induced ubiquitination (29789424)
Rsp5 と結合できない Spt23ΔLPKY は切り出されにくく、標的遺伝子: Spt23ΔLPKY, which cannot bind Rsp5, is poorly processed and cannot increase expression of its target gene OLE1 (15466864)
Rsp5 に結合するアダプターをすべて調べ、イソフルランによる Bap2 のエン: All Rsp5-binding adaptors were examined, showing that Art2 has a central role in isoflurane-induced endocytosis of Bap2 (34536986)
Rsp5 のユビキチン化活性がアルギニンによる Put4 のエンドサイトーシスに: The ubiquitin ligase activity of Rsp5 is essential for arginine-induced endocytosis of Put4 (32800549)
Rsp5 は Lsb1・Lsb2 をユビキチン化するが分解に向けない。Rsp5・: Rsp5 ubiquitinates Lsb1 and Lsb2 but does not target them for degradation. Rsp5, Lsb1, Lsb2 and Sla1 regulate the level of Las17 (22000681)
Rsp5 はユビキチン化によって膜にある転写因子 Spt23・Mga2 の OL: Rsp5 activates, by ubiquitination, the OLE1-inducing function of the membrane-bound transcription factors Spt23 and Mga2 (17719829). K63 chains on Mga2-p120 are sufficient for proteasome binding and processing (19153599)
Rsp5 は体内で SUMO 化され、その SUMO 化は Siz1 と Siz: Rsp5 is SUMOylated in vivo, and this SUMOylation is by Siz1 and Siz2. SUMOylated Rsp5 has reduced ubiquitin ligase activity, and ubiquitin-dependent sorting of Smf1 is altered (23443663)

Rsp5 is SUMOylated in vivo, and this SUMOylation is by Siz1 and Siz2. SUMOylated Rsp5 has reduced ubiquitin ligase activity, and conversely Siz1 ubiquitinated by Rsp5 has reduced SUMO ligase activity (23443663). No PMC full text
Rsp5 は生体内で Rpn10 をモノユビキチン化し、この修飾は Rpn10: Rsp5 monoubiquitinates Rpn10 in vivo, and this modification prevents binding of Rpn10 to substrates (26205498). Monoubiquitination of Rpn10 reduces binding of Rpn10 to the proteasome and to Dsk2 (26450923)
Rsp5 は膜に繋がれた転写因子 Spt23・Mga2 をユビキチン化して OL: Rsp5 ubiquitinates the membrane-tethered transcription factors Spt23 and Mga2 and activates their function in inducing OLE1 (17719829). The LPKY motif of Spt23 is required for Rsp5 binding, ubiquitination, proteasomal processing and OLE1 induction (15466864)
Rtf1 の C 末端が L 字の構造をとり Ctr9 と特異的に結合する（34: The C-terminus of Rtf1 adopts an L-shaped structure and binds Ctr9 specifically (34852272)
Rtf1 の HMD が Rad6 に直接結合し、生体内・試験管内で H2BK1: The HMD of Rtf1 binds Rad6 directly and promotes H2BK123ub in vivo and in vitro (37216505)
Rtf1 の N 末端と Chd1 の CHCT ドメインが直接結合。結合を壊す: The N-terminus of Rtf1 binds the CHCT domain of Chd1 directly. Disrupting the binding alters Chd1 distribution and nucleosome positioning (40867051)
Rtg1-Rtg3 複合体の核への移行には細胞質の Rtg2 が要る（11076: Cytoplasmic Rtg2 is required for nuclear translocation of the Rtg1-Rtg3 complex (11076970)
Rtg1/Rtg3 の核への集まりと標的遺伝子の発現がラパマイシンで誘導される。: Nuclear accumulation of Rtg1/Rtg3 and expression of their target genes are induced by rapamycin. Rtg3 is a phosphoprotein whose phosphorylation state changes with rapamycin (11076970). TOR negatively regulates RTG target genes by controlling the subcellular localization of the Rtg1/Rtg3 complex (11882290)
Rtg1・Rtg3 はヘテロ二量体として CIT2 の上流活性化部位に結合し、r: Rtg1 and Rtg3 bind as a heterodimer to the upstream activation site of CIT2, and CIT2 expression increases in rho0 cells (10848632)
Rtg2 は Rtg3 の脱リン酸化と核への移行に必要（10848632）。Rt: Rtg2 is required for dephosphorylation and nuclear translocation of Rtg3 (10848632). Cytoplasmic Rtg2 is required for nuclear translocation of the Rtg1-Rtg3 complex (11076970)
Rtg2 は負の調節因子 Mks1 に可逆的に結合してレトログレード応答を制御し: Rtg2 controls the retrograde response by binding reversibly to the negative regulator Mks1, and hypophosphorylated Mks1 bound to Rtg2 is inactive (14536080). When the response is active, Mks1 is inactivated by binding to Rtg2. Rtg2 and Mks1 bind without other factors (15967597)
Rtn1 と Yop1 は Ndc1 などの NPC 膜タンパク質と物理的に相互: Rtn1 and Yop1 interact physically with NPC membrane proteins such as Ndc1 (22798490)
Rtn1 も生体内で Yip3 と結合するが、Ypt1 とは別の複合体（1600: Rtn1 also binds Yip3 in vivo, but in a complex distinct from that with Ypt1 (16002643)
Rtp1 は RNA pol II の核への輸入に要り、いくつかの pol II: Rtp1 is required for nuclear import of RNA pol II and interacts with several pol II subunits. It is thought to be an assembly factor involved in formation of the Rpb2/Rpb3 subcomplex (23438601)
Rtr1 による RTR1 mRNA の分解に Dhh1 と Rex2・Rex3: Dhh1 and Rex2/Rex3 are involved in Rtr1-mediated decay of RTR1 mRNA (genetics) (26843527)
Dhh1 and the 3'-5' exonucleases Rex2 and Rex3 are involved in Rtr1-mediated decay of RTR1 mRNA (genetics) (26843527)
Rtr1・Rex3 は Dhh1 と結合している（26843527）: Rtr1 and Rex3 are bound to Dhh1 (26843527)
Rts1 は PP2A をいつも Ssy5 の前駆ドメインに向け、アミノ酸がない: Rts1 constitutively directs PP2A to the prodomain of Ssy5 and suppresses activation of Ssy5 in the absence of amino acids (23447701)
Rts3 は PP6 ホスファターゼ Sit4 の阻害因子で、α ヘリックスで: Rts3 is an inhibitor of the PP6 phosphatase Sit4 and inserts directly into the catalytic groove of Sit4-Sap185/190 via an α helix. It is induced upon nitrogen starvation and selectively inhibits the function of Sit4-Sap185/190 (41748572; only one paper)
Rtt101 はリンカー Mms1 を介して基質アダプター Mms22 と結合す: Rtt101 binds the substrate adaptor Mms22 through the linker Mms1 (21593207)
Rtt101-Mms22 は Mrc1 を分解せず、その複製での働きに拮抗する（: Rtt101-Mms22 does not degrade Mrc1 but antagonizes its function in replication (26849847)
Rtt101-Mms22 は S 期に Ctf4 の WD40 ドメインを介して: Rtt101-Mms22 associates with the replisome in S phase through the WD40 domain of Ctf4 (26849847)
Rtt102 は Arp7/9 ヘテロ二量体に強く結合し、その立体構造と ATP: Rtt102 binds tightly to the Arp7/9 heterodimer and is a stabilizing factor that regulates its conformation and its interactions with the ATPase subunit and nucleotide (24189066)
Rtt105 は RPA の大サブユニットと結合する。NLS-Rfa1 を使った: Rtt105 binds the large subunit of RPA. Analysis using NLS-Rfa1 shows that Rtt105 acts both in nuclear import of RPA and in RPA function (33724421)
Rtt105 は Rad51 と試験管内・生体内で結合し、Rad51 の一本鎖: Rtt105 binds Rad51 in vitro and in vivo and directly promotes Rad51 assembly on single-stranded DNA, strand exchange and D-loop formation (39145931)
Rtt106 の 2 つの領域が H3-H4 を組み合わせで認識し、二重 PH: Two regions of Rtt106 recognize H3-H4 combinatorially; the double PH region binds the part of H3 containing K56, and acetylation of K56 greatly increases the affinity (22307274)
Rtt107 は Mec1 の標的。Mec1 によるリン酸化と Smc5-Smc: Rtt107 is a target of Mec1. Phosphorylation by Mec1 and binding to Smc5-Smc6 are required for recruitment of Rtt107 to DSBs (21647453)
Rtt107 は SMC5/6 の DSB への集まりに要る（21642432）: Rtt107 is required for recruitment of SMC5/6 to DSBs (21642432)
Rtt109 は H3 K56 のアセチル化酵素で、Rtt109 を欠くか活性部: Rtt109 is the H3 K56 acetyltransferase; in cells lacking Rtt109 or with active-site mutations, H3-K56 acetylation is lost, cells become sensitive to DNA damaging agents and chromosome breakage increases (17272723). In cells lacking Rtt109 and in H3-K56 mutants, binding of three proteins to stalled replication forks is reduced and recombination increases at the rDNA fork barrier. Rtt109-Vps75 acetylates H3/H4 presented by Asf1 (17690098)
Rtt109 は Vps75 と複合体をつくり、複合体でだけ触媒が効率よく進む。: Rtt109 forms a complex with Vps75, and efficient catalysis occurs only in the complex. The C-terminal acidic domain of Vps75 contributes to activation of Rtt109, whereas Nap1 does not activate Rtt109 (19172749)
Rub1 は結合の前に C 末端の Asn が外される。Rub1 の結合は C: The C-terminal Asn of Rub1 is removed before conjugation. Rub1 conjugation depends on the C-terminal processing enzyme Yuh1, and Rub1 lacking the Asn is conjugated even without Yuh1 (12455997)
Rud3 の Golgi への局在には積み荷受容体 Erv14 も要る（1550: The cargo receptor Erv14 is also required for Golgi localization of Rud3 (15504911)
Rud3 は C 末端の GRAB ドメインで Arf1 に結合し、cis-Go: Rud3 binds Arf1 through its C-terminal GRAB domain and localizes to the cis-Golgi (15504911)
Rup1 は Rsp5 と Ubp2 の結合に試験管内でも生体内でも必要（159: Rup1 is required for binding between Rsp5 and Ubp2 both in vitro and in vivo (15933713)
Rvb1 と Rvb2 はヘテロ六量体の環を作り、複合体は単独より高い ATPa: Rvb1 and Rvb2 form a heterohexameric ring, and the complex shows higher ATPase activity and stronger DNA helicase activity than either alone (18234224)
Rvs167p は Acf2p・Gdh3p・Ybr108wp と直接結合し、どれ: Rvs167p binds Acf2p, Gdh3p and Ybr108wp directly, all of which are in lipid rafts containing Rvs161p (15561700)
S 期に GINS は複製起点に結合する。GINS が無いと Dpb11 も C: In S phase GINS binds replication origins. Without GINS, neither Dpb11 nor Cdc45 binds chromatin properly (12730134)
S 期に SCF-Cdc4 が CDK の活性に依存して Clb6 の分解を制御: In S phase SCF-Cdc4 controls degradation of Clb6 depending on CDK activity (stated in the abstract as previously reported) (26994663)
S 期に SCF-Cdc4 が Clb6 の分解を担い、これには CDK の活性: In S phase SCF-Cdc4 mediates degradation of Clb6, which requires CDK activity. The non-phosphorylatable Clb6-3A (S6A, T39A, S147A) is excessively stable in S phase. In G1, APC-Cdh1 also degrades Clb6 (26994663). Since the kinase is described only as CDK, the confidence is medium
S 期にストレスで転写が急増すると、Mrc1 の N 末端のリン酸化が複製を止め: When transcription surges under stress in S phase, phosphorylation of the Mrc1 N-terminus halts replication and prevents genome instability (29371596). Main text: at low glucose, Snf1 phosphorylates and binds Mrc1 in vivo and delays S phase. snf1 and mrc1-3A similarly increase Rad52 foci, with no additive effect in the double mutant

When transcription surges under stress in S phase, phosphorylation of the Mrc1 N-terminus halts replication and prevents transcription-associated recombination and genome instability. Several kinases phosphorylate the N-terminus (29371596). Main text: Mrc1 phosphorylation under heat stress is abolished in an mpk1 deletion, Mpk1 and Mrc1 bind in vivo, and this phosphorylation is required for the replication delay and for preventing TAR
S 期に入ると Cdc28 と 9-1-1 複合体の両方が Ddc2 を損傷のフ: Upon entry into S phase, both Cdc28 and the 9-1-1 complex recruit Ddc2 to damage foci (in G1 only 9-1-1 does) (18406328)
S 期の 4 つの転写因子のリン酸化を除くと分解が損なわれる。本文: その 4: Removing phosphorylation of four S-phase transcription factors impairs their degradation. Main text: the four are Hcm1, Tos4, Yox1 and Yhp1, expressed in S phase. Tos4-9A is stable and persists throughout the cell cycle, and Tos4 is also stabilized by Cdk1 inhibition. Phosphorylated Tos4 is stable in cdc53-1 (degradation by SCF) (24714560)
S 期の後、Cdk1 によるリン酸化で Eco1 は SCF-Cdc4 にユビキ: After S phase, phosphorylation by Cdk1 leads to ubiquitination and degradation of Eco1 by SCF-Cdc4. Non-phosphorylatable Eco1 establishes cohesion even after DNA replication (21549314). After Cdk1, Cdc7-Dbf4 and Mck1 phosphorylate sequentially to create the degron (23314252)
S 期の後、Eco1 は Cdk1 のリン酸化を足がかりに Cdc7-Dbf4: After S phase, Eco1 is phosphorylated sequentially by Cdc7-Dbf4 and the GSK-3 Mck1, building on Cdk1 phosphorylation, and is recognized by SCF(Cdc4) and degraded. The DNA damage response inhibits Cdc7 to prevent Eco1 degradation, allowing cohesion establishment after S phase (23314252)
S 期の後に Cdk1 でリン酸化された Eco1 は SCF(Cdc4) でユ: After S phase, Eco1 phosphorylated by Cdk1 is ubiquitinated by SCF(Cdc4) and degraded (21549314)
S 期の遺伝毒性ストレスは MBF の標的遺伝子を特異的に誘導し、それは Rad: Genotoxic stress in S phase specifically induces MBF target genes, which is due to Rad53 directly phosphorylating Nrm1 and preventing its binding to MBF target promoters (22333915)
S 期型の CDK（S-CDK）のリン酸化が Yta7 の ATP 加水分解を促: Phosphorylation by S-phase CDK (S-CDK) stimulates ATP hydrolysis by Yta7 and promotes nucleosome disassembly and replication. Main text: the S-CDK used was Clb5-Cdc28-Cks1. Yta7 binds replication origins in S phase (34471130)
S-II 欠失株で SSM1 の発現が下がり、試験管内で SSM1 内の転写停止: SSM1 expression is reduced in an S-II deletion strain, and S-II relieves a transcriptional pause site within SSM1 in vitro (10858443)
S230A の変異で PHO5 の転写を活性化できなくなり、S230D は働く（: The S230A mutation abolishes the ability to activate PHO5 transcription, whereas S230D is functional (suggesting that only phosphorylated Pho2 activates). CDC28 immunoprecipitates from cells grown under low phosphate phosphorylate GST-PHO2 in vitro, and CDC28 binds PHO2 in two-hybrid assays (10884387)
S911-T912 のリン酸化は大部分重複する Ptk1 と Ptk2 が担う。: Phosphorylation of S911-T912 is mediated by the largely redundant Ptk1 and Ptk2. In cells grown on glucose, Ptk1 and Ptk2 prevent autoinhibition by the R domain of Pma1 (38227612). In ptk1Δ alone, both glucose-induced acidification and S911-T912 phosphorylation are normal
SAC1 と MBR1 の同時欠失は合成致死（9267436）: Simultaneous deletion of SAC1 and MBR1 is synthetically lethal (9267436)
SAGA が Ada3 の K8・K14・K182 をアセチル化し、Rpd3 が: SAGA acetylates K8, K14 and K182 of Ada3, and Rpd3 deacetylates them. The bromodomains of Gcn5 and Spt7 bind acetylated Ada3, SAGA dimerizes, and nucleosome acetylation and transcription proceed (35301489)
SAGA の核モジュールの八量体様の折りたたみは Taf6-Taf9・Taf10: The octamer-like fold of the SAGA core module consists of the Taf6-Taf9, Taf10-Spt7 and Taf12-Ada1 dimers plus Spt3 (cryo-EM) (31969703)
SAH1 の発現を下げると PC の新規合成が減り TG が増え、INO1 の発: Lowering SAH1 expression reduces de novo PC synthesis, increases TG, and greatly alters INO1 expression and Opi1 localization (18591246)
SAM の第 2 段階は Tom5 と Tom40 前駆体の会合。Tom40 の: The second step of SAM is association of Tom5 with the Tom40 precursor. Tom40 assembly begins on SAM with its association with Tom5 (20668160)
SAM2 と SAM1 が abd1 の温度感受性の多コピー抑圧遺伝子として取れ: SAM2 and SAM1 were isolated as multicopy suppressors of the temperature sensitivity of abd1, suggesting that Abd1 function varies with the concentration of its substrate AdoMet (10924457)
SAP は SIT4 とともに正に働き、4 つの SAP をすべて欠くと SIT: The SAPs act positively together with SIT4, and deleting all four SAPs is equivalent to loss of SIT4. Binding of SAP4 to SIT4 has not been demonstrated (8649382)
SAP155・SAP185・SAP190 はそれぞれ別の複合体で SIT4 と物: SAP155, SAP185 and SAP190 associate physically with SIT4 in separate complexes and act positively together with SIT4 (8649382)
SAP155・SAP185・SAP190 はそれぞれ別の複合体で SIT4 と結: SAP155, SAP185 and SAP190 bind SIT4 in separate complexes and act positively with SIT4 (8649382)
SAP185 は K+ 排出の正の調節因子で SIT4 に依存。Sap155・S: SAP185 is a positive regulator of K+ efflux and depends on SIT4. Sap155 and Sap185 control Nha1 function through Sit4 (15947196)
SAW1 を欠くと SSA 中間体への Rad1 の結合が失われる（184719: Loss of SAW1 abolishes binding of Rad1 to SSA intermediates (18471978). Msh2-Msh3 and Saw1 recruit Rad1-Rad10 for removal of 3′ nonhomologous tails (29660012)
SBF は YHP1・YOX1 などの転写因子のプロモーターに結合し、別の方法で: SBF binds the promoters of transcription factor genes such as YHP1 and YOX1, and these targets were confirmed by another method (12464632). SBF activates gene expression at the G1/S transition (11533240)
SCF(Dia2) は Sir4 を試験管内・体内でユビキチン化する。dia2: SCF(Dia2) ubiquitinates Sir4 in vitro and in vivo. Deletion of dia2 increases Sir4 at HMR and reduces silencing at telomeres and HMR (22844255)
SCF-Cdc4 と SCF-Grr1 は重複して Cln3 を分解に導く。Cd: SCF-Cdc4 and SCF-Grr1 redundantly target Cln3 for degradation. Cdc4 and Grr1 bind all three G1 cyclins in extracts, but only nuclear Cln3 is redundantly targeted in vivo
SCF-Cdc4 と SCF-Grr1 は重複して Cln3 を分解に導く。Gr: SCF-Cdc4 and SCF-Grr1 redundantly target Cln3 for degradation. Grr1 alone also targets cytoplasmic Cln2
SCF-Cdc4 と Ubp3 は Ste7 のユビキチン化に逆向きに働き、Ub: SCF-Cdc4 and Ubp3 act in opposite directions on Ste7 ubiquitination, and Ubp3 suppresses Kss1 activation to maintain signaling specificity (23645675)
SCF-Cdc4 と脱ユビキチン化酵素 Ubp3 は Ste7 のユビキチン化を: SCF-Cdc4 and the deubiquitinating enzyme Ubp3 regulate Ste7 ubiquitination in opposite directions. Ubp3 is required to suppress Kss1 activation, Fus3 directly phosphorylates Ubp3, and this phosphorylation is required to suppress Kss1 activation (23645675). Confidence is medium since there is only one paper. BioGRID 16319894 is a comprehensive protein chip analysis
SCF-Cdc4 は Cdc34 とともに Gcn4 の分解に必要で、Gcn4: SCF-Cdc4, together with Cdc34, is required for degradation of Gcn4, and ubiquitination and degradation of Gcn4 are suppressed upon amino acid starvation. Degradation requires phosphorylation of Gcn4 by Pho85 (10712509). BioGRID 16338374 is a review of methods for finding SCF substrates, and Gcn4 does not appear in its abstract
SCF-Cdc4 は E2 の Cdc34 とともに G タンパク質の段階で働き: SCF-Cdc4, together with the E2 Cdc34, acts at the G-protein step, promoting degradation of Gpa1 and ubiquitinating it (20542006)
SCF-Cdc4 は Ste7 を直接ユビキチン化し、Fus3 の正しい活性化に: SCF-Cdc4 directly ubiquitinates Ste7 and is required for proper activation of Fus3 (23645675)
SCF-Cdc4 はリン酸化に依存して Ash1 をユビキチン化し分解させる。S: SCF-Cdc4 ubiquitinates Ash1 in a phosphorylation-dependent manner and leads to its degradation. When SCF-Cdc4 is made nonfunctional Ash1 is stabilized, and degradation of Ash1 allows mating-type switching in mother cells (21098119)
SCF-Grr1 はグルコースを除いたときに Pfk27 と Tye7 を標的に: SCF-Grr1 targets Pfk27 and Tye7 upon glucose removal (a screen for ubiquitin ligase substrates), and non-phosphorylatable Pfk27 is stable (17828247)
SCF-Grr1 targets Pfk27 and Tye7 upon glucose removal. Pfk27 is phosphorylated by Snf1, and non-phosphorylatable Pfk27 is stable and impairs growth in the absence of glucose (17828247)
SCF-Grr1 は細胞質分裂のときに PCH タンパク質 Hof1 を分解する: SCF-Grr1 degrades the PCH protein Hof1 during cytokinesis. Hof1 is degraded in late mitosis and is unstable throughout G1, and this degradation requires SCF-Grr1 rather than APC-Cdh1 (15775961)
SCH9 欠損やラパマイシンで CYS3・CYS4 の発現が下がる。CYS4 の: Expression of CYS3 and CYS4 is reduced by loss of SCH9 or by rapamycin. Overexpression of CYS4 restores H2S production (31582588)
SCOCO に似た Slo1p は試験管内で Arl1p ではなく Arl3p: Slo1p, which resembles SCOCO, binds Arl3p but not Arl1p in vitro (12620189)
SCT1 過剰発現の増殖欠陥を使って、Sct1 のリン酸化状態と量を左右する調節: Using the growth defect of SCT1 overexpression, Cst26/Psi1 was identified as a regulator that affects the phosphorylation state and level of Sct1 (22323296)
SDHB を欠く株では SDH 活性がなくコハク酸が大量にたまり、αKG 依存の: Strains lacking SDHB have no SDH activity and accumulate large amounts of succinate, which inhibits the αKG-dependent enzymes Jlp1 and Jhd1 (17884808)
SDHB を欠く株ではコハク酸がたまり、αKG 依存のヒストン脱メチル化酵素 J: Strains lacking SDHB accumulate succinate, which inhibits the αKG-dependent histone demethylase Jhd1 (17884808)
SDP1 の転写はいくつかのストレスで Msn2/4 に依存して誘導される（Rl: SDP1 transcription is induced by several stresses in an Msn2/4-dependent manner (independently of Rlm1) (11923319)
SDS23/SDS24 の過剰発現でカフェイン耐性。エピスタシスから Rts3: Overexpression of SDS23/SDS24 confers caffeine resistance. Epistasis supports a model in which Rts3 and Sds23/24 negatively regulate Sit4 in parallel (21360731)
SEACAT（Seh1・Sea2-4・Sec13）が SEACIT の GAP: Genetic ordering showed that SEACAT (Seh1, Sea2-4, Sec13) counteracts the GAP function of SEACIT (23974112)
Genetic ordering showed that SEACAT (Seh1, Sea2-4, Sec13) counteracts the GAP function of SEACIT (23974112). Within SEACAT, loss of Sea2 strongly impairs amino acid signaling to TORC1 (41680390)
SEC10 の変異は Sec6-Sec8-Sec15 複合体の一体性を壊し、Se: SEC10 mutations disrupt the integrity of the Sec6-Sec8-Sec15 complex, and Sec10p is a component of this complex (the exocyst) (8978675)
SER1 の転写は GCN4 による一般制御を受け、GCN4 が SER1 プロ: SER1 transcription is subject to general control by GCN4, and GCN4 binds the SER1 promoter (7553933)
SESA（Smy2・Eap1・Scp160・Asc1）が POM34 mRNA: SESA (Smy2, Eap1, Scp160, Asc1) specifically represses translation initiation of POM34 mRNA (19571182)
SET1 mRNA と Set1・Swd1・Spp1・Shg1 を含む SET1: SET1 mRNA and SET1RC containing Set1, Swd1, Spp1 and Shg1 were identified (19713935)
SET1 を欠くと H3 K4 のメチル化が体内で完全に失われ、Set1 による: Loss of SET1 completely abolishes H3 K4 methylation in vivo, and H3 K4 methylation by Set1 is required for repression (silencing) of Pol II transcription within the rDNA. H3 K4 mutants grow slowly, like set1Δ (11751634). Set1 mutants unable to trimethylate show silencing defects at telomeres, rDNA, HML and HMR (15964832)
SFA1 などは Hog1-Sko1 の標的で、浸透圧ストレスでの制御は HOG: SFA1 and others are targets of Hog1-Sko1, and their regulation under osmotic stress depends on the HOG pathway (11401713)
SFL1 破壊の凝集株で過剰に作られるタンパク質 FSP の遺伝子を取り、DDR: The gene for FSP, a protein overproduced in a flocculent SFL1-disrupted strain, was cloned and found to be identical to DDR48 (8089083)
SGA1 の転写産物は IME1・IME2 で正に、RME1 と栄養で負に制御さ: The SGA1 transcript is positively regulated by IME1 and IME2 and negatively by RME1 and nutrients. The NRE confers IME2-dependent meiosis-specific expression (2038303)
SGA1 の酵素活性と転写産物は栄養と RME1 で負に、IME1・IME2 で: Enzyme activity and transcript level of SGA1 are negatively regulated by nutrients and RME1 and positively by IME1 and IME2 (2038303)
SH3 ドメインをもつ Nbp2 は Ptc1 を Pbs2-Hog1 複合体へ: The SH3-domain protein Nbp2 recruits Ptc1 to the Pbs2-Hog1 complex and negatively regulates Hog1. Like Ptc1, it is required for Hog1 inactivation during adaptation, and in nbp2-deficient cells the Ptc1-Pbs2 complex does not form (14685261)
SIP18 の浸透圧誘導は PBS2・HOG1 に依存する（8801420）: Osmotic induction of SIP18 depends on PBS2 and HOG1 (8801420)
SIP18 は浸透圧ストレスで誘導され、その誘導は ALD2 と同じく PBS2: SIP18 is induced by osmotic stress, and, as for ALD2, this induction depends on the PBS2 and HOG1 kinases (8801420)
SIT4 の過剰発現などで CAPP を活性化すると Tlg1・Tlg2 が脱リ: When CAPP is activated, for example by SIT4 overexpression, Tlg1 and Tlg2 are dephosphorylated and incorporated into SNARE complexes, restoring endocytosis. Recovery also occurs with the PKA site mutant S90A of Tlg2 (12006655)
SKN1 は kre6 欠失を量依存的に抑え、skn1 kre6 二重欠失では: SKN1 suppresses the kre6 deletion in a dosage-dependent manner, and in the skn1 kre6 double deletion β-1,6-glucan and growth are greatly reduced (8321211)
SKN7 の過剰発現で CDRE からの転写が上がり、skn7 変異では Ca2: Overexpression of SKN7 increases transcription from the CDRE, and in skn7 mutants Ca2+-induced activation of calcineurin/Crz1-dependent genes is reduced. In skn7 mutants, degradation of Crz1 is accelerated. Skn7 binds Crz1 and calcineurin in vitro (11432834)
SLN1・YPD1 を欠くと Skn7 による転写が下がり、それには Skn7: Loss of SLN1 or YPD1 reduces Skn7-dependent transcription, which requires the receiver site D427 of Skn7 (PMID 9790591). The phosphate from Sln1 is passed through Ypd1 to an aspartate of Skn7 (PMID 12455952)
SLX1 と SLX4 はヘテロ複合体の構造特異的エンドヌクレアーゼ。Slx1: SLX1 and SLX4 form a heterocomplex structure-specific endonuclease. Slx1 activity is increased 500-fold by Slx4 (12832395)
SLY41 は PMR1 と負の遺伝的相互作用。Sly41 の過剰発現で細胞質: SLY41 shows a negative genetic interaction with PMR1. Overexpression of Sly41 raises cytosolic Ca and suppresses defects in tethering of COPII vesicles (27030673)
SMF3 の鉄による調節はプロモーター（Aft1 の結合部位を含む）を介し、af: Iron regulation of SMF3 acts through the promoter (which contains an Aft1 binding site) and is greatly reduced in the aft1 aft2 double mutant (there is also an Aft-independent pathway) (11829747)
SMP1 の過剰発現は STL1 などの浸透圧応答遺伝子を Hog1 に依存して: Overexpression of SMP1 induces osmotic response genes such as STL1 in a Hog1-dependent manner, and in smp1Δ their expression is absent (12482976)
SNF1 三量体コアの構造で Sip2 のグリコーゲン結合ドメインが Snf4: In the structure of the SNF1 heterotrimeric core, the glycogen-binding domain of Sip2 interacts with Snf4 (17851534)
SNF11 は試験管内で SNF2 と結合し、酵母細胞から SNF-SWI 複合: SNF11 binds SNF2 in vitro and co-purifies with the SNF-SWI complex from yeast cells (7623818)
SNO-CoA 還元酵素 Adh6 がアセトアセチル CoA チオラーゼを阻害的: The SNO-CoA reductase Adh6 protects acetoacetyl-CoA thiolase from inhibitory S-nitrosylation, affecting sterol synthesis (25512491)
SO2 ストレスで Com2 が活性化遺伝子の発現を制御し、ORT1 は SO2: Under SO2 stress, Com2 controls expression of the activated genes, and ORT1 is one Com2 target that contributes to SO2 tolerance (31799324)
SO2 ストレスで Com2 の標的のうち SO2 耐性に寄与する 50 遺伝子: Among the Com2 targets under SO2 stress, LYS21 is one of the 50 genes contributing to SO2 tolerance (31799324)
SOD1 は酸素とグルコースの信号を伝えて呼吸を抑える。その仕組みは Yck1・: SOD1 transmits oxygen and glucose signals to repress respiration. The mechanism is stabilization of Yck1 and Yck2 (CK1γ): SOD1 binds the C-terminal degron of Yck1/Yck2 and stabilizes the kinases through its catalysis converting superoxide to hydrogen peroxide (23332757)
SOR2（YIL092W）欠失でアシル鎖が短くなり Acc1 活性が下がると考え: Deletion of SOR2 (YIL092W) shortens acyl chains, which is thought to reflect reduced Acc1 activity. Snf1 activation is unchanged (28076367)
SOR3（YJR039W）の欠失で脂肪酸の鎖長が短くなり、Acc1p が下がって: Deletion of SOR3 (YJR039W) shortens fatty acid chain length, which is thought to reflect reduced Acc1p (28076367)
SPB の挿入に失敗すると SESA（Smy2・Eap1・Scp160・Asc1: When SPB insertion fails, SESA (Smy2, Eap1, Scp160, Asc1) specifically represses translation initiation of POM34 mRNA, and the reduction of Pom34 restores viability of SPB duplication mutants (19571182)
SPB の部品の変異で Trm1-II-GFP が核膜内膜に均一に分布せず、移行: In mutants of SPB components, Trm1-II-GFP is not uniformly distributed on the inner nuclear membrane, showing that its translocation and retention depend on the SPB. Main text: inactivating Spc110 and others disturbs the localization (25482124)
SPB 複製だけに欠陥のある mps1-8 の多コピー抑圧因子として SPC42: SPC42 was obtained as a multicopy suppressor of mps1-8, which is defective only in SPB duplication. Mps1 co-precipitates with Spc42, phosphorylates Spc42 in vitro, and Spc42 phosphorylation in vivo depends on Mps1. In mps1-1, Spc42 assembly is abnormal, and Mps1 controls Spc42 assembly during SPB duplication (11827982). Confidence is medium since there is no direct verification by phosphosite mutation
SPOUT メチル基転移酵素 Upa1 は Cse4-R37 のメチル化に寄与し: The SPOUT methyltransferase Upa1 contributes to methylation of Cse4-R37, and overexpression of UPA1 causes chromosome instability (37436802)
SPS 経路の Stp1 は MAE1・OAC1 のプロモーターに直接結合して発: Stp1 of the SPS pathway binds directly to the MAE1 and OAC1 promoters and controls their expression (25825491)
SPS 経路の正の調節因子 Yck1・Yck2 は Ptr3 の過剰なリン酸化に: Yck1 and Yck2, positive regulators of the SPS pathway, are required for hyperphosphorylation of Ptr3, and hyperphosphorylation of Ptr3 correlates with activation of the SPS pathway. CKI and PP2A act in opposite directions (17984223)
SPS1/SPO77 の経路は Ssp1 の適切なリン酸化と安定性（前胞子膜が閉: The SPS1/SPO77 pathway is required for proper phosphorylation and stability of Ssp1 (its removal and degradation at closure of the prospore membrane) (27182947)
SPS4 の胞子形成特異的な発現は IME2 の変異で遅れる。UME6 変異では: Sporulation-specific expression of SPS4 is delayed in IME2 mutants. In UME6 mutants, expression during vegetative growth does not occur (7791799)
SRB4 の 1 アミノ酸変異が med6 温度感受性の転写欠損を抑圧し、Med: A single amino acid change in SRB4 suppresses the transcriptional defect of a med6 temperature-sensitive mutant, and Med6 and Srb4 belong to the same subcomplex of Mediator (9710620)
SRB6 は srb4 温度感受性変異の優性サプレッサーとして得られ、その産物は: SRB6 was obtained as a dominant suppressor of an srb4 temperature-sensitive mutation, and its product binds Srb4 physically (9671455)
SRP のコアタンパク質（Srp21 など）の核小体への取り込みに Pse1 と: Pse1 and Kap123 are required for nucleolar import of SRP core proteins such as Srp21 (11352936)
SRP 受容体の beta サブユニット Srp102p は Srp101p と: Srp102p, the beta subunit of the SRP receptor, binds Srp101p, and loss of the binding abolishes its function (9679135)
SSD1 の欠失で Ssd1 が結合する SRL1 mRNA の非対称な局在が強: Deletion of SSD1 strongly impairs the asymmetric localization of SRL1 mRNA, which Ssd1 binds. Phosphomimetic Ssd1 drives polarized localization of SRL1 mRNA, whereas the non-phosphorylatable form localizes it constitutively to P bodies (21339329)
SSD1-V の Ssd1（ssd1-d でない）は CLN2 mRNA の一部: Ssd1 of SSD1-V (not ssd1-d) partly stabilizes CLN2 mRNA and helps maintain CLN2 transcription after heat shock. Both depend on the 5′ UTR of CLN2 mRNA, and Ssd1 binds this region (20977549)
SSF1・SSF2 の単独欠失は表現型がないが、両方の欠失は致死（7748491: Single deletions of SSF1 and SSF2 have no phenotype, but deletion of both is lethal (7748491). They are redundant essential genes whose overexpression increases mating efficiency of ste4 mutants (9611192)
SSK1 の受容ドメインが SSK2 の N 末端に結合して潜在的なキナーゼ活性: The receiver domain of SSK1 binds the N-terminus of SSK2 and unleashes its latent kinase activity, causing autophosphorylation of SSK2
SSK2/SSK22 は SLN1・YPD1・SSK1 の二成分系で活性化される: SSK2/SSK22 are activated by the SLN1-YPD1-SSK1 two-component system (the details of activation by binding are shown for SSK2)
SSU プロセソームでの Mpp10p–Imp4p の結合を逆ツーハイブリッドで: The Mpp10p-Imp4p interaction in the SSU processome was examined by reverse two-hybrid. imp4 mutants with weakened binding are defective in pre-rRNA processing (14990745)
STB5 の過剰発現で、グルコース制限のとき Stb5 の標的とされる GND1: Overexpression of STB5 coordinately induced GND1/2, TAL1, ALD6 and YEF1, considered Stb5 targets, under glucose limitation (30924859). Med3 acts with Stb5 to control expression of gnd1 and ald6 under high osmolarity (39082808)
STB5 欠損株のトランスクリプトームで PP 経路の多くの遺伝子は変わるが Z: In the transcriptome of an STB5-deficient strain many genes of the PP pathway change, but Zwf1 is not among them (30107458) (PMID: 30107458)
STL1 プロモーターの Hog1 応答要素は Hot1 の直接の標的で、hot: The Hog1 response element of the STL1 promoter is a direct target of Hot1, and STL1 was the only gene whose expression was abolished in hot1Δ (25904326). Under high osmotic stress, the Hot1 target STL1 is activated with cell-to-cell variability (24817120)
STU1 は β チューブリン変異 tub2-406 の抑圧遺伝子。TUB1・T: STU1 is a suppressor of the β-tubulin mutation tub2-406. Genetic interactions with TUB1 and TUB2 mutations suggest that Stu1 interacts with microtubules (7806575)
STUbL の Slx5-Slx8 は MATα2 の分解を担う主なリガーゼで、: The STUbL Slx5-Slx8 is the main ligase for degradation of MATα2 and binds α2 directly and ubiquitinates it without SUMO (20388728). Slx5/Slx8 directly ubiquitinates a C-terminal fragment of α2, and mutation of the degradation sequence impairs this ubiquitination. α2 is also ubiquitinated by the Doa10 (Ubc6, Ubc7) pathway (26246605)
SUT1 の発現は自己制御され、Ste12 に抑えられる（23223039）: Expression of SUT1 is autoregulated and is repressed by Ste12 (23223039)
SWI/SNF と RSC に含まれる Arp7 と Arp9 は機能単位として: Arp7 and Arp9, contained in SWI/SNF and RSC, form a stable heterodimer as a functional unit (12805231)
SWI1・SWI2(SNF2)・SWI3 は HO と INO1 の転写に必要。: SWI1, SWI2(SNF2) and SWI3 are required for transcription of HO and INO1, and also of ADH1, ADH2, SUC2, GAL1 and others (1339306)
SWI1・SWI2(SNF2)・SWI3・SNF5・SNF6 の産物が約 2 M: The products of SWI1, SWI2(SNF2), SWI3, SNF5 and SNF6 form a single complex of about 2 MDa (8159677)
SWI5 は HO の発現に要る亜鉛フィンガータンパク質で、Pho2（Grf10: SWI5 is a zinc-finger protein required for HO expression and binds the HO promoter cooperatively with Pho2 (Grf10) (7902583). Nuclear translocation of Swi5 at the end of anaphase recruits Swi/Snf (10319811)
SWR1 のサブユニット Bdf1 は SWR1 のクロマチンへの結合を促し、Y: The SWR1 subunit Bdf1 promotes binding of SWR1 to chromatin, and Yaf9 slows its dissociation. They contribute to targeting to the +1 nucleosome and to histone exchange (40768570)
SYH1 の高発現が ebp2 変異の増殖とリボソーム形成の欠陥を一部抑圧し、s: High expression of SYH1 partly suppresses the growth and ribosome biogenesis defects of ebp2 mutants, and syh1Δ shows a synthetic growth defect with ebp2 (25849478)
Sac1 による PI4P の代謝には Osh タンパク質が要り、Osh による: Osh proteins are required for Sac1-mediated PI4P metabolism, and stimulation of Sac1 activity by Osh was reconstituted in vitro. Osh3 activates Sac1 at ER-plasma membrane contact sites (21295699)
Sac3-Thp1-Sem1 の結晶構造と、構造に基づく変異で Thp1-Sac: The crystal structure of Sac3-Thp1-Sem1 and structure-based mutations show that Thp1-Sac3 binding is essential for mRNA binding and for mRNP formation and nuclear export (22343721)
Sad1 は Brr2 による tri-snRNP の ATP 依存の解離に拮抗: Sad1 antagonizes ATP-dependent disassembly of the tri-snRNP by Brr2 and preserves the tri-snRNP (24190974)
Sae2 によるチェックポイント信号の減弱は Mec1 と Tel1 に依存した: Attenuation of checkpoint signaling by Sae2 requires Mec1- and Tel1-dependent phosphorylation of Sae2 (31552432)
Sae2 は Tel1-Rad53 のチェックポイントを弱め、Mre11 のヌク: Sae2 attenuates the Tel1-Rad53 checkpoint and prevents recruitment of Rad9 to DSBs independently of the Mre11 nuclease. Sae2 competes with other Tel1 substrates and reduces binding of Rad9 to chromatin and to Rad53 (30510002)
Sae2 は減数分裂で Mec1・Tel1 にリン酸化され、その部位を Ala: Sae2 is phosphorylated by Mec1 and Tel1 in meiosis, and replacing those sites with Ala impairs the initiation and efficiency of DSB end resection (18670132). Attenuation of the checkpoint by Sae2 requires Mec1/Tel1-dependent phosphorylation, which indirectly promotes resection by the Dna2-Sgs1 and Exo1 pathways (31552432)
Saf1p は転写後の段階で Aah1p の分解を促す。この制御はプロテアソーム: Saf1p promotes degradation of Aah1p at a post-transcriptional step. This control is lost in proteasome or SCF mutants (16677311)
Sam35 を不安定にすると Sam50 の基質結合が妨げられる。Sam37 は: Destabilizing Sam35 prevents substrate binding by Sam50. Sam37 assists substrate release at a later step (17978093)
Sam37 は Tom22 の受容体ドメインと結合し TOM と SAM をつな: Sam37 binds the receptor domain of Tom22 and links TOM and SAM (26416958)
Sam5（Pet8）はミトコンドリアの SAM 輸送体で、欠失株はビオチン要求性: Sam5 (Pet8) is the mitochondrial SAM transporter, and its deletion strain becomes biotin-auxotrophic (biotin is made by Bio2, which requires SAM in mitochondria) (14609944)
Sba1 は Hsp90 に結合し、Hsp90 の ATPase と阻害剤の結合: Sba1 binds Hsp90 and protects it from Hsp90 inhibitors by interfering with the Hsp90 ATPase and inhibitor binding (18362168)
Sbh1 は Rtn1 だけでなく Rtn2・Yop1 を含む複合体にも見つかる: Sbh1 is found not only with Rtn1 but also in complexes containing Rtn2 and Yop1 (19857245)
Sbp1 は Hmt1 に依存してアルギニンがメチル化され、メチル化はグルコース: Sbp1 is arginine-methylated in an Hmt1-dependent manner, and the methylation is enhanced upon glucose removal. A methylation-deficient mutant (AMD) causes less growth inhibition upon overexpression and is defective in granule localization and granule formation. Binding of Sbp1 to eIF4G1 is weakened in the AMD mutant and also in the absence of Hmt1. The AMD mutant cannot complement the decapping defect (31495062)
Scc1 の C 末端ドメインは Smc1 の頭部への ATP 結合を促して S: The C-terminal domain of Scc1 promotes ATP binding to the Smc1 head and increases the ATPase activity of Smc1/Smc3 (17055978)
Scc2p は新しいタンパク質 Scc4p と複合体を作り、どちらも姉妹染色分体: Scc2p forms a complex with the novel protein Scc4p, and both are required for sister chromatid cohesion (10882066)
Scc3 の I358 から SCD までの領域が Mcd1 との結合、コヒーシ: The region of Scc3 from I358 to the SCD is required for binding to Mcd1, for localization of cohesin to chromosomes, and for cohesion (25748820)
Scc3・Pds5・Rad61 は複合体をつくって姉妹 DNA の取り込みを妨げ: Scc3, Pds5 and Rad61 form a complex that prevents entrapment of sister DNA, and Eco1 relieves this block and promotes entrapment (19328069)
Scd6 は RGG ドメインに依存して eIF4F の eIF4G に結合し、: Scd6 binds eIF4G of eIF4F in an RGG domain-dependent manner and represses translation by forming translationally stalled mRNPs (22284680). Arginine methylation by Hmt1 strengthens binding to eIF4G1 and enhances the repressive function of Scd6. A methylation-deficient mutant cannot repress growth upon overexpression or form stress granules (27613419)
Scd6 は RGG モチーフでアルギニンがメチル化され Hmt1 が主に担う。: Scd6 is arginine-methylated at its RGG motif, mainly by Hmt1. The methylation enhances the translational repression activity of Scd6 by promoting binding to eIF4G1. A methylation-deficient mutant cannot form stress granules and binds eIF4G1 poorly, and Scd6-eIF4G1 binding is also weak in cells lacking Hmt1 (27613419). Upon glucose starvation and other conditions Scd6 accumulates in P bodies, which is prevented by hmt1 deletion or methylation-deficient mutation. Methylation by Hmt1 is required for Scd6 localization and function (it also suggests that methylation may act negatively for Dhh1-related phenotypes) (27776129)
Sch9 が Rim15 を直接リン酸化して抑える。Rim15 の核内蓄積は T: Sch9 directly phosphorylates and inhibits Rim15. Nuclear accumulation of Rim15 is negatively regulated by TOR and Sch9 (14690612)
Sch9 と CK2 は栄養ストレスの下で協同して H3pT11 を調節し、H3: Sch9 and CK2 cooperatively regulate H3pT11 under nutrient stress, and loss of H3pT11 extends chronological lifespan (29938647). Main text: on YPglycerol, the increase of H3pT11 is strongly impaired in sch9Δ (but not in ras2Δ or tor1Δ)
Sch9 に依存した Stu2 の核外輸送シグナル近くのリン酸化は、分裂期に入る: Sch9-dependent phosphorylation near the nuclear export signal of Stu2 prevents nuclear accumulation of Stu2 before mitotic entry (28972103)
Sch9 の C 末端 6 残基を TORC1 が直接リン酸化し、そのリン酸化が: TORC1 directly phosphorylates the C-terminal six residues of Sch9, and this phosphorylation is required for Sch9 activity
Sch9 は PI(3,5)P2 との直接の結合で液胞に呼び寄せられ、そこで T: Sch9 is recruited to the vacuole by direct binding to PI(3,5)P2, where it is phosphorylated by TORC1 (24478451). PI(3,5)P2 generated by Fab1 on vacuoles and endosomes recruits both TORC1 and Sch9 (36791155)
Sch9 は PKA と重なる部位で Maf1 をリン酸化し、sch9 欠損は: Sch9 phosphorylates Maf1 at sites overlapping those of PKA, and loss of sch9 lowers Pol III transcription in a Maf1-dependent manner (19299514). Sch9 is involved in hyperphosphorylation and cytoplasmic localization of Maf1 (19823048). Since Maf1 is a repressor of Pol III, Sch9 inhibits Maf1
Sch9 は Sko1 が制御する遺伝子の発現に必要で、in vitro で S: Sch9 is required for expression of Sko1-regulated genes and phosphorylates Sko1 in vitro (acting as a transcriptional activator under osmotic stress)
Sch9 は V-ATPase と物理的に結合し、グルコースに応じた組み立て・解: Sch9 binds the V-ATPase physically and influences its glucose-dependent assembly and disassembly, integrating inputs to TORC1 (28604780, abstract). In sch9Δ or upon rapamycin treatment, V-ATPase assembly increases in log phase (28604780, main text)
Sch9 は転写抑制因子 Stb3・Dot6・Tod6 を直接リン酸化して抑え、: Sch9 directly phosphorylates and inhibits the transcriptional repressors Stb3, Dot6 and Tod6, promoting expression of Ribi and RP genes. Dephosphorylated Stb3 and the others recruit RPD3L to repress (21730963)
Sco1 は Cox2 の CuA 部位の銅の付加に関わる。loop 8 の変異: Sco1 is involved in copper delivery to the CuA site of Cox2. A loop 8 mutant binds copper and receives copper from Cox17 normally but is impaired in its function with Cox2 and cannot respire (18390903)
Scp160 の RNA 結合は Gpa1 の活性化で高まり、フェロモンの勾配感: RNA binding by Scp160 is enhanced by Gpa1 activation and is required for pheromone gradient sensing, chemotropism and mating (22832273). Signaling by activated Gpa1 requires direct binding to Scp160 (14536090)
Scp160 は YOR338W などの特定の mRNA と結合し、欠失で YO: Scp160 binds specific mRNAs such as YOR338W, and its deletion alters the level of YOR338W mRNA and its distribution to the membrane fraction (12654998)
Sct1 は C16:0-CoA を脂質に取り込んで Ole1 による不飽和化か: Sct1 incorporates C16:0-CoA into lipids and keeps it away from desaturation by Ole1. Overexpression reduces desaturation (22323296)
Sdh5 は Sdh1 への FAD の共有結合に必要。推定結合面の変異でフラビ: Sdh5 is required for covalent attachment of FAD to Sdh1. Mutations in the putative binding surface abolish flavinylation (23062074)
Sdh6 と Sdh7 が Sdh1/Sdh2 中間体に結合して Sdh2 の成: Sdh6 and Sdh7 bind the Sdh1/Sdh2 intermediate, promote maturation of Sdh2 and protect it from oxidants (24954417)
Sdh6 と Sdh7 は Sdh1/Sdh2 中間体に結合して Sdh2 の成: Sdh6 and Sdh7 bind the Sdh1/Sdh2 intermediate, drive maturation of Sdh2 and protect it from oxidative damage. Loss of SDHAF3 reduces Sdh2 (24954417)
Sdh8 はマトリックスで Sdh1 と特異的に結合し、Sdh2 との会合と S: Sdh8 binds Sdh1 specifically in the matrix and assists its association with Sdh2 and the assembly of SDH (24954416)
Sdo1 があると Efl1 の GTP の Km が半分になり、Sdo1 はヌ: In the presence of Sdo1 the Km of Efl1 for GTP is halved, and Sdo1 acts as a nucleotide exchange factor (23831625)
Sdo1 は前駆 60S からの Tif6 の解離と再利用に必須（1735389: Sdo1 is essential for release and recycling of Tif6 from pre-60S (17353896)
Sds3 は Rpd3-Sin3 複合体の構成要素で、欠失すると Sin3 が: Sds3 is a component of the Rpd3-Sin3 complex, and its deletion releases Sin3 from Rpd3 and nearly abolishes the deacetylase activity of the remaining Rpd3 complex (11024051)
Sec14 ファミリーの Sfh1（YKL091C）は Psd2 による PE: Sfh1 (YKL091C) of the Sec14 family enhances PE synthesis by Psd2. Its overexpression in a psd1-deficient strain restores growth on non-fermentable carbon sources (30958856)
Sec15 は分泌小胞に結合し、GTP 型 Sec4 と特異的に結合する（100: Sec15 binds secretory vesicles and binds specifically to GTP-bound Sec4 (10022848). Polarized localization of Sec15 depends on active Sec4 and its GEF Sec2 (15647373)
Sec18 の ATP 加水分解で LMA1 は Vam3 の複合体に移り、これ: Upon ATP hydrolysis by Sec18, LMA1 is transferred to the Vam3 complex and stabilizes it (9657146)
Sec18 は Sec17 との接触面を介して Sec17 による膜融合を促し、: Sec18 promotes Sec17-driven membrane fusion through its interface with Sec17 and stabilizes Sec17 assemblies on the membrane (36103252)
Sec2 は Sec4 に直接結合し（ヌクレオチドのない Sec4 を好む）、G: Sec2 binds Sec4 directly (preferring nucleotide-free Sec4) and acts as an exchange factor promoting GDP release and GTP binding. In sec2 mutants, vesicles do not accumulate at the bud tip and Sec4 is mislocalized (9199166). The N-terminus of Sec2 is the exchange factor for Sec4, and the C-terminus acts in vesicle transport (10747090)
Sec20 と Tip20 は Ufe1 と共沈し、Ufe1 の変異を Sec2: Sec20 and Tip20 co-precipitate with Ufe1, and a sec20 mutation compensates for a ufe1 mutation (9214619)
Sec22 は Ufe1・Sec20 と共沈し、SEC22 の多コピーが ufe: Sec22 co-precipitates with Ufe1 and Sec20, and multicopy SEC22 suppresses the temperature-sensitive ufe1 mutation in an allele-specific manner (9214619)
Sec23 のユビキチン化は Rsp5 による。cdc48 温度感受性変異株では: Ubiquitination of Sec23 is by Rsp5. In cdc48 temperature-sensitive mutants, ubiquitinated Sec23 accumulates and Sec23 is stabilized. Cdc48 controls proteasomal degradation of Sec23 (20846524)
