Sec23 の仲間 Nel1 は COPII の成分とは結合しないが、Sar1: Nel1, a Sec23 relative, does not bind COPII components but shows strong GAP activity toward Sar1. Loss of NEL1 in the sar1D32G background greatly reduces growth (24947508). Since a GAP turns Sar1 into the GDP-bound, inactive form, this is inhibition. Consistent with the GO direction (inhibition)
Sec3 の PH ドメインと Sso2 の結晶構造で、Sso2 の N 末端の: The crystal structure of the Sec3 PH domain with Sso2 shows that the two N-terminal NPY motifs of Sso2 bind Sec3 synergistically and promote fusion of secretory vesicles (35979953)
Sec3 は GTP 型 Rho1 と直接結合し、Sec3 の極性のある局在を作: Sec3 binds GTP-bound Rho1 directly, and Rho1 is required to establish and maintain the polarized localization of Sec3 (11283608)
Sec36（COG1）は Sec34（COG3）・Sec35（COG2）と結合し: Sec36 (COG1) binds Sec34 (COG3) and Sec35 (COG2), and mutations in SEC36 disrupt the complex (12006647)
Sec39（Dsl3）は Dsl1 複合体に含まれ、Dsl1 とともに SNAR: Sec39 (Dsl3) is part of the Dsl1 complex and, together with Dsl1, is required for stable binding of the SNARE Use1 to the complex of Tip20, Ufe1 and Sec20 (15958492)
Sec4 と結合できない Sro7 の変異で小胞のつなぎとめの大部分が失われ、遺: Sro7 mutations that abolish Sec4 binding lose most vesicle tethering, and genetically too, binding to Sec4 is important for most of the in vivo function of Sro7 (29668350)
Sec4 のリン酸化は Sec15 を介したエキソシストとの結合を壊して Sec: Phosphorylation of Sec4 negatively regulates its function by disrupting its Sec15-mediated binding to the exocyst. The phosphorylation is a cell cycle-dependent event accompanying cytokinesis, a kinase screen identified Cdc5 as a positive regulator of the phosphorylation, and spatiotemporal colocalization suggests it is a direct substrate (27621363). Confidence is medium because directness is inferred
Sec65 は SRP のサブユニットで、Srp54 が SRP に安定に結合す: Sec65 is a subunit of SRP and is required for stable binding of Srp54 to SRP (1313947)
Sec7 は Arf1 を正のフィードバックで活性化し、自己抑制も受ける（225: Sec7 activates Arf1 through positive feedback and is also autoinhibited (22516198, main text). Sec7-dependent activation of Arf1 recruits Pik1 to the late Golgi/TGN (33788598, main text)
Sec7 は Ypt1・Ypt31/32 の効果分子でもあり、Ypt1 は主に: Sec7 is also an effector of Ypt1 and Ypt31/32, with Ypt1 acting mainly on membrane localization of Sec7 (25220393). Main text: on liposomes Ypt1 recruits Sec7, and in ypt1-3 strains Sec7 disperses into the cytoplasm
Sec9 は試験管内・体内で Kin1/Kin2 の基質と確かめられ、Kin1: Sec9 was confirmed as a substrate of Kin1/Kin2 in vitro and in vivo, and in vitro phosphorylation by Kin1 is enhanced by prior phosphorylation at the +2 position (30305396)
Sed5（重鎖）・Gos1・Ykt6（軽鎖）の t-SNARE の対になる v-: Sft1 is the v-SNARE partner for the t-SNARE of Sed5 (heavy chain), Gos1 and Ykt6 (light chains). The complex was confirmed in vivo by immunoprecipitation (11959998)
Seg1 は Pil1 のアイソソームへの効率的な取り込みと正常な細胞膜の溝の形: Seg1 is required for efficient incorporation of Pil1 into eisosomes and for normal formation of plasma membrane furrows (22869600)
Sem1 が Rpn3 と Rpn7 をつかんで lid への順序立った組み込み: Sem1 grips Rpn3 and Rpn7 and mediates their ordered incorporation into the lid (24412063)
Sen1 が無いと、内在の Rnh1 が複製チェックポイント依存的に増え、ハイブ: In the absence of Sen1, endogenous Rnh1 increases in a replication checkpoint-dependent manner and binds chromatin at sites where hybrids accumulate (41236927)
Ser2 CTD キナーゼ Ctk1・Bur1 を欠く細胞では、ヘテロクロマチン: In cells lacking the Ser2 CTD kinases Ctk1 and Bur1, YFR057w within heterochromatin is hardly activated (38615982)
Ser3 は Pib2 にのみ依存してリン酸化され、TORC1 活性の指標として: Ser3 is phosphorylated in a manner dependent only on Pib2 and was used as a readout of TORC1 activity (38127619)
Ser3・Ser33 が α-ケトグルタル酸を D-2HG に還元する主な源で、: Ser3 and Ser33 are the main sources reducing α-ketoglutarate to D-2HG, and Dld3 oxidizes D-2HG to α-ketoglutarate (26774271)
Set1 の N 末と Swd2 は互いに結合し、どちらも CTD への効率的な: The Set1 N-terminus and Swd2 bind each other, and both are required for efficient binding to the CTD (32358498)
Set1 の塩基性・Swd1 の酸性の部分を欠くと両者の結合が壊れ、Set1 の: Loss of the basic region of Set1 or the acidic region of Swd1 disrupts their binding, reduces Set1 levels, and abolishes H3K4 methylation (22147691)
Set1 は D-box をもち APC/C(Cdh1) に分解される。Cla4: Set1 has a D-box and is degraded by APC/C(Cdh1). Cla4 phosphorylates S228 within the D-box to suppress degradation and maintain H3K4me3 levels (37774018)
Set1 は Nrd1 の適切な呼び込みに重要。SET1 欠失は nrd1 変異: Set1 is important for proper recruitment of Nrd1. SET1 deletion exacerbates the termination defect of nrd1 mutants (21709022)
Set2 による H3K36 メチル化が Ioc4 の PWWP ドメインを通じ: H3K36 methylation by Set2 recruits Isw1b to ORFs via the PWWP domain of Ioc4 (in vivo and in vitro) (22922743)
Set2 は H3 の K36 に特異的なメチル化酵素で、体内の K36 のメチ: Set2 is a methyltransferase specific for K36 of H3 and is responsible for K36 methylation in vivo. Tethering it to a promoter represses transcription (11839797). H3K36 methylation is required for Rpd3S activation; without Set2 or H3K36, acetylated histones accumulate in ORFs and transcription initiates from cryptic promoters. K36 methylation also suppresses histone exchange (22914091)
Set3 が Snt1・YIL112w・Sif2・Cpr1・Hos2・Hst1: Set3 forms a single complex, Set3C, with Snt1, YIL112w, Sif2, Cpr1, Hos2, and Hst1 (11711434)
Set3 は Snt1・YIL112w・Sif2・Cpr1・Hos2・Hst1: Set3 forms one complex, Set3C, with Snt1, YIL112w, Sif2, Cpr1, Hos2, and Hst1 (11711434)
Set3 forms a single complex, Set3C, with Snt1, YIL112w, Sif2, Cpr1, Hos2, and Hst1 (11711434)
Set5 は初めて見つかった H4 のメチル化酵素で、H4 の K5・K8・K1: Set5 is the first H4 methyltransferase identified and monomethylates H4 K5, K8, and K12. In set5Δ yeast, H4K5me1 and H4K8me1 specifically decrease, and mass spectrometry also shows a large reduction of monomethyl H4 (22343720). Set5 is involved in stress response and genome stability, and its MYND domain is required for repression of subtelomeric genes (31685550)
Sfi1 の C 末端には Cdk1 と Cdc5 のリン酸化部位があり、リン酸: The C-terminus of Sfi1 has phosphorylation sites for Cdk1 and Cdc5, and phosphomimetic mutations block SPB duplication. Cdc14 dephosphorylates C-Sfi1 to prepare it for the next duplication, and Cdc14 is integrated at Sfi1 as a positive signal for SPB duplication (24954044)
Sfi1 の C 末端には Cdk1 と Cdc5 のリン酸化部位がある。リン酸: The C-terminus of Sfi1 has phosphorylation sites for Cdk1 and Cdc5. In phosphomimetic sfi1, cells enter metaphase with a single SPB; Cdk1 and (more weakly) Cdc5 inhibit SPB duplication. Cdc14 dephosphorylates C-Sfi1 to prepare for the next duplication, and Mps1 promotes Sfi1 elongation in G1 (24954044). Because the contribution of Cdc5 is smaller than that of Cdk1, confidence is medium
Sfi1 の Cdk1 部位を非リン酸化型にすると、複製した SPB の分離に欠: Making the Cdk1 sites of Sfi1 non-phosphorylatable causes defects in separation of duplicated SPBs and SPB reduplication during mitosis (25340401). Phosphomimetic sfi1 yields cells with a single SPB in metaphase (24954044). Main text: S801, T816, S855, S882, and S923 are phosphorylated in vitro by the mitotic cyclin Clb2/Cdk1 (25340401)
Sfk1 は以前 PI4 キナーゼ Stt4 の調節に関わるとされたが、lem3: Sfk1 was previously thought to be involved in regulating the PI4 kinase Stt4, but its effect on PS/PE exposure in lem3Δ does not depend on Stt4 (29540528)
Sfp1 は Fhl1 と Ifh1 の核内の局在に影響し、Sfp1 がないと両: Sfp1 affects the nuclear localization of Fhl1 and Ifh1; without Sfp1, both move to the nucleolar region and RP gene transcription decreases (15466158)
Sfp1 は Fhl1・Ifh1 の核局在に影響し、Sfp1 がないと両者が核小: Sfp1 affects the nuclear localization of Fhl1 and Ifh1; without Sfp1, both move toward the nucleolus and RP gene transcription decreases. This is localization control, not transcriptional regulation
Sfp1 は TORC1 と直接結合し、TORC1 によるリン酸化で働きが制御さ: Sfp1 binds TORC1 directly, and its function is regulated by TORC1 phosphorylation. Upon TOR inhibition, Sfp1 leaves RP gene promoters and exits the nucleus (15353587)
Sfp1 はプロテアソームで分解され、その調節された分解に Blm10 が要る。: Sfp1 is degraded by the proteasome, and Blm10 is required for its regulated degradation. In blm10Δ, Sfp1 is stabilized and accumulates in the nucleus under nutrient limitation (21209318)
Sfp1 は核内で RP 遺伝子のプロモーターに結合し発現を促す。RPL3 その: Sfp1 binds RP gene promoters in the nucleus and promotes their expression. RPL3 itself is not named in the summary (the statement concerns RP genes as a whole)
Sgf11 は Ubp8 が SAGA に結合するのと H2B の脱ユビキチン化: Sgf11 is required for Ubp8 binding to SAGA and for H2B deubiquitination (15657441)
Sgf1（Cog4）は sec35-1 の多コピー抑圧因子で、ツーハイブリッドと: Sgf1 (Cog4) is a multicopy suppressor of sec35-1 and, by two-hybrid and co-precipitation, a new subunit of the Sec34/Sec35 complex (11733049)
Sgm1 は Ypt6 によりゴルジに呼び込まれ、保存されたコイルドコイルで Y: Sgm1 is recruited to the Golgi by Ypt6 and binds Ypt6:GTP through a conserved coiled-coil (15128430)
Sgo1 が特定の PP2A を動原体に呼び込み、その不活性化で第一分裂後期に動: Sgo1 recruits a specific PP2A to centromeres, and its inactivation leads to loss of centromeric cohesin at anaphase I. Artificially recruiting PP2A to chromosome arms prevents Rec8 phosphorylation and blocks chiasma resolution (16541024). Sgo1 and PP2A-Rts1 are central to centromeric cohesin protection (CCP) (29644457)
Sgo1 のセリンに富む領域（SRM）はコンデンシンとの結合とセントロメアへの呼: The serine-rich motif (SRM) of Sgo1 is required for binding to condensin and recruitment to centromeres, and SRM phosphorylation disrupts this binding. Mps1 directly phosphorylates the SRM to regulate condensin binding (32810145). Main text: inhibiting Mps1 abolishes Sgo1 phosphorylation, and Mps1 phosphorylates T159 in vitro. The phosphorylation inhibits part of Sgo1's function (condensin retention), which the authors interpret as releasing cargo to receive the next; hence confidence is medium
Sgs1 の N 末端の酸性領域（R1）は Rpa70 と結合し、Mec1 の標: The N-terminal acidic region (R1) of Sgs1 binds Rpa70 and is a Mec1 target. Under HU, Mec1 phosphorylation of R1 makes Sgs1 bind strongly to the FHA1 of Rad53, fully activating Rad53 and recruiting it to stalled forks (22820947). This is Sgs1's role as a checkpoint scaffold, not its helicase activity, so confidence is medium. BioGRID's 24035500 is a TORC2 paper and its summary does not mention phosphorylation of Sgs1 by Mec1
Sgs1 のヘリカーゼの働きは CDK と Cdc5 で細胞周期に合わせて調節さ: Sgs1 helicase activity is regulated with the cell cycle by CDK and Cdc5. In S phase and prophase I, CDK phosphorylation enhances Sgs1 unwinding, and subsequent hyperphosphorylation by Cdc5 appears to lower Sgs1 activity (while activating Mus81-Mms4 and others) (32504558). Because it is stated as "appears to", confidence is medium
Sgs1 はポリ SUMO 鎖に結合し Smc5/6 と結合する。これらが組換え: Sgs1 binds poly-SUMO chains and binds Smc5/6. These support SUMOylation of Sgs1, Top3, and Rmi1 when recombination structures form. Reduced STR SUMOylation leads to accumulation of recombination structures and impaired growth under conditions with many such structures. SUMOylation promotes binding among STR subunits and their assembly at repair sites. Main text: SUMOylation of Top3 and Rmi1 depends mainly on the SUMO ligase activity of Mms21, with a slight contribution from Siz2 (27373152)
Sgt1 と Hsp90 が Skp1 と Ctf13 の結合を促し、CBF3: Sgt1 and Hsp90 promote binding of Skp1 and Ctf13, activating Ctf13 in CBF3 assembly (15340069)
Sgt1 は Cyr1 と物理的に結合し、sgt1 変異で cAMP 経路の活性: Sgt1 physically binds Cyr1, and sgt1 mutations alter cAMP pathway activity. Sgt1 is an activator of adenylate cyclase (12456005). Hsp90-Sgt1 cooperation maintains Cyr1 activity (22461145)
Sgt2 の N 末端領域と Get5 の UBL 領域が直接結合し、TA タン: The N-terminal region of Sgt2 and the UBL region of Get5 bind directly, handing TA proteins to the Get4/Get5 complex. The structure of the complex was determined (23297211)
She1 はダイナクチンと関係なくモータードメインに直接働いてダイニンの微小管上: She1 acts directly on the motor domain, independently of dynactin, to strongly inhibit dynein movement on microtubules. In cells, She1 weakens microtubule-cortex interactions on the mother side, biasing spindle movement toward the bud (23142046)
She2 の T109D 変異で四量体化と She3・Srp1 との相互作用が阻: The She2 T109D mutation impairs tetramerization and interaction with She3 and Srp1 (36921931)
She2 は ASH1 mRNA の芽先端への局在に必要。リン酸化模倣変異で R: She2 is required for localization of ASH1 mRNA to the bud tip. Phosphomimetic mutations disrupt RNA binding and ASH1 mRNA localization (36921931)
She4p は Myo4p・Myo5p のモータードメインに UCS ドメインで: She4p binds the motor domains of Myo4p and Myo5p through its UCS domain and promotes Myo5p binding to actin filaments in vitro (12725728)
Shh4 は Δsdh4 を相補し、Sdh3 は Sdh4 または Shh4 と: Shh4 complements Δsdh4, and Sdh3 forms SDH isozymes with Sdh4 or Shh4 (22573324)
Sho1 の C 末端領域が Ste11 に結合してその活性化を担い、別の領域で: The C-terminal region of Sho1 binds Ste11 and mediates its activation, and another region binds Pbs2
Sho1 は Ste11 と結合する領域と Pbs2 と結合する領域をもち、St: Sho1 has a region that binds Ste11 and a region that binds Pbs2, in a model where it acts as a joint scaffold directing Ste11 to Pbs2 (15200959)
Shq1 と Naf1 は核に局在し、H/ACA snoRNP の中心タンパク質: Shq1 and Naf1 localize to the nucleus and interact with the core H/ACA snoRNP proteins Nhp2 and Cbf5 (12228251)
Shq1 と Naf1 は複合体をつくるが、H/ACA snoRNP とは強く結: Shq1 and Naf1 form a complex but do not bind strongly to H/ACA snoRNPs (12228251)
Shu 複合体の結晶構造で Csm2・Psy3・Shu1・Shu2 が順につなが: In the crystal structure of the Shu complex, Csm2, Psy3, Shu1, and Shu2 connect in sequence to form a V shape. Key residues were validated by pull-down and in vivo (29069504)
Sif2 は Sir4 の N 末端と結合し、sif2 欠失でテロメアの抑制が強: Sif2 binds the N-terminus of Sir4, and sif2 deletion strengthens telomeric silencing. Sif2 antagonizes Sir4 function at telomeres (9651685)
Sin3 の PAH2 ドメインを餌にしたツーハイブリッドで STB1-STB5: A two-hybrid screen using the Sin3 PAH2 domain as bait identified STB1-STB5 and STB6, which resembles STB2 (9393435)
Sin3 の PAH2 領域を餌にしたツーハイブリッドで、Sin3 に結合するタ: A two-hybrid screen using the Sin3 PAH2 region as bait identified STB1-STB5 as Sin3-binding proteins (9393435)
Sin3（PAH2）とのツーハイブリッドで STB1〜STB5 を同定。Stb1: STB1-STB5 were identified by two-hybrid with Sin3 (PAH2). Stb1 and Stb2 are included in Sin3 complexes (9393435)
Sip1・Sip2・Gal83 はそれぞれ別のドメインで Snf1 と Snf4: Sip1, Sip2, and Gal83 each bind Snf1 and Snf4 through separate domains, tethering Snf1-Snf4 into the complex (9121458)
Sip2 のアセチル化は NuA4 と拮抗する Rpd3 脱アセチル化酵素が制御: Sip2 acetylation is controlled by the Rpd3 deacetylase antagonizing NuA4, and it strengthens binding to Snf1 (21906795)
Sip2 のアセチル化は NuA4 アセチル基転移酵素と Rpd3 脱アセチル化: Sip2 acetylation is controlled antagonistically by the NuA4 acetyltransferase and the Rpd3 deacetylase, and it strengthens binding to Snf1. Main text: Sip2 acetylation depends almost completely on NuA4/Esa1 both in vivo and in vitro (21906795)
Sip3 は Snf1 との 2 ハイブリッドで同定され、DNA に結合した S: Sip3 was identified by two-hybrid with Snf1, binds DNA-tethered Snf1, and activates transcription of target genes (8127709)
Sip4 は two-hybrid で Snf1 と結合し、Sip4 による転写: Sip4 binds Snf1 in two-hybrid assays; transcriptional activation by Sip4 is regulated by glucose and depends on Snf1. Sip4 phosphorylation requires Snf1 (8628258). Under glucose limitation, Snf1 rapidly phosphorylates and activates Sip4 via Gal83 (10581241)
Sir1 は Orc1 の BAH 領域と結合して HMR・HML のサイレンシ: Sir1 binds the BAH region of Orc1 to establish HMR and HML silencing. Crystal structure of the OIR-BAH complex (15932939)
Sir2 の PMA1 などの転写抑制は、cAMP-PKA と CK2 による: Sir2-mediated transcriptional repression of PMA1 and others is released by phosphorylation of S473 by cAMP-PKA and CK2
Sir2 は Hsf1 の熱ショック応答に必須で、UPR による Hsf1 の活: Sir2 is essential for the Hsf1 heat shock response and is also required for Hsf1 activation by the UPR. Increasing Sir2 enhances UPR-induced Hsf1 activation (25600811). In sir2Δ, Hsf1 does not respond to heat shock, and increasing Sir2 mimics the heat shock response (25356557)
Sir2 は MATa 細胞で RDT1 のプロモーターに呼び込まれて転写を抑え: Sir2 is recruited to the RDT1 promoter in MATa cells to repress transcription, and is released upon MAT cleavage by HO (31461456)
Sir2 は NAD 依存のヒストン脱アセチル化酵素で H4 の K16 を特異: Sir2 is an NAD-dependent histone deacetylase that specifically deacetylates H4 K16, and this activity underlies silencing. H4 K16 deacetylation is required for Sir3 binding (10693811). Deacetylation of H4 K16 by Sir2 is thought to spread Sir protein binding (17889663). BioGRID's 22654676 is a paper on the Sir4 N-terminus. HHF1 and HHF2 encode the same H4
Sir2 は Sir3・Sir4 と組んで HMLalpha2 などの沈黙したプ: Sir2 works with Sir3 and Sir4 to repress transcription of silenced promoters such as HMLalpha2. It does not prevent Pol II binding but targets the transition to elongation (18391020)
Sir2 は Sir3・Sir4 と組んでサイレンシングをつくり、HMRa1 と: Sir2 works with Sir3 and Sir4 to establish silencing, blocking the transition from initiation to elongation at the HMRa1 and HMLα1/α2 promoters (18391020)
Sir2 はテロメアのヘテロクロマチンで H3 K56 を直接脱アセチル化してク: Sir2 directly deacetylates H3 K56 in telomeric heterochromatin, compacting chromatin and enabling silencing (17889663)
Sir3 の N 末端のアラニンは NatA でアセチル化され、ard1・nat: The N-terminal alanine of Sir3 is acetylated by NatA, and the silencing defects of ard1 and nat1 mutants are explained by the lack of Sir3 acetylation (15454564)
Sir3 は NatA の基質で、ard1・nat1 変異株での Sir3 のア: Sir3 is a NatA substrate, and the lack of Sir3 acetylation in ard1 and nat1 mutants explains their silencing defects (15454564)
Sir4・Esc1・Siz2・Nup170 が互いに物理的・機能的に相互作用し、: Sir4, Esc1, Siz2, and Nup170 interact physically and functionally, forming a complex with some nucleoporins that is distinct from the NPC (28883038)
Sit1 に結合できない Aft1 の Y179F 変異では Sit1 の分解が: In the Aft1 Y179F mutant, which cannot bind Sit1, Sit1 degradation increases and FOB uptake decreases (26323600)
Sit4 は Snf1 T210 の脱リン酸化に関わる（21464305）。グル: Sit4 is involved in dephosphorylation of Snf1 T210 (21464305). When glucose is abundant, Reg1-Glc7 and Sit4 dephosphorylate T210 (24019512). Snf1 is activated by T210 phosphorylation
Siw14/Oca3 の過剰発現が oca1 ほかの欠失株のカフェイン感受性を抑: Overexpression of Siw14/Oca3 suppresses the caffeine sensitivity of oca1 and other deletion strains, suggesting a functional connection (21409566)
Siz1 と Siz2 は Rsp5 のユビキチン化の基質で、ユビキチン化された: Siz1 and Siz2 are substrates for ubiquitination by Rsp5; ubiquitinated Siz1 has lower SUMO ligase activity, altering poly-SUMO chain formation (23443663)
Siz1/Siz2 は Sgo1 を SUMO 化し、SUMO 化は Sgo1: Siz1/Siz2 SUMOylate Sgo1, and SUMOylation weakens Sgo1 binding to PP2A, enabling stable bi-orientation (33929514). Main text: without Siz1/Siz2, Sgo1 is stabilized, CPC removal is insufficient, and bi-orientation becomes unstable
Siz1/Siz2 は動原体周辺の Sgo1 を張力依存の離脱の前に SUMO: Siz1/Siz2 SUMOylate pericentromeric Sgo1 before its tension-dependent release, and Sgo1 SUMOylation weakens its binding to PP2A. This is important for stable bi-orientation (33929514). Main text: a genetic screen identified Siz2 as a negative regulator of Sgo1; Siz2 antagonizes Sgo1 to promote anaphase onset. Without Siz1/Siz2, Sgo1 is stabilized
Sjl2 の皮質への局在には Abp1 が要り、Abp1 は Sjl2 と物理的: Cortical localization of Sjl2 requires Abp1, and Abp1 physically binds Sjl2 (15798181)
Ska1 は SKI 複合体（Ski2-Ski3-Ski8）の一部と結合する新し: Ska1 is a new factor that binds part of the SKI complex (Ski2-Ski3-Ski8). It acts in degradation of mRNAs such as those with long 3'UTRs (31304628)
Skg6 と Tos2 の過剰発現で Hof1 の母娘の首への集まりと隔壁形成が: Overexpression of Skg6 and Tos2 impairs Hof1 accumulation at the mother-bud neck and septum formation. skg6 deletion suppresses the growth defect of hof1 deletion (16816427)
Skg6 と Tos2 の過剰発現で Hof1 の首への集まりが損なわれる（16: Overexpression of Skg6 and Tos2 impairs Hof1 accumulation at the neck (16816427)
Ski2・Ski3・Ski8 は共免疫沈降で複合体を作り、Ski3-Ski8 の: Ski2, Ski3, and Ski8 form a complex by co-immunoprecipitation, and Ski3-Ski8 binding does not require Ski2 (10744028)
Ski7 は Ski8 と Ski3 を介して Ski 複合体と結合する（ツーハ: Ski7 binds the Ski complex via Ski8 and Ski3 (two-hybrid, co-immunoprecipitation) (16043509)
Ski8 が無いと Ski2 は Ski3 と、Ski3 が無いと Ski2 は: Without Ski8, Ski2 does not associate with Ski3; without Ski3, Ski2 does not associate with Ski8 (10744028)
Skn7 の HSF 様 DNA 結合ドメインが OCH1 の上流のシス配列に結: The HSF-like DNA-binding domain of Skn7 binds a cis element upstream of OCH1 (title: Sln1 regulates OCH1 through Skn7) (11854400)
Sko1 の 5 つの標的（SFA1 を含む）は酸化ストレスで誘導され、その誘導: Five Sko1 targets (including SFA1) are induced by oxidative stress, and Yap1 is involved in this induction (11401713)
Sko1 は HOG 経路依存の制御を担う抑制因子で、SFA1 などが Hog1: Sko1 is a repressor mediating HOG pathway-dependent regulation, and SFA1 and others are Hog1-Sko1 targets (11401713)
Sko1 は Hog1 を不活性化するホスファターゼ PTP3 のプロモーターに: Sko1 binds the promoter of PTP3, a phosphatase that inactivates Hog1, and is required for PTP3 induction under osmotic stress (16087739)
Sko1 は MSN2 のプロモーターに結合し、sko1 変異株では浸透圧ストレ: Sko1 binds the MSN2 promoter, and in sko1 mutants induction of MSN2 expression under osmotic stress is weakened (16087739)
Sko1 は Tup1-Cyc8 を標的プロモーターに呼ぶ DNA 結合タンパク: Sko1 is a DNA-binding protein that recruits Tup1-Cyc8 to target promoters. The Sko1-regulated GRE2 and AHP1 are derepressed in tup1 and cyc8 mutants under non-stress conditions (18201562)
Skp1・Cdc53・Cdc4 は SCF-Cdc4 をつくり、Cdc34・E1: Skp1, Cdc53, and Cdc4 form SCF-Cdc4, which acts with Cdc34 and E1 as the ubiquitin ligase for Sic1. Cdc4 selectively binds phosphorylated Sic1 (9346238). Sic1 degradation is required for the G1/S transition and requires Cdc4 and others. In cdc4ts extracts, ubiquitin chains on Sic1 are not formed (9285816)
Sks1 依存のリン酸化を Bud6・Itr1・Lrg1・Npr3・Pda1 に: Sks1-dependent phosphorylation was found on Bud6, Itr1, Lrg1, Npr3, and Pda1, and Pda1 Y309 and S313 are required for pseudohyphal growth (24603354)
Sky1 は Npl3 の 8 つの SR/RS のうち C 末端の 1 つだけ: Sky1 phosphorylates only one, the C-terminal one, of the eight SR/RS dipeptides of Npl3. Changing this RS to RA or lacking SKY1 causes Npl3 to accumulate in the cytoplasm, with increased binding to poly(A)+ RNA and decreased binding to the import receptor Mtr10 (11233987). Sky1 phosphorylation regulates binding between the RGG motif and Mtr10 to determine Npl3 nuclear import, and arginine methylation impedes this phosphorylation (10952997)
Sla2 は Pan1 の Arp2/3 活性化を試験管内で特異的に抑え、pan: Sla2 specifically inhibits Pan1's Arp2/3 activation in vitro, and partial-loss pan1 mutations suppress the temperature sensitivity, endocytosis, and actin defects of sla2ΔCC (17151356)
Sld2 と Dpb11 はリン酸化依存の複合体をつくり、染色体の複製に必須。C: Sld2 and Dpb11 form a phosphorylation-dependent complex essential for chromosome replication. Changing all CDK sites to alanine greatly reduces complex formation and blocks replication. CDK phosphorylation of other sites enables T84 phosphorylation, and phosphorylated T84 mediates Dpb11 binding (16619031)
Sld2 は S 期に S-Cdk 依存でリン酸化され、Cdk 部位をすべて欠く: Sld2 is phosphorylated in S phase in an S-Cdk-dependent manner; mutants lacking all Cdk sites cannot replicate DNA or form a complex with Dpb11 (11807498). Note that 27705801 reports that phosphorylation by CDK and others in mitosis promotes Sld2 degradation, so there is an opposite effect in mitosis
Sld7 は Sld3 の N 末端に結合し、Cdc45 への親和性を下げる。欠: Sld7 binds the N-terminus of Sld3 and lowers its affinity for Cdc45. Its loss reduces Sld3 and delays S phase (21487389)
Slh1/Rqt2・Cue3/Rqt3・Ykr023w/Rqt4 からなる RQ: The RQT complex, composed of Slh1/Rqt2, Cue3/Rqt3, and Ykr023w/Rqt4, was identified. It is required for RQC (28757607)
Sli15 は CDK と Ipl1 にリン酸化され、後期の開始後に活性化した: Sli15 is phosphorylated by CDK and Ipl1; after anaphase onset, activated Cdc14 removes CDK phosphorylation and the CPC moves from kinetochores to the spindle. A pathway in which Fin1-PP1 removes Ipl1 phosphorylation also contributes (37405742). BioGRID's 21658602 and 34502421 are papers on in vitro substrate specificity and do not describe Sli15 function
Slk19 の体内の修飾に Cdc28 と Cdc5 が要り、両者は試験管内でも: In vivo modification of Slk19 requires Cdc28 and Cdc5, and both also phosphorylate it in vitro (18178775)
Slm1 が Ypk1 を細胞膜に呼び TORC2 がリン酸化する。TORC2: Slm1 recruits Ypk1 to the plasma membrane, where TORC2 phosphorylates it. TORC2-dependent T662 phosphorylation activates Ypk1
Slm1 と Slm2 は正常なスフィンゴ脂質の代謝に要り、Isc1 が Slm: Slm1 and Slm2 are required for normal sphingolipid metabolism, and Isc1 was identified as a target negatively regulated by Slm1/2 (16847337)
Slm1 は Ypk1 と物理的に結合し、細胞膜に呼んで TORC2 によるリン: Slm1 physically binds Ypk1 and recruits it to the plasma membrane, enabling phosphorylation by TORC2
Slm1・Slm2 のリン酸化は TORC2 のキナーゼ活性に依存（生体内・試験: Phosphorylation of Slm1 and Slm2 depends on TORC2 kinase activity (in vivo and in vitro). Slm1 and Slm2 regulate the actin cytoskeleton downstream of TORC2
Slm1・Slm2 のリン酸化は生体内・試験管内とも TORC2 のキナーゼ活性: Phosphorylation of Slm1 and Slm2 depends on TORC2 kinase activity both in vivo and in vitro, and Slm1 localization requires TORC2. Slm1 and Slm2 regulate the actin cytoskeleton downstream of TORC2
Slm1・Slm2 は PXIXIT に似た配列でカルシニューリンに結合し脱リン: Slm1 and Slm2 bind calcineurin through PXIXIT-like sequences and are dephosphorylated. Under heat stress they remain dephosphorylated for a long time, and regulation by calcineurin is required for full Slm function in the presence of myriocin (16738335)
Slm1・Slm2 は Pkh1・Pkh2 とカルシニューリンによるリン酸化・脱: Slm1 and Slm2 are regulated by a cycle of phosphorylation and dephosphorylation by Pkh1/Pkh2 and calcineurin. S659 phosphorylation is essential for survival under heat stress and promotes polarization of the actin cytoskeleton
Slm1・Slm2 は TORC2 の Avo2・Bit61 と物理的に結合し、: Slm1 and Slm2 physically bind the TORC2 components Avo2 and Bit61, and these bindings regulate Slm1 localization to the plasma membrane (15689497)
Sln1 のアスパラギン酸のリン酸は Ypd1 に渡り、Ypd1 は応答調節因子: The phosphate on the Sln1 aspartate is transferred to Ypd1, which transfers it to conserved aspartates of the response regulators Ssk1 and Skn7 (12455952). ypd1 deletion lowers Skn7 transcriptional activity, which depends on D427 (9790591)
Sln1 の自己リン酸化のリン酸が Ypd1 の His64 に渡る。リン酸化さ: The phosphate from Sln1 autophosphorylation is transferred to His64 of Ypd1. Because phosphorylated Ypd1 functions to transfer phosphate to Ssk1, the effect was corrected to activate (summary 2 had inhibit)
Slp1 と Emp65（YER140W）は小胞体膜の複合体を作る。Slp1 は: Slp1 and Emp65 (YER140W) form an ER membrane complex. Slp1 is involved in localization of Mps3 to the nuclear envelope (23275891)
Slt11p（Ecm2）と Slu7p は生体内・試験管内で結合し、Slu7p: Slt11p (Ecm2) and Slu7p bind in vivo and in vitro, and Slu7p binding impairs the RNA-binding activity of Slt11p (11158289)
Slt2 が TORC2 のサブユニット Avo2 を直接リン酸化し、TORC2: Slt2 directly phosphorylates the TORC2 subunit Avo2, lowering TORC2 signaling (Avo2 is required for optimal TORC2 activity)
Slt2 は Hsp90 のクライアントで、Hsp90 の量が少ないと熱での S: Slt2 is an Hsp90 client; when Hsp90 levels are low, the heat-induced increase in Slt2 kinase activity does not occur. High Hsp90 expression restores it (17293484). The Hsp90 inhibitor radicicol blocks Rlm1 activation by Slt2 but not the non-catalytic activation of Swi4/Swi6 (35420390)
Slt2 は出芽と接合突起の形成のときにチロシンリン酸化されて活性化する。どちら: Slt2 is tyrosine-phosphorylated and activated during budding and mating projection formation. Both require Bck1; Ste20 is required for activation by mating pheromone but not for activation during the vegetative cell cycle (8598209)
Slu7 の Prp18 結合領域の変異は two-hybrid と試験管内で: Mutations in the Prp18-binding region of Slu7 abolish binding to Prp18 in two-hybrid and in vitro assays and cause temperature sensitivity in vivo (12212850)
Slx5 による Cse4 のユビキチン化は Cse4 の分解に重要で、Cse4: Ubiquitination of Cse4 by Slx5 is important for Cse4 degradation and prevents mislocalization of Cse4 to euchromatin. In slx5Δ, SUMOylated Cse4 accumulates and Cse4 becomes stable. slx5Δ psh1Δ is more stable than either single mutant, independent of Psh1 (26960795)
Slx5 は SUMO E3 の Siz1 と結合し、Slx5/Slx8 は S: Slx5 binds the SUMO E3 Siz1, and Slx5/Slx8 ubiquitinate Siz1 fragments in vitro. Phosphorylated and SUMOylated Siz1 accumulates in slx5 cells. Siz1 is ubiquitinated in vivo and, when it cannot exit the nucleus in mitosis, is degraded in a Slx5-dependent manner (24196836)
Slx9 は RanGTP と NES を Crm1 に差し出す足場で、40S: Slx9 is a scaffold that presents RanGTP and the NES to Crm1, triggering nuclear export of 40S precursors (25895666)
Sly1 は Sed5 と共沈し、sly1(ts) では結合が弱い。組換え Sl: Sly1 co-precipitates with Sed5, and binding is weak in sly1(ts). Recombinant Sly1 enhances formation of the Sed5-Bet1 complex on membranes (12186954)
SmD1（と SmD2・SmE・SmF）の変異が brr1Δ と合成致死になる（: Mutations in SmD1 (and SmD2, SmE, SmF) are synthetically lethal with brr1Δ (27974620)
SmD2（と SmD1・SmE・SmF）の変異が brr1Δ と合成致死になる（: Mutations in SmD2 (and SmD1, SmE, SmF) are synthetically lethal with brr1Δ (27974620)
SmD3・SmB・Yhc1 の Snp1 との接触面の変異は単独では影響がないが: Mutations at the Snp1 contact surfaces of SmD3, SmB, and Yhc1 have no effect alone but show synthetic defects with mud1Δ (25897024)
Smc1 と Smc3 はヒンジのヘテロな相互作用で結合し V 字のヘテロ二量体: Smc1 and Smc3 bind through heterotypic hinge interactions to form a V-shaped heterodimer (11983169)
Smc2 と Smc4 は安定なヘテロ二量体を作り、両方そろうと ATPase: Smc2 and Smc4 form a stable heterodimer, and ATPase activity appears when both are present (12719426)
Smc5-Smc6 は Mph1 ヘリカーゼのフォーク逆行の活性を抑えるが D: Smc5-Smc6 inhibits the fork regression activity of the Mph1 helicase but not its D-loop dissociation activity. In vitro, Smc5-Smc6 binds the Mph1 region required for fork regression and prevents Mph1 multimerization at fork junctions (25439736)
Smd1p の変異で低温の生育に Lhp1p が必要になる。pre-U4 RNA: Smd1p mutations make Lhp1p necessary for growth at low temperature. Pre-U4 RNA is bound by Smd1p, and Lhp1p helps efficient binding of Sm proteins (10747032)
Smf1 の分解には Bsd2 に加えて Tre1 か Tre2 のどちらかが要: Smf1 degradation requires Bsd2 plus either Tre1 or Tre2. Tre1 binds Bsd2 (16456538). Sorting of Smf1 requires Bsd2 and Tre1 and depends on the two PY motifs of Bsd2 and the one PY motif of Tre1 (17429078)
Smf1 degradation requires Bsd2 plus either Tre1 or Tre2 (16456538)
Smk1 の活性化ループの T は Cak1 が、Y は Ssp2 を要する分子: In the Smk1 activation loop, the T is phosphorylated by Cak1 and the Y by intramolecular autophosphorylation requiring Ssp2 (23207907)
Smk1 の発現直後に Ime2 を止めると Smk1 の活性化ループのリン酸化: Stopping Ime2 right after Smk1 expression lowers phosphorylation of the Smk1 activation loop; Ime2 is a key activator of Smk1 signaling (19087957)
Smk1 は Ssp2 とともに減数第二分裂後半に LEP と一時的に局在し、先: Smk1, together with Ssp2, transiently localizes with the LEP in late meiosis II, and its localization to the tip depends on Ady3 (33466572)
Smk1 は部分的に重複するグルカン合成酵素 Gsc2 と Fks3 を介して胞: Smk1 promotes deposition of the glucan layer of the spore wall via the partially redundant glucan synthases Gsc2 and Fks3 (38874213)
Smt1 は ATP6/8 mRNA の翻訳抑制因子で、変異で Atp6・Atp: Smt1 is a translational repressor of ATP6/8 mRNA, and its mutation restores translation of Atp6 and Atp8 (26823015)
Smt3 は Uba2 と Aos1 からなるヘテロ二量体の E1 によって A: Smt3 is activated in an ATP-dependent manner by a heterodimeric E1 composed of Uba2 and Aos1. AOS1 and UBA2 are both essential (9312010)
Smt3 は Uba2 と Aos1 のヘテロ二量体の酵素で ATP 依存的に活: Smt3 is activated in an ATP-dependent manner by the Uba2-Aos1 heterodimeric enzyme (9312010)
Sna3 の液胞への輸送は Rsp5 のリガーゼ活性とユビキチン化に強く依存（2: Transport of Sna3 to the vacuole depends strongly on Rsp5 ligase activity and ubiquitination (22212814)
Sna3 は Rsp5 をメチオニン輸送体 Mup1 などの積荷に呼ぶアダプター: Sna3 is an adaptor that recruits Rsp5 to cargoes such as the methionine transporter Mup1, making Mup1 delivery to the vacuole efficient (22212814)
Sna4 の PPPY モチーフが Rsp5 との相互作用に関わり、モチーフの変: The PPPY motif of Sna4 is involved in interaction with Rsp5, and mutation of the motif or reduction of Rsp5 blocks entry into MVBs. Sna4 is polyubiquitinated on its only lysine (19168755)
Snf1 が Cyr1 をリン酸化し、cAMP と PKA 依存の転写を負に制御: Snf1 phosphorylates Cyr1 and negatively regulates cAMP and PKA-dependent transcription
Snf1 が Hxk2 の Ser14 をリン酸化すると核への輸入が減り輸出が増: Phosphorylation of Hxk2 Ser14 by Snf1 reduces its nuclear import and increases export (lowering its function in the nuclear repressor complex)
Snf1 がグルコース飢餓と Ca2+ による GPX1 の発現に関わる。snf: Snf1 is involved in GPX1 expression induced by glucose starvation and Ca2+. In snf1Δ, the onset of induction is delayed (20002498)
Snf1 と Ypk1 による Rod1 のリン酸化は Rod1 を負に調節し、: Phosphorylation of Rod1 by Snf1 and Ypk1 negatively regulates Rod1, blocking its function in promoting desensitization of the pheromone pathway (Ste2 internalization) (PMID 26920760). 17949685 shows S447 phosphorylation but its effect is unclear
Snf1 と酵母の GSK3 はそれぞれ独立に Tda1 をリン酸化し活性化し、: Snf1 and yeast GSK3 each independently phosphorylate and activate Tda1, and Tda1 phosphorylates S15 of Hxk2. Tda1 S509 is important for activation by GSK3, and S483 and T484 for activation by Snf1 (40275108). Main text: Tda1 phosphorylation is greatly reduced in rim11Δ mck1Δ, and Rim11 phosphorylates Tda1 in vitro
Snf1 と酵母の GSK3 はそれぞれ独立に Tda1 をリン酸化し活性化する: Snf1 and yeast GSK3 each independently phosphorylate and activate Tda1. Tda1 S483 and T484 are important for activation by Snf1 (40275108)
Snf1 による Pib2 と Sch9 のリン酸化が、グルコース飢餓直後の T: Phosphorylation of Pib2 and Sch9 by Snf1 explains the inhibition of TORC1 signaling immediately after glucose starvation
Snf1 に依存してリン酸化されるタンパク質の中に Ccr4・Dhh1・Xrn1: Proteins phosphorylated in a Snf1-dependent manner include Ccr4, Dhh1, and Xrn1, which are required for glucose-induced degradation of Snf1-dependent mRNAs induced by glucose starvation. Changing three Snf1-dependent phosphorylation sites of Xrn1 reduces glucose-induced mRNA degradation (25005228)
Snf1 は HSF と結合し試験管内で直接リン酸化する。グルコース飢餓での H: Snf1 binds HSF and directly phosphorylates it in vitro. HSF phosphorylation under glucose starvation, increased binding to low-affinity promoters, and induction of target genes depend on Snf1 (PMID 14612437). 18793336 is a Yak1 paper
Snf1 は Hxk2 と恒常的に結合し、高グルコースでは Hxk2 が Snf: Snf1 binds Hxk2 constitutively, and at high glucose Hxk2 prevents Snf1 from phosphorylating Mig1 Ser311. hxk2 mutations relieve glucose repression of Snf1
Snf1 は Msn2 の S582 を直接リン酸化して Msn2 の働きを抑え: Snf1 directly phosphorylates Msn2 S582 to inhibit Msn2 function
Snf1 は Sak1 を多くの部位でリン酸化して抑え、Sak1 による Snf: Snf1 phosphorylates Sak1 at many sites to inhibit it, limiting Sak1 phosphorylation of Snf1 T210 and nuclear accumulation of Snf1 (the evidence sentence is from the PMC main text)
Snf1 はグルコース欠乏で Imh1 の S606・S802・S804 をリン: Under glucose deprivation, Snf1 phosphorylates Imh1 S606, S802, and S804, dissociating Arl1-Imh1 from the Golgi. Phosphomimetic mutants detach from the Golgi, while non-phosphorylatable mutants do not. Snf1 binds Imh1 and directly phosphorylates it. This phosphorylation impairs its function in supporting SNARE recycling in ypt6Δ and disturbs Golgi homeostasis (40560401)
Snf1 はラパマイシン感受性の TOR キナーゼに負に調節される。窒素の制限で: Snf1 is negatively regulated by the rapamycin-sensitive TOR kinase. Under nitrogen limitation, Snf1 Thr210 phosphorylation increases
Snf1 は代替炭素源での Psk1 の活性化に必要かつ十分で、Psk1 の移動: Snf1 is necessary and sufficient for Psk1 activation on alternative carbon sources, is required for the mobility shift of Psk1, phosphorylates Psk1 in vitro, and binds it via Gal83. Psk1 phosphorylates and activates Pbp1, and Pbp1 inhibits TORC1 by sequestering it into stress granules (25428989)
Snf5 は Swp82・Taf14 と一つのサブモジュールをつくる（架橋質量分: Snf5 forms one submodule with Swp82 and Taf14 (cross-linking mass spectrometry and subunit deletion, 28249160)
Snf5-Swi3 部分複合体の結晶構造。この形成は SWI/SNF の働きに必: Crystal structure of the Snf5-Swi3 subcomplex. Its formation is required for SWI/SNF function (32284172)
Snf6 は ATPase サブユニット Snf2 の土台モジュールへの結合を安: Snf6 stabilizes binding of the ATPase subunit Snf2 to the base module (32636384)
Sng1 は Nce102 と物理的・遺伝学的に相互作用し、nce102Δ sn: Sng1 interacts physically and genetically with Nce102, and in nce102Δ sng1Δ myriocin-induced hyperphosphorylation of Ypk1 and Orm2 does not occur (27033517)
Sni445 は 90S 前駆リボソーム内で Kre33 と物理的に結合し、欠損: Sni445 physically binds Kre33 within the 90S pre-ribosome, and its deletion abolishes acetylation of C1280 and C1773 (41603732)
Snt2 と Ecm5 が Rpd3 を少数のプロモーターへ呼び込む（ChIP-: Snt2 and Ecm5 recruit Rpd3 to a small number of promoters (ChIP-seq) (23878396)
Snt2・Ecm5・Rpd3 は物理的に結合する（23878396）: Snt2, Ecm5, and Rpd3 physically bind one another (23878396)
Snu114 と Prp8 の結合領域の結晶構造。Prp8 の結合領域は Snu: Crystal structure of Snu114 with the Prp8 binding region. The Prp8 binding region abolishes the weak GTPase activity of Snu114 (32196113)
Snu13 が B/C モチーフに先に結合していると、Rrp9 の WD ドメイ: When Snu13 is pre-bound to the B/C motif, specific binding of the Rrp9 WD domain increases (23509373)
Snx3 は Neo1 の輸送に必要で、Neo1 の N 末端に Snx3 の選: Snx3 is required for Neo1 transport, and the Snx3 sorting motif is in the N-terminus of Neo1 (28404745)
Snx4 は Snx4-Atg20 と Snx4-Snx41 の 2 つのヘテロ: Snx4 forms two heterodimers, Snx4-Atg20 and Snx4-Snx41. Snx4-Atg20 transports Snc1 (28026081)
Snx4 forms two heterodimers, Snx4-Atg20 and Snx4-Snx41. Snx4-Snx41 transports Atg27 (28026081)
Snx4 forms two heterodimers, Snx4-Atg20 and Snx4-Snx41 (28026081)
Snx4-Snx41 は Atg27 のエンドソームからゴルジへの逆行輸送を担う: Snx4-Snx41 mediates retrograde transport of Atg27 from endosomes to the Golgi (28026081)
Sod1 とその銅シャペロン Ccs1 は外の銅の欠乏に応じた Mac1 の活性: Sod1 and its copper chaperone Ccs1 act in Mac1 activation in response to external copper deficiency. Without CCS1, Mac1 target genes are not activated (18977757)
Sod1 の触媒活性が Mac1 の活性化と標的遺伝子のプロモーターへの結合に必: Sod1 catalytic activity is essential for Mac1 activation and binding to target gene promoters (18977757). Sod1 binds Mac1 and is important for transcriptional activation and DNA binding (36456733)
Sof1 は U3 snoRNA と Nop1 と共免疫沈降する（8508778: Sof1 co-immunoprecipitates with U3 snoRNA and Nop1 (8508778)
Sog2 は Hym1・Kic1 と相互作用する。sog2 欠失で RAM 欠損: Sog2 interacts with Hym1 and Kic1. sog2 deletion causes the same cell separation and morphology defects as RAM loss (12972564)
Sov1 は VAR1 mRNA の翻訳を活性化し、合成直後の Var1 に結合: Sov1 activates translation of VAR1 mRNA and binds newly synthesized Var1 (32449921)
Spa2 と Pea2 は生体内で強く結合し、Bud6 とともに 12S 複合体: Spa2 and Pea2 bind strongly in vivo and appear to form a 12S complex with Bud6 (9632790)
Spa2 は Cyk3・Hof1・Chs2 に直接結合する。spa2Δ と cy: Spa2 binds Cyk3, Hof1, and Chs2 directly. The synthetic lethality of spa2Δ with cyk3Δ or hof1Δ is suppressed by a hyperactive Chs2, and increasing Spa2 promotes Chs2 incorporation at the division site and primary septum formation
Spb1 は生体内で Nop1 と Nop5/58 と結合している（106486: Spb1 is bound to Nop1 and Nop5/58 in vivo (10648622)
Spb1 は生体内で核小体タンパク質 Nop1 と Nop5/58 と結合してい: Spb1 is bound to the nucleolar proteins Nop1 and Nop5/58 in vivo (co-immunoprecipitation) (10648622)
Spc1 欠失で SPase による膜タンパク質の処理が増え、過剰発現で減る。S: Spc1 deletion increases processing of membrane proteins by SPase, and overexpression decreases it. Spc1 is a negative regulator of SPase (34125229). The SPC consists of Spc1-3 and Sec11 (39565596)
Spc105/Kre28 は外側動原体での Ipl1・Sli15 の受容体。変異: Spc105/Kre28 is the receptor for Ipl1 and Sli15 at the outer kinetochore. Mutations impair correction of erroneous attachments, which is rescued by artificial recruitment of Ipl1 (40281358)
Spc110p の N 末端は Spc98p と強く結合し、この結合が Tub4: The N-terminus of Spc110p binds Spc98p strongly, and this binding is key to linking the Tub4p complex to the SPB. The lethality of spc98-63 spc110-221 is due to loss of binding between the two (9693376)
Spc29 の T240 のリン酸化は SPB の複製と生存に要り、体内で Sp: Phosphorylation of Spc29 T240 is required for SPB duplication and viability and stabilizes Spc29 in vivo. Mps1 phosphorylates this site in vitro, and in strains with reduced Mps1 activity newly made Spc29 is unstable (19269975). That Mps1 phosphorylates this site in vivo is only "suggested", so confidence is medium
Spc29 は G1 サイクリン（Cln1・Cln2）に特異的な K/R ドッキ: Spc29 is a G1-CDK substrate with a K/R docking motif specific to G1 cyclins (Cln1, Cln2) (34502421)
Spc2p を減らすと SPC の活性が下がり、小胞体の Sec11p と Sp: Reducing Spc2p lowers SPC activity and decreases the levels of ER Sec11p and Spc3p (10921929)
Spc72 は Cdc5 と Ime2 に依存する経路で SPB から外され、こ: Spc72 is removed from the SPB by a pathway dependent on Cdc5 and Ime2, and this pathway is unleashed by APC/C-mediated degradation of Spo13 at anaphase I (35023198). Main text: in addition to Cdc5 activity, Ime2 activity is also required for removal of Spc72 at anaphase I
Spc72 は分裂期に限って Cdc5 の PBD に結合し、試験管内で Cdc: Spc72 binds the Cdc5 PBD only in mitosis, is phosphorylated by Cdc5 in vitro, and stopping Cdc5 abolishes its mitotic phosphorylation (18022565). Main text: Cdc5 directly phosphorylates Nud1 and Spc72 in vitro (17967947)
Spc97 は two-hybrid で Spc98・Tub4 と結合し、免疫沈: Spc97 binds Spc98 and Tub4 by two-hybrid, and a three-way complex is also found by immunoprecipitation (9130700)
Sph1p はツーハイブリッドで MAPKK の Mkk1p・Mkk2p・Ste: Sph1p binds the MAPKKs Mkk1p, Mkk2p, and Ste7p in two-hybrid assays, and also binds Ste11 weakly (9443897)
Spn1 の転写装置への結合は結合相手の Spt6 に強く依存する（329416: Spn1 binding to the transcription machinery depends strongly on its binding partner Spt6 (32941642)
Spn1 は H3K36・H3K4 メチル化の分布を保ち、転写領域への Spt6: Spn1 maintains the distribution of H3K36 and H3K4 methylation, and binding of Spt6 and Set2 to transcribed regions depends partly on Spn1 (32941642)
Spo1 は Spo23（PI の合成を調節する）と物理的に結合する（17179: Spo1 physically binds Spo23 (which regulates PI synthesis) (17179081)
Spo13 は後期 I に分解される APC の基質で、L26 の変異で試験管内: Spo13 is an APC substrate degraded at anaphase I; the L26 mutation abolishes in vitro ubiquitination and makes it stable throughout meiosis (17493939). Cdc20-dependent degradation of Spo13 at anaphase I increases Ama1 synthesis and activity, causing exit from meiosis at the second division (37728253)
Spo13 は第一分裂中期に Ime2 による Rim4 の分解を妨げ、それによ: Spo13 prevents Ime2-mediated degradation of Rim4 at metaphase I, thereby preventing translation of AMA1 and CLB3. Binding to Cdc5 is required for this function (37728253, main text)
Spo13/MEIKIN を欠くと APC/C-Ama1 が早く活性化して分裂が: Without Spo13/MEIKIN, APC/C-Ama1 is activated early and only one division occurs. In wild type, Spo13 bound to Cdc5 stabilizes the translational repressor Rim4 to prevent Ama1 synthesis in the first division (37728253)
Spo20p は t-SNARE の Sso1p に特異的に結合し、さらに v-: Spo20p binds specifically to the t-SNARE Sso1p and also forms a complex with the v-SNARE Snc2p (10924463)
Spo73 は前胞子膜に局在し Spo71 と複合体を作る。SPO71 と同じく: Spo73 localizes to the prospore membrane and forms a complex with Spo71. Like SPO71, it is required for membrane expansion (26605945)
Spo74 と Mpc70（SPO21）は減数分裂で SPB への呼び込みに互い: Spo74 and Mpc70 (SPO21) depend on each other for recruitment to the SPB in meiosis (12796288)
Spp1 と Set1 の結合を壊すと H3K4me3 がわずかに下がる（294: Disrupting Spp1-Set1 binding slightly lowers H3K4me3 (29444071)
Spp381 の C 末端側半分が Prp38 と直接結合する（two-hybr: The C-terminal half of Spp381 binds Prp38 directly (two-hybrid). High expression of SPP381 suppresses prp38-1 (9858581)
Spt21 は S 期に Spt10 によってヒストン遺伝子のプロモーターに呼び: Spt21 is recruited to histone gene promoters by Spt10 in S phase (25228766)
Spt8 は TFIIS の N 末端ドメインの two-hybrid の相手で: Spt8 is a two-hybrid partner of the TFIIS N-terminal domain, and TFIIS binds SAGA in cell extracts (15359273)
Sqt1 は Qsr1p と結合し、SQT1 を減らすと遊離 60S 上の Qs: Sqt1 binds Qsr1p, and reducing SQT1 decreases Qsr1p on free 60S (9271392). Sqt1 enriches nascent Rpl10 mRNA and covers the Rpl10 N-terminus with its β-propeller (26112308)
Srb10 は Med2 と結合し、体内と試験管内でリン酸化する。Med2 の: Srb10 binds Med2 and phosphorylates it in vivo and in vitro. A point mutation at one Med2 phosphorylation site strongly lowers expression of REP1, REP2, FLP1, and RAF1 of the 2 μm plasmid (14988503). The BioGRID PTM site is S208
Srb10p とサイクリン Srb11p が AAH1 の発現を転写の段階で制御: Srb10p and the cyclin Srb11p regulate AAH1 expression at the transcriptional level (16677311)
Srb10（Cdk8 = SSN3）は富栄養培地で Ste12 をリン酸化して不: Srb10 (Cdk8 = SSN3) phosphorylates and destabilizes Ste12 in rich medium, inhibiting filamentous growth. Under nitrogen limitation, Srb10 levels and activity are lost, and mutations at the phosphorylation sites increase pseudohyphal growth (12520306)
Srb10（Ssn3）と Kin28 はどちらも試験管内で Pol II CTD: Srb10 (Ssn3) and Kin28 both phosphorylate the Pol II CTD in vitro, but Srb10 acts as a negative regulator that represses transcription by phosphorylating the CTD before the transcription initiation complex forms at the promoter (9702190). BioGRID's 33523904 is a CKM structure paper and 22124158 is a Phd1 paper
Srb10（Ssn3）は Gcn4 をリン酸化して SCF(Cdc4) に認識さ: Srb10 (Ssn3) phosphorylates Gcn4, leading to its recognition by SCF(Cdc4) and degradation. In srb10 mutants, Gcn4 phosphorylation and degradation decrease, and Gcn4 with all Srb10 sites changed is nearly stable (11331604)
Srb8・Srb9・Srb10・Srb11 が化学量論的な複合体として単離され、: Srb8, Srb9, Srb10, and Srb11 were isolated as a stoichiometric complex that phosphorylates the CTD of RNA polymerase II (12200444)
Srf1 は Spo14 と物理的に相互作用し、体細胞分裂中の細胞の PLD 触: Srf1 physically interacts with Spo14 and is essential for PLD catalytic activity in mitotically dividing cells (21347278)
Sro7 と Sro77 は細胞膜の SNARE Sec9 に結合することで見つ: Sro7 and Sro77 were found by their binding to the plasma membrane SNARE Sec9 (10402465)
Srp102 の活性の喪失は Srp101 との親和性の喪失と並行し、SR サブ: Loss of Srp102 activity parallels loss of affinity for Srp101, so binding between the SR subunits is important for function (9679135)
Srp1・Kap95・Sxm1 が Rrp6 の核への取り込みに最も重要なカリオ: Srp1, Kap95, and Sxm1 are the most important karyopherins for nuclear import of Rrp6 (28539363)
Srs2 の SUMO 化は PCNA との結合を弱める。STUbL の Uls: SUMOylation of Srs2 weakens its binding to PCNA. The STUbL Uls1 binds both PCNA and Srs2, reduces Srs2-SUMO at replication forks, and promotes Srs2 binding to PCNA (28341648)
Srs2 は Rad51 のフィラメントを解体して相同組換えを制限し、Srs2: Srs2 disassembles Rad51 filaments to limit homologous recombination, and without Srs2 Rad51 foci accumulate (19506039, in cells). Srs2 removes Rad51 from ssDNA (12748644, in vitro)
Srv2/CAP の N 末端半分がコフィリンによる繊維切断を直接促進する（結合: The N-terminal half of Srv2/CAP directly promotes filament severing by cofilin (increasing severing frequency without changing the amount bound) (23135996)
Ssa1 と Hsp40 の Ydj1・Hlj1 は Ste6p* の ERAD: Ssa1 and the Hsp40s Ydj1 and Hlj1 are important for ERAD of Ste6p* (15252059)
Ssa1 と Ssa2 はともに Ste5 の機能と接合応答に重要。両方を欠くと: Ssa1 and Ssa2 are both important for Ste5 function and the mating response. Lacking both impairs Ste5 levels and localization (37851593)
Ssa1 を FBPase の結合相手として同定し、ssa1-45(ts) 変異: Ssa1 was identified as a binding partner of FBPase, and in the ssa1-45(ts) mutant polyubiquitination of FBPase by the Gid complex does not occur (20513352)
Ssb は TORC1 による Sch9 の T737 のリン酸化に要る（290: Ssb is required for phosphorylation of Sch9 T737 by TORC1 (29038496 summary). Main text: Sch9 phosphorylates Hsf1 when glucose is present (in vitro and in vivo), which is required for the activating phosphorylation by Yak1 and induction of target genes upon glucose depletion. It is not required for Hsf1 activation by heat shock
Ssb はグルコースがあるとき SNF1 を脱リン酸化された状態に保つのに要る（: Ssb is required to keep SNF1 dephosphorylated when glucose is present (19723765). Increasing Ssb or Bmh allows Glc7 to dephosphorylate SNF1 even without Reg1 (27001512)
Ssc1 の働きは Tim44・コシャペロン Mdj1・Mge1 との相互作用で: Ssc1 function is supported by interactions with Tim44, the co-chaperone Mdj1, and Mge1 (11601843). The 8943361 summary also states that Mdj1 cooperates with mt-Hsp70 in the matrix, but it was removed from the pmids because it is not written under the name Ssc1
Sse1・Sse2 は Hsp104 依存の脱凝集に必須で、Hsp110 がない: Sse1 and Sse2 are essential for Hsp104-dependent disaggregation; without Hsp110, recruitment of Hsp70 and Hsp104 to aggregates is impaired, and Hsp104 that does arrive cannot disaggregate (28289075)
Ssh1p 複合体は Ssh1・Sbh2・Sss1 からなる三量体（861257: The Ssh1p complex is a trimer composed of Ssh1, Sbh2, and Sss1 (8612571)
Ssh4 はリジン飢餓のあとでだけ Ypq1 を認識する。Ypq1 の TM5・: Ssh4 recognizes Ypq1 only after lysine starvation. TM5 and TM7 of Ypq1 interact with the transmembrane portion of Ssh4 (33351099)
Ssn6（Cyc8）は Aft1 と直接結合し、誘導時に FRE2 プロモーター: Ssn6 (Cyc8) binds Aft1 directly and acts as a coactivator at the FRE2 promoter upon induction (14739928)
Ssp120 は Emp47 と強く結合し、emp47Δ では Ssp120 が: Ssp120 binds Emp47 strongly, and in emp47Δ Ssp120 is mislocalized and secreted (26650540)
Sst2 の DEP ドメインが Ste2 への結合を担い、その結合が RGS: The DEP domain of Sst2 mediates binding to Ste2, and this binding places the RGS near its substrate Gα to promote inhibition. Sst2 binds only the unphosphorylated Ste2 tail (16990133)
Sst2 は Ste2 と結合し、フェロモン刺激した細胞の伸びる先端で受容体が戻: Sst2 binds Ste2 and is required for receptor return to the growing tip of pheromone-stimulated cells. It negatively regulates G protein signaling but positively promotes receptor retention (26310439)
Ssu72 は CPF の Pta1 と組んで CTD の Ser5 リン酸を外: Ssu72 is a phosphatase that, together with Pta1 of CPF, removes CTD Ser5 phosphate (15125841)
Ssy1 と Ptr3 は細胞膜にある外のアミノ酸のセンサーの成分。Ssy1 は: Ssy1 and Ptr3 are components of the plasma membrane sensor for external amino acids. Ssy1 requires ER Shr3 to reach the plasma membrane, but Ptr3 does not (10409731)
Ssy1-Ptr3-Ssy5 アミノ酸センサー系が rho0 細胞での ATO3: The Ssy1-Ptr3-Ssy5 amino acid sensor system is preferentially required for high ATO3 expression in rho0 cells (12966084)
Ssy5 の活性化は、信号による前駆ドメインの Yck1/2 によるリン酸化に依: Ssy5 activation depends on signal-induced phosphorylation of its prodomain by Yck1/2, followed by ubiquitination by SCF-Grr1 and degradation (23447701). An amino acid-induced conformational change allows the phosphodegron to be phosphorylated by Yck1/2 (21653827)
Ssy5 は Stp1 を切る内部プロテアーゼで、自身の切断が Stp1 の切断: Ssy5 is an endoprotease that cleaves Stp1, and its own cleavage is a prerequisite for Stp1 cleavage. Overproducing Ssy5 cleaves Stp1 without inducer and strongly transcribes AGP1 (15509782). In response to extracellular amino acids, Ssy5 cleaves and activates Stp1 and Stp2. Ssy5 is a serine protease (29661936)
Stb5 はペントースリン酸経路など NADPH を作る酵素の遺伝子を活性化する: Stb5 activates genes for NADPH-producing enzymes such as those of the pentose phosphate pathway. Overexpression induced TAL1 and others under glucose limitation (30924859)
Std1 は Snf1 の触媒ドメインに結合し、Snf1 と Snf4 の結合を: Std1 binds the catalytic domain of Snf1 and strengthens Snf1-Snf4 binding. Std1 overexpression raises Snf1 activity in vitro and in vivo (12618390)
Ste11 の膜への局在は Sho1 枝と糸状増殖の経路の活性化に必須で、Ste: Membrane localization of Ste11 is essential for activation of the Sho1 branch and the filamentous growth pathway, and results from Ste50 binding to Opy2. Ste50 binds Opy2 CR-A constitutively and CR-B in response to Yck1/2 phosphorylation (20932477)
Ste11 の膜への局在は糸状成長の MAPK 経路と Sho1 側の HOG: Membrane localization of Ste11 is essential for activation of the filamentous growth MAPK pathway and the Sho1 branch of the HOG pathway, and is mediated by binding of Ste50 to the membrane anchor Opy2 (20932477)
Ste11 は Nst1 を介して Mkk1/2 と直接結合し、熱やフェロモンで: Ste11 binds Mkk1/2 directly via Nst1, linking the HOG and pheromone pathways to the cell wall pathway upon heat or pheromone
Ste11 は Pbs2 の活性化部位 Thr-518 をリン酸化する（3201: Ste11 phosphorylates Thr-518 in the activation site of Pbs2 (32011004). Sho1 activates Pbs2 and Hog1 via Ste11 (9180081)
Ste12 は Kap121 と Ran-GTP に感受性の形で特異的に結合し、: Ste12 binds Kap121 specifically in a Ran-GTP-sensitive manner, and shifts to the cytoplasm in temperature-sensitive kap121 mutants. The mating and invasive growth defects of kap121 are suppressed by STE12 overexpression or addition of a classical NLS (11909949)
Ste12 は PRM1 プロモーターの 3 つの結合部位を介して PRM1 の: Ste12 increases PRM1 transcription via three binding sites in the PRM1 promoter (28986257)
Ste14 はメチル基転移酵素で、a-factor・RAS1・RAS2 は st: Ste14 is a methyltransferase; a-factor, RAS1, and RAS2 are not methylated in ste14 deletion. RAS2 maturation is slightly delayed (2050108)
Ste18 のリン酸化と Ste5 への Fus3 のドッキングが、Ste5 の: Ste18 phosphorylation and Fus3 docking to Ste5 determine the speed and stability of Ste5 binding to the plasma membrane. Disrupting both makes Fus3 activation faster and larger (29719261)
Ste20 の C 末端に Gβ の結合部位があり、その結合はフェロモンで調節さ: The C-terminus of Ste20 has a Gβ binding site, and this binding is regulated by pheromone. Gβ or Ste20 mutations that abolish binding block MAP kinase pathway activation (9428767)
Ste20 の CRIB ドメインの点変異は Cdc42 との結合とフェロモン応: Point mutations in the Ste20 CRIB domain impair Cdc42 binding and the pheromone response. GTP-bound Cdc42 enhances Ste20 kinase activity in vivo; CRIB is an autoinhibitory domain whose inhibition Cdc42 relieves. The same holds in the filamentous growth pathway (11940652). BioGRID's PMID 7651520 shows that Cdc42 acts between the G protein and the kinase system in the pheromone pathway, but Ste20 does not appear in the summary
Ste20 の PXXP 配列は Sho1 の SH3 ドメインに結合し、この結: The PXXP sequence of Ste20 binds the SH3 domain of Sho1, and this binding contributes to Hog1 activation by Hkr1 but not by Msb2 (24570489)
Ste20 のリン酸化は細胞周期に依存し S 期に最大。Cln2 の過剰発現（C: Ste20 phosphorylation depends on the cell cycle and peaks in S phase. Overexpression of Cln2 (not Clb2 or Clb5) changes its mobility in a Cdc28-dependent manner, and in vitro only the Cln2 complex phosphorylates it (9774429). In vivo phosphorylation sites specifically dependent on Cln2 were identified (10359756)
Ste20 は生体内で Ste11 の S302・S306・T307 をリン酸化: Ste20 phosphorylates Ste11 S302, S306, and T307 in vivo. Making the sites non-phosphorylatable inactivates Ste11, and changing them to aspartate makes it constitutively active without Ste20. Phosphorylation relieves the N-terminal inhibitory domain (10837245)
Ste20・Cla4・Skm1 が Sut1 と複合体を作り、Sut1 標的のス: Ste20, Cla4, and Skm1 form a complex with Sut1 and lower expression of the Sut1-target sterol uptake genes (19793923)
Ste3 のユビキチン化はリガンド非依存の速い取り込みと液胞での分解を起こす。A: Ste3 ubiquitination causes ligand-independent rapid internalization and degradation in the vacuole. Mutations in Akr1 or the redundant Yck1 and Yck2 block ubiquitination and internalization. Ste3 deletion mutants are also defective in phosphorylation (10866691)
Ste4 はフェロモン刺激で Rsp5 に依存してユビキチン化され、Rsp5 を: Ste4 is ubiquitinated in an Rsp5-dependent manner upon pheromone stimulation; stopping Rsp5 abolishes in vivo ubiquitination, and recombinant Rsp5 ubiquitinates Ste4 in vitro. The main site is K340; ubiquitination does not change Ste4 stability, but K340R cells polarize faster than wild type in a pheromone gradient (21685393)
Ste5 のユビキチン化は SCF(Cdc4) が担い、G1 の Cdk1 によ: Ste5 ubiquitination is mediated by SCF(Cdc4) and requires phosphorylation by G1 Cdk1. Degradation occurs mainly in the nucleus, and when Ste5 cannot be degraded the pathway is activated without pheromone (19001089)
Ste5 は Hsp70 の Ssa1 と結合し、Ssa1 と Ssa2 は合わ: Ste5 binds the Hsp70 Ssa1, and Ssa1 and Ssa2 together are required for Ste5 function and an efficient mating response. Losing both impairs Ste5 levels, integrity, and localization (37851593)
Ste5 は Ste11・Ste7・Fus3 を束ね、Ste11 が働くのに必要: Ste5 bundles Ste11, Ste7, and Fus3 and is required for Ste11 to function (8062390). Through membrane binding by the Ste5 PH domain, Ste5-bound Ste11 is activated by membrane Ste20 (16847350). Binding of Gβ to the Ste5 LIM domain is essential for Ste11 activation (9501067)
Ste50 と Ste11 は N 末端どうしで結合し、この結合が Ste11: Ste50 and Ste11 bind through their N-termini, and this binding relieves the N-terminal inhibition of Ste11. This is required for Ste11 function in the HOG pathway and is important (not essential) in the mating pathway (10397774)
Ste50 の RA ドメインは侵入性増殖と HOG の信号に必須で、試験管内で: The RA domain of Ste50 is essential for invasive growth and HOG signaling, and binds Cdc42, not Ras2, in vitro. The RA domain can be replaced by the membrane-binding sequence of Cdc42; through binding Cdc42, Ste50 tethers Ste11 to the membrane and brings it to activated Ste20 (16428446)
Ste7 は二重特異性キナーゼで、Fus3 を正しい部位でリン酸化して活性を上げ: Ste7 is a dual-specificity kinase that phosphorylates Fus3 at the correct sites and raises its activity (8384702). Fus3 is a poor substrate of Ste7, and a domain of Ste5 makes Fus3 easier to phosphorylate. Because both Ste7 and Ste5 are required, Fus3 is activated only in the mating pathway (19303851)
Sth1 の ABD の保存されたアミノ酸が Sth1 の働きに必須。本文: I: Conserved amino acids in the Sth1 ABD are essential for Sth1 function. Main text: TAD1 and TAD2 of Ino2 bind Sth1 (39235627)
Sti1 は Ssa 群と特異的に結合し、Ssa1 の ATPase を約 20: Sti1 binds the Ssa family specifically and activates the Ssa1 ATPase about 200-fold (12716905)
Sti1 は Ssa1 と酵母 Hsp90 をつなぐ三者複合体を作り、Hsp90: Sti1 forms a ternary complex linking Ssa1 and yeast Hsp90, with an affinity for Hsp90 two orders of magnitude higher (12716905)
Stp1 は MAE1 と OAC1 のプロモーターに直接結合して発現を制御する: Stp1 binds the MAE1 and OAC1 promoters directly to regulate their expression (25825491)
Stp1 はカゼインキナーゼ I に依存してリン酸化され、このキナーゼを欠く y: Stp1 is phosphorylated in a casein kinase I-dependent manner; in yck mutants lacking this kinase, Stp1 is not cleaved and amino acid-induced AGP1 induction does not occur (15509782)
Stp1・Stp2 は BAP2 プロモーターに直接結合する（11212916）: Stp1 and Stp2 bind the BAP2 promoter directly (11212916)
Stp1 and Stp2 bind the BAP2 promoter directly (11212916). Activation of the BAP2 promoter by amino acids in the medium depends on STP1 (9065387)
Stp2 も BAP3 の誘導に関わり、Stp2 に依存した UAS(aa) と: Stp2 is also involved in BAP3 induction, and a Stp2-dependent complex with UAS(aa) is observed (10648791)
Sts1 は Srp1 と結合してプロテアソームを核へ向ける。Sts1 の NL: Sts1 binds Srp1 and directs the proteasome to the nucleus. Sts1 lacking its NLS cannot bind Srp1, and proteasome localization is disturbed (21075847)
Stt4 または Mss4 を止めると Rho の GEF Rom2 が正しく局: Stopping Stt4 or Mss4 causes mislocalization of the Rho GEF Rom2. Rom2 binds PI4,5P2 through its PH domain and is the first effector of the Stt4-Mss4 pathway (12015967)
Stt4 または Mss4 を止めると Rom2 が正しく局在しない（12015: Stopping Stt4 or Mss4 causes mislocalization of Rom2 (12015967). Binding of the Mss4 product PI4,5P2 to the Rom2 PH domain recruits Rom2 to the membrane, an essential step for Rho1/2 activation. When myriocin disturbs Mss4 activity and localization, Rom2 also fails to reach the membrane (15741172)
Stu2 の体内の修飾に Cdc28 と Cdc5 が要り、両者は試験管内でもリ: In vivo modification of Stu2 requires Cdc28 and Cdc5, and both also phosphorylate it in vitro (18178775)
Stu2 の核への取り込みに Cdc28 の活性が要る（40576560）: Nuclear import of Stu2 requires Cdc28 activity (40576560)
Su e(Atp21) と Su g(Atp20) は二量体の安定化に要り、順に: Su e (Atp21) and Su g (Atp20) are required for dimer stabilization and bind monomeric ATP synthase sequentially, producing monomers capable of dimerization (19635484)
Sua5 が TC-AMP を作り、Qri7 がそれを tRNA に移して t6: Sua5 makes TC-AMP and Qri7 transfers it to tRNA to make t6A. Qri7 and Sua5 constitute the mitochondrial t6A pathway (25038083)
Sub1 は C 末端領域で RNAPII のストーク Rpb4/7 と物理的に: Sub1 physically interacts through its C-terminal region with the RNAPII stalk Rpb4/7 and associates with Fcp1 (27924005)
Sub2 と Yra1 の C 末断片の複合体の結晶構造を決め、THO と Yr: The crystal structure of a complex of Sub2 and a C-terminal fragment of Yra1 was determined; THO and Yra1-C together enhance Sub2 ATPase activity (28059701)
Sul1 と Sul2 は硫黄飢餓からの脱出時に PKA にシグナルを送るトラン: Sul1 and Sul2 are transceptors that signal to PKA upon exit from sulfur starvation (25724649)
Sul1 などのトランスセプターは試験管内と生体内で Sch9 と物理的に相互作: Transceptors such as Sul1 physically interact with Sch9 in vitro and in vivo (33394033)
Sup35 の T341A/D 変異で GTPase 活性と eRF1/Sup4: Sup35 T341A/D mutations lower GTPase activity and binding to eRF1/Sup45, increasing readthrough (18267004)
Sus1 は Mex67 と Dbp5 の核膜周縁への結合に必要。Mex67・D: Sus1 is required for binding of Mex67 and Dbp5 to the nuclear periphery. Increasing Mex67 and Dbp5 rescues the defects of sus1Δ (35771153)
Sus1 は Mex67 と Dbp5 の核膜周縁への結合に必要（3577115: Sus1 is required for binding of Mex67 and Dbp5 to the nuclear periphery (35771153)
Sut1 は GAT2・HAP4・MGA1 などの発現を下げる（23223039: Sut1 lowers expression of GAT2, HAP4, MGA1, and others (23223039)
Sut1 は GAT2・HAP4・MGA1・MSN4・NCE102・PRR2・R: Sut1 lowers expression of GAT2, HAP4, MGA1, MSN4, NCE102, PRR2, RHO3, and RHO5 (23223039)
Sut1 は HAP4 などの発現を下げ、SUT1 の過剰発現は糸状成長を止める: Sut1 lowers expression of HAP4 and others, and SUT1 overexpression blocks filamentous growth (23223039)
Sut1・Sut2 はフェロモンに応じて接合阻害因子 NCE102・PRR2・R: Sut1 and Sut2 repress expression of the mating inhibitors NCE102, PRR2, and RHO5 in response to pheromone, promoting mating (23872066)
Suv3 単独ではヘリカーゼ活性がなく、Dss1 と複合体をつくったときにだけ現: Suv3 alone has no helicase activity; it appears only when Suv3 forms a complex with Dss1 (17658549)
Svf1 は組換え CK2α・CK2α′ と CK2 ホロ酵素の基質。試験管内で: Svf1 is a substrate of recombinant CK2α, CK2α′, and the CK2 holoenzyme. In vitro, up to six serines in its acidic region are phosphorylated. Svf1 co-precipitates with CK2β (18265947)
Svp26 が Mnt2・Mnt3 の COPII 小胞への取り込みを助け、sv: Svp26 helps incorporation of Mnt2 and Mnt3 into COPII vesicles, and they accumulate in the ER in svp26 deletion. They bind by co-immunoprecipitation (30700649)
Svp26 がないと Mnn2・Mnn5 が小胞体にとどまる。Mnn2・Mnn5: Without Svp26, Mnn2 and Mnn5 remain in the ER. Mnn2 and Mnn5 bind Svp26 in vivo (20236934)
Svp26 は Mnt2・Mnt3 の ER からの出口のアダプター（30700: Svp26 is an ER exit adaptor for Mnt2 and Mnt3 (30700649)
Swc6 と Arp6 は SWR1 複合体への Swc2 の会合とヌクレオソー: Swc6 and Arp6 are required for association of Swc2 with the SWR1 complex and for nucleosome binding (16299513)
Swc6 と Arp6 は SWR1 複合体への Swc2 の結合とヌクレオソー: Swc6 and Arp6 are required for binding of Swc2 to the SWR1 complex and for nucleosome binding (16299513)
Swd1-Swd3 二量体が無いと Set1 の量が大きく減る。複合体の形には: Without the Swd1-Swd3 dimer, Set1 levels drop greatly. Set1, Swd1, and Swd3 are required for the complex to form (16921172)
Swd1・Swd3 を除くと Set1 タンパク質が失われ、H3K4 メチル化が: Removing Swd1 and Swd3 causes loss of Set1 protein and complete loss of H3K4 methylation (22147691)
Swd2 のユビキチン化が、トリメチル化に必要な COMPASS の Spp1: Swd2 ubiquitination controls recruitment of the COMPASS subunit Spp1, which is required for trimethylation (18849979)
Swe1 による Cdk1 の抑制は APC-Cdc20 の活性化を妨げ、後期の: Inhibition of Cdk1 by Swe1 prevents APC-Cdc20 activation and blocks anaphase onset. This checkpoint requires Cdc55, and the cdc55Δ defect is reversed by mutating 12 Cdk1 sites in the APC (23751495). In the main text, phosphorylation of Cdc16 and others increases in cdc55Δ, and purified PP2A-Cdc55 dephosphorylates Cdk1-phosphorylated APC. Activation of APC-Cdc20 by Cdk1 requires the sites on Cdc16 and Cdc27

Swe1 の分解には核から出芽の首への移動が要り、首への移動には Swe1 と結: Swe1 degradation requires its movement from the nucleus to the bud neck, and movement to the neck requires Hsl7, which binds Swe1. Swe1-Hsl7 binding is indispensable for movement to the neck and degradation (12388757)
Swe1 は Hsl7 によって芽の首のセプチンに局在し、この局在が Swe1: Swe1 is localized to the septins at the bud neck by Hsl7, and this localization is required for Swe1 degradation. Hsl7 accumulation at the septin ring depends on the combination of two kinases, Hsl1 and Elm1, and Elm1 accumulation responds to bud emergence (27053666)
Swf1 が SNARE の Snc1・Syn8・Tlg1 を膜貫通部の近くのシ: Swf1 palmitoylates the SNAREs Snc1, Syn8, and Tlg1 at cysteines near their transmembrane domains (15973437)
Swh3（Rsc8）と Rsc6 が two-hybrid と試験管内で結合し、: Swh3 (Rsc8) and Rsc6 bind in two-hybrid and in vitro assays, and the swh3-ts mutation weakens binding. RSC6 is a multicopy suppressor of swh3-ts (9685490)
Swi4 の NLS による取り込みは Kap95 と Srp1 が担う（205: Import of Swi4 via its NLS is mediated by Kap95 and Srp1 (20587033)
Swi4 の NLS（371〜376）は核への移行に必要かつ十分で、この NLS: The Swi4 NLS (371-376) is necessary and sufficient for nuclear entry, and import via this NLS is mediated by Kap95 and Srp1 (20587033)
Swi5 は G1 期には核内、S・G2・M 期には細胞質にある。NLS 付近の: Swi5 is in the nucleus in G1 and in the cytoplasm in S, G2, and M phases. Changing three serines near the NLS makes it constitutively nuclear. These are phosphorylated while it is in the cytoplasm and are also phosphorylated in vitro by Cdc28-dependent H1 kinase, so a model in which Cdc28 directly controls nuclear entry is proposed (1652372)
Swi5 は M 期の終わりに核に入るとすぐに濃度依存的に EGT2 の転写を活: Swi5 activates EGT2 transcription in a concentration-dependent manner as soon as it enters the nucleus at the end of M phase (8668141)
Swi5 は Pcl2 と two-hybrid で結合し、試験管内で Pho8: Swi5 binds Pcl2 by two-hybrid and is phosphorylated by Pho80-Pho85 in vitro. In pho85 deletion, Swi5 activity appears to be disturbed (10692159)
Swi6 の体内での核への取り込みは Kap95 に依存する。Kap95 は S: In vivo nuclear import of Swi6 depends on Kap95. Kap95 mediates import of Swi4, Swi6, and Mbp1 and is indispensable for Start (20587033)
Swi6 の核外への移行には Clb6-Cdc28 による S160 のリン酸化: Nuclear export of Swi6 requires S160 phosphorylation by Clb6-Cdc28, and Swi6 returns to the nucleus with S160 dephosphorylation at the end of mitosis. Cdc14 moves Swi6 into the nucleus in vivo and dephosphorylates S160 in vitro (14993267). Because the in vivo results come from experiments in which Cdc14 was activated, confidence is medium
Swi6 の核外への輸送には S160 のリン酸化が要り、それには Clb6-C: Nuclear export of Swi6 requires S160 phosphorylation, which requires Clb6-Cdc28. Clb6-Cdc28 phosphorylates S160 in vitro. When Cdc14 dephosphorylates it at the end of M phase, it returns to the nucleus (14993267). Classified as inhibition because it moves a transcription factor out of the nucleus
Swm1/Apc13 は Cdc16 と Cdc27 の APC/C への安定な: Swm1/Apc13 promotes stable binding of Cdc16 and Cdc27 to the APC/C (15060174)
Swm1/Apc13 は必須サブユニット Cdc16 と Cdc27 が APC: Swm1/Apc13 promotes stable binding of the essential subunits Cdc16 and Cdc27 to the APC/C and is required for in vitro ubiquitin ligase activity and APC/C-dependent cell cycle progression in vivo (15060174)
Swm2 がないとスプライソソームの snRNA と U3 snoRNA のトリ: Without Swm2, trimethylation of spliceosomal snRNAs and U3 snoRNA is lost. Swm2 binds the N-terminus of Tgs1 (20621096)
Swp73 は Swi5 と Pho2 が結合するエンハンサーによる転写の活性化: Swp73 is required for transcriptional activation by the enhancer bound by Swi5 and Pho2 (8804308)
Swr1 の N 末端領域が Bdf1・Swc7・Arp4・Act1・Yaf9・: The Swr1 N-terminal region is necessary and sufficient for binding of Bdf1, Swc7, Arp4, Act1, Yaf9 and Swc4 (19088068)
Swr1 の N 末端領域は Bdf1・Swc7 などの複合体への結合に必要かつ: The Swr1 N-terminal region is necessary and sufficient for binding to the complex including Bdf1 and Swc7 (19088068)
Swr1 の N 末領域が Bdf1・Swc7・Arp4・Act1・Yaf9・S: The Swr1 N-terminal region is necessary and sufficient for binding of Bdf1, Swc7, Arp4, Act1, Yaf9 and Swc4 (19088068)
Swt1 は Mlp1・Nup60・Esc1 と遺伝学的に相互作用し、mlp1Δ: Swt1 genetically interacts with Mlp1, Nup60 and Esc1; in mlp1Δ, nuclease inactivation causes nuclear accumulation of poly(A)+ RNA (19127978)
Swt21p が無いと U1 の構成要素 Nam8p の遊離型が現れ、核への局在: Without Swt21p, a free form of the U1 component Nam8p appears and its nuclear localization is disturbed (40564906)
Sym1 は TOM 複合体を通り、TIM22 ではなく TIM23 複合体に依: Sym1 passes through the TOM complex and is inserted into and assembled in the inner membrane in a TIM23 complex-dependent, not TIM22-dependent, manner (23045398)
Syo1 は Rpl5 と Rpl11 の核への同時の取り込みを助ける輸送アダプ: Syo1 is a transport adaptor that facilitates the simultaneous nuclear import of Rpl5 and Rpl11. In vitro it binds Rpl5-Rpl11 and recruits Kap104 (23118189)
T319 がリン酸化された Ndd1 は Fkh2 の FHA ドメインに結合し: Ndd1 phosphorylated at T319 binds the FHA domain of Fkh2 and is recruited to CLB2 cluster promoters. T319A impairs transcription and growth. T319 phosphorylation and recruitment depend on Cdc28-Clb (12865300). Phosphorylation of Ndd1 by Cdc28-Clb2 promotes binding to the Fkh2 FHA domain (14521842)
T36 のリン酸化で Ydj1 が外れ、Ssa1 が Cln3 に結合して分解を: T36 phosphorylation releases Ydj1, allowing Ssa1 to bind Cln3 and promote its degradation. Pho85 phosphorylates T36 under nitrogen starvation and pheromone, and Cdk1 at G2/M (23217712)
TAE1 は N 末端メチル基転移酵素で、Rpl12ab と Rps25a/Rp: TAE1 is an N-terminal methyltransferase that modifies Rpl12ab and Rps25a/Rps25b. In the cytoplasm of the deletion strain, the Rps25 N-terminal peptide is not methylated (20481588)
TAF12 の ReNu 領域は SAGA・SLIK によるヌクレオソームのアセ: The ReNu region of TAF12 is required for nucleosome acetylation by SAGA and SLIK and regulates Gcn5 acetylation (32832935)
TAF40 は TFIIA と直接・特異的に結合。Toa2 の変異で結合を失うと: TAF40 binds TFIIA directly and specifically. Toa2 mutations that lose the binding cause conditional growth and transcription defects (11238911)
TAP で Nop19p は Dhr2p・Utp25p と優先して結合し、Utp: By TAP, Nop19p preferentially binds Dhr2p and Utp25p and is essential for incorporation of Utp25p into pre-ribosomes (21941128)
TAT1・TAT2 の発現は STP1 と STP2 に依存し、Tup1 がその: Expression of TAT1 and TAT2 depends on STP1 and STP2, and Tup1 binds their promoters (26546823)
TAX4 と IRS4 は INP51 の NPF モチーフに結合して活性化する: TAX4 and IRS4 bind the NPF motif of INP51 and activate it (15265867)
TBP と Spt3 は直接結合し、その面の変異で TBP が SAGA 依存の: TBP and Spt3 bind directly; mutations on that surface prevent TBP from coming to SAGA-dependent promoters and reduce transcriptional activation (18981477)
TCA17 か TRS33 の変異で Trs65 の TRAPP 複合体への結び: Mutation of TCA17 or TRS33 disturbs the association of Trs65 with the TRAPP complex and alters the localization of the Rab Ypt31 (19220810)
TDH3 の UAS のうち RAP1 結合配列だけの 22 塩基で完全な活性化: Within the TDH3 UAS, the 22 bases of the RAP1-binding sequence alone give full activation; RAP1-dependent activation is the main positive regulation of TDH3 expression (8075210)
TFC7 は τ55 をコードし、τ55 は TFIIIC の τ95 とともに: TFC7 encodes τ55, and τ55 was found together with the TFIIIC subunit τ95 in a complex separate from TFIIIC (9584160)
TFIID の Taf1・Taf4・Taf6・Taf10・Taf12 が Ino: The TFIID subunits Taf1, Taf4, Taf6, Taf10 and Taf12 bind the Ino2 activation domain in vitro (28994223)
TFIIH の構成要素の総当たりツーハイブリッドで Rad3–Tfb3、Tfb4: An all-against-all two-hybrid screen of TFIIH components newly found the Rad3–Tfb3, Tfb4–Ssl1 and Ssl2–Tfb2 interactions (10681587)
TFIIH の構成要素の総当たりツーハイブリッドで Tfb4–Ssl1 の結合（: Tfb4–Ssl1 binding in an all-against-all two-hybrid screen of TFIIH components (10681587)
TFIIIA の亜鉛フィンガー 1 には DNA 結合に要らず TFIIIC の: Zinc finger 1 of TFIIIA has residues dispensable for DNA binding but required for TFIIIC incorporation (17626045). The TFIIIA-DNA complex recruits TFIIIC, and cannot when the first finger is deleted (8496187)
TFIIIC の tau131 と Pol I/II/III 共通のサブユニット: The TFIIIC subunit tau131 and ABC10alpha, a subunit shared by Pol I/II/III, bind in vivo and in vitro, with the binding site at the ABC10alpha C terminus. rpc10-30 weakens the binding and is suppressed by overexpression of tau131-ΔTPR2 (10559229)
TFIIIE 活性は一部のリボソームタンパク質と共精製され、Rpl6Ap・Rpl: TFIIIE activity copurifies with some ribosomal proteins, and Rpl6Ap and Rpl6Bp bind the tRNA(Ile) gene. RPL6A is a strong multicopy suppressor of conditional TFIIIC mutants (19116144)
THI3 を変えると THI11/12/13・THI74 の発現が下がり PDC: Altering THI3 decreases expression of THI11/12/13 and THI74 and increases PDC1 (25494835)
THI6 の mRNA 量は細胞内のチアミン二リン酸で制御され、正の制御因子 T: THI6 mRNA levels are controlled by intracellular thiamine diphosphate and require the positive regulators THI2 and THI3 (7982968)
THO-Sub2 のクライオ電顕構造。THO は Tho2・Hpr1・Tex1・: Cryo-EM structure of THO-Sub2. THO consists of Tho2, Hpr1, Tex1, Mft1 and Thp2, assembled around the largest subunit Tho2 (33787496). THO has five subunits including Tex1 (22964977)
TIF34 と PRT1 の C 末端ヘリックスの複合体の結晶構造。結合面の変異: Crystal structure of the complex of TIF34 and the PRT1 C-terminal helix. Interface mutations release TIF34 and TIF35 from eIF3 in vivo (22090426)
TIM8-13 複合体は Tim23 の転位中間体の N 末端側に結合し、膜電位: The TIM8-13 complex binds the N-terminal side of the Tim23 translocation intermediate and is essential for Tim23 import when membrane potential is low (11101512)
TIP41 を欠くと、Sit4 に依存する Npr1 の脱リン酸化と Gln3: Without TIP41, Sit4-dependent Npr1 dephosphorylation and Gln3 nuclear translocation do not occur (11741537)
TIP41 を欠くとラパマイシンに強くなり、tap42 変異を抑え、Sit4 が: Loss of TIP41 confers strong rapamycin resistance, suppresses tap42 mutations, and Sit4 no longer dissociates from Tap42. TIP41 negatively regulates the TOR pathway by binding and inhibiting TAP42 (11741537)
TKL2 などはジオーキシックシフトでの誘導に Msn2/4 を要する（9495: Induction of TKL2 and others at the diauxic shift requires Msn2/4 (9495741)
TMP1 の MCB に Swi6 を含む複合体ができ、MCB は TMP1 の: A Swi6-containing complex forms on the TMP1 MCB, and the MCB is necessary and sufficient for late-G1 transcription of TMP1. Cell-cycle regulation is lost in swi6Δ (1608451). MCB-mediated regulation of replication genes depends on SWI6 (1409658)
TOR が働かないときリン酸化された Crf1 は核に集まり、Fhl1 への結合: When TOR is inactive, phosphorylated Crf1 accumulates in the nucleus, competes with Ifh1 for binding to Fhl1, and represses ribosomal protein gene transcription (15620355)
TOR にリン酸化された TAP42 が 2A 型ホスファターゼに結合して抑える: TAP42 phosphorylated by TOR binds and inhibits type 2A phosphatases (10604478 "possibly inhibits", 31213504 "TorC1 inhibits the PTap42–Sit4 complex"). 8756348 genetically places Tap42 acting in the same direction as Sit4, so the direction of the effect is disputed
TOR の経路が Npr1 をリン酸化し、それにより Tat2 の飢餓による分解: The TOR pathway phosphorylates Npr1, thereby inhibiting starvation-induced degradation of Tat2 (9843498)
TOR は MSN2 と Bmh2 の結合を促して細胞質に留め、炭素源で調節され: TOR promotes binding of MSN2 to Bmh2, retaining it in the cytoplasm and repressing expression of carbon source-regulated genes (10604478). TOR1 and TOR2 are not distinguished
TOR は MSN4 と Bmh2 の結合を促して細胞質に留め、炭素源で調節され: TOR promotes binding of MSN4 to Bmh2, retaining it in the cytoplasm and repressing expression of carbon source-regulated genes (10604478). TOR1 and TOR2 are not distinguished
TOR は Msn2 と細胞質の 14-3-3 タンパク質 Bmh2 の結合を促: TOR promotes binding of Msn2 to the cytoplasmic 14-3-3 protein Bmh2 and represses expression of carbon source-regulated genes (10604478)
TOR は Msn4 と細胞質の 14-3-3 タンパク質 Bmh2 の結合を促: TOR promotes binding of Msn4 to the cytoplasmic 14-3-3 protein Bmh2 and represses expression of carbon source-regulated genes (10604478)
TOR は PKA を介して YAK1 を抑え、CRF1 を細胞質にとどめる。T: TOR inhibits YAK1 via PKA, keeping CRF1 in the cytoplasm. When TOR is stopped, activated YAK1 phosphorylates and activates CRF1, and phosphorylated CRF1 accumulates in the nucleus and competes with IFH1 for binding to FHL1 (15620355)
TOR は PKA を介して YAK1 を負に調節し、CRF1 を細胞質にとどめ: TOR negatively regulates YAK1 via PKA, keeping CRF1 in the cytoplasm (15620355)
TOR negatively regulates YAK1 via PKA, keeping CRF1 in the cytoplasm (15620355). TOR controls the subcellular localization of the PKA catalytic subunit TPK1 and of YAK1 (14673167)
TOR は PKA を介して Yak1 を抑え Crf1 を細胞質にとどめる。T: TOR inhibits Yak1 via PKA, keeping Crf1 in the cytoplasm. When TOR becomes inactive, activated Yak1 phosphorylates and activates Crf1, which accumulates in the nucleus, competes with Ifh1, and represses ribosomal protein gene transcription (15620355)
TOR 依存の GLN3 リン酸化が URE2 との結合・細胞質保持に必要。TA: TOR-dependent GLN3 phosphorylation is required for binding to URE2 and cytoplasmic retention. Because it depends on TAP42 and is antagonized by SIT4, it is not described as direct phosphorylation by TOR
TOR 経路が NPR1 をリン酸化して働きを抑える。TOR がないと NPR1: The TOR pathway phosphorylates NPR1 and inhibits its activity. Without TOR, NPR1 is rapidly dephosphorylated, and TAP42 is involved in that dephosphorylation
TORC1 が Atg13 の複数の Ser を直接リン酸化する。リン酸化できな: TORC1 directly phosphorylates multiple Ser residues of Atg13. Non-phosphorylatable Atg13 activates Atg1 and induces autophagy even under nutrient-rich conditions
TORC1 が働かなくなると活性化される PP2A-Cdc55・PP2A-Rts: PP2A-Cdc55 and PP2A-Rts1, which are activated when TORC1 becomes inactive, dephosphorylate Atg13 and are required for Atg1 activation and autophagy induction
TORC1 が弱まると Mpk1 が Sic1 の T173 をリン酸化し、SC: When TORC1 weakens, Mpk1 phosphorylates Sic1 at T173, protecting it from SCF(Cdc4)-mediated degradation. PP2A(Cdc55) dephosphorylates this site but is inhibited by endosulfine (26356805). pT173 becomes a binding site for Cks1, turning Sic1 from a CDK target into an inhibitor (28496991)
TORC1 が弱まると Sic1 の C 末端（T173）のリン酸化が Sic1: When TORC1 weakens, phosphorylation of the Sic1 C terminus (T173) protects Sic1 from SCF(Cdc4)-mediated degradation. This requires T173 phosphorylation by Mpk1 and inhibition by endosulfine of PP2A(Cdc55), which dephosphorylates T173 (26356805, 28496991). Because PP2A(Cdc55) destabilizes Sic1, this is classed as inhibition
TORC1 が止まると Npr1 が働き、Orm1・Orm2 を直接リン酸化して: When TORC1 stops, Npr1 becomes active and directly phosphorylates and activates Orm1 and Orm2. Phosphorylated Orm promotes synthesis of complex sphingolipids
TORC1 と、その下流の Sit4・Npr1 が Aly のリン酸化と安定性を: TORC1 and its downstream Sit4 and Npr1 regulate Aly phosphorylation and stability. Without Sit4, Aly becomes hyperphosphorylated in an Npr1-dependent manner and unstable (35454122)
TORC1 の下流のリン酸化の解析で、Atg1 が Hom3 をリン酸化する候補: In an analysis of phosphorylation downstream of TORC1, Atg1 was proposed as a candidate kinase that phosphorylates Hom3 (25921291)
TORC1 の不活性化で活性化される PP2A-Cdc55 と PP2A-Rts: PP2A-Cdc55 and PP2A-Rts1, activated by TORC1 inactivation, are required for full dephosphorylation of Atg13 and autophagy induction after TORC1 inactivation. After rapamycin treatment, PP2A deletion strains are impaired in Atg13 dephosphorylation, Atg1 activation, PAS formation and autophagy, and the defects are suppressed by overexpression of non-phosphorylatable Atg13 (27973551)
TORC1 の基質 Sch9 が Amd1 をリン酸化する候補のキナーゼ（259: The TORC1 substrate Sch9 is a candidate kinase that phosphorylates Amd1 (25921291)
TORC1 の基質 Sch9 が転写抑制因子 Dot6・Tod6・Stb3 を直: The TORC1 substrate Sch9 directly phosphorylates and inhibits the transcriptional repressors Dot6, Tod6 and Stb3
TORC1 の標的 Sfp1 は、並行して働くもう一つの標的 Sch9 の TO: The TORC1 target Sfp1 negatively regulates TORC1-mediated phosphorylation of Sch9, another TORC1 target acting in parallel (19328065)
TORC1 の阻害が細胞壁の性質を変え、Wsc1・Wsc3・Wsc4 を通じて: TORC1 inhibition changes cell wall properties and activates the CWI pathway (Mpk1) through Wsc1, Wsc3 and Wsc4 (38949052)
TORC1 の阻害で酵母の 19S 組み立てシャペロンとプロテアソームサブユニッ: TORC1 inhibition induces all yeast 19S assembly chaperones and proteasome subunits (27462806). Main text: TORC1 inhibition induces Adc17 and increases proteasomes
TORC1 の阻害の下流で Mpk1 が RAC とプロテアソームサブユニットの: Downstream of TORC1 inhibition, Mpk1 increases the supply of RACs and proteasome subunits (27462806; main text: Mpk1 signaling is required for Adc17 induction). TORC1 inhibition raises Adc17 translation, which depends on Mpk1 activation (38949052)
TORC1 の阻害は Wsc1・Wsc3・Wsc4 を通して CWI 経路を活性: TORC1 inhibition activates the CWI pathway through Wsc1, Wsc3 and Wsc4, but this alone is not enough; Sch9 also needs to be inhibited (38949052)
TORC1 は 5S rDNA のクロマチンに結合し、Pol III の抑制因子: TORC1 binds 5S rDNA chromatin and controls phosphorylation of the Pol III repressor Maf1 and its binding to Pol III genes. TORC1 inhibits Maf1 translocation to the nucleolus, binds Maf1 in vivo, and phosphorylates Maf1 in vitro (19574957). Because it blocks the repressive activity of Maf1, this is classed as inhibition
TORC1 は AGC キナーゼ Ypk3 と PP1 の Glc7 を通して: TORC1 regulates phosphorylation of two Rps6 sites through the AGC kinase Ypk3 and the PP1 Glc7 (26582391). In the main text, Ypk3 becomes hypophosphorylated upon rapamycin, carbon source shift and nitrogen starvation; TORC1 phosphorylates Ypk3 in vitro, and Ypk3 purified from rapamycin-treated cells has reduced activity. Ypk3 with four C-terminal sites replaced by A cannot phosphorylate Rps6
TORC1 は Cbk1 のリン酸化を通して細胞質分裂後の細胞分離を抑える。T5: TORC1 inhibits post-cytokinesis cell separation through Cbk1 phosphorylation. A T574 phosphomimetic Cbk1 is inactive and reproduces TORC1-mediated inhibition of cell separation (37647291). The main text says "directly or indirectly", so direct is left blank
