Trm7 は Trm732 と結合して tRNA の C32 を 2'-O-メチ: Trm7 binds Trm732 and 2'-O-methylates tRNA C32 (in vivo and in vitro) (22912484)
Trm732 と Trm734 は Trm7 のメチル化活性に必要（355591: Trm732 and Trm734 are required for Trm7 methylation activity (35559166)
Trm9 は Trm112 と結合し、Trm112 は生体内で mcm5U34: Trm9 binds Trm112, and Trm112 is required for mcm5U34 formation in vivo. The complex forms mcm5U34 on tRNA in vitro (20400505)
Trs20 は Trs120 と結合し、その結合が TRAPP II の組み立て: Trs20 binds Trs120, and this binding is required for TRAPP II assembly and Ypt32 exchange activity (23465091)
Trs65 は Trs120・Trs130 と物理的に結合し、trs65 変異細: Trs65 physically binds Trs120 and Trs130; in trs65 mutant cells Trs130 is reduced and TRAPP II lacks GEF activity (17475775)
Trs85 は Trs20 があるときだけ TRAPP と結合し、Trs20 を: Trs85 binds TRAPP only in the presence of Trs20 and recruits core TRAPP to the PAS via Trs20. trs20ts is defective in autophagy (24329977)
Trs85 を含む TRAPPIII が Ypt1 を Atg9 小胞に載せ、T: Trs85-containing TRAPPIII loads Ypt1 onto Atg9 vesicles, and Trs85 and Ypt1 localize to the PAS in an Atg9-dependent manner (23129774)
Trx1 と Trx2 は同じくらいチオレドキシンペルオキシダーゼ Tsa1 の: Trx1 and Trx2 act about equally as cofactors of the thioredoxin peroxidase Tsa1. The requirement for thioredoxin in stationary phase is due to its function as a Tsa1 cofactor (11929546)
Trz1–Nuc1–ムタロターゼの安定な 6 量体で、Nuc1 の活性はムタロタ: A stable Trz1–Nuc1–mutarotase hexamer; Nuc1 activity is fully inhibited by mutarotase and partly by Trz1 (28899942)
Trz1・Nuc1・ムタロターゼ（YMR099C）は安定な複合体を作り、Nuc1: Trz1, Nuc1 and mutarotase (YMR099C) form a stable complex, and Nuc1 activity is fully inhibited by mutarotase (28899942)
Tsl1 がないと熱ストレスでの Tps1 の活性の上昇とトレハロースの蓄積が起: Without Tsl1, the increase in Tps1 activity and trehalose accumulation under heat stress do not occur (24380875). Tsl1 is a regulatory subunit of the Tps1-Tps2 complex (9837904)
Tsr1 と Dim1 は Rio2・Nob1・Dim2 のまとまりに周辺でつな: Tsr1 and Dim1 connect peripherally to the Rio2-Nob1-Dim2 assembly. Main text: Rio2 binds Tsr1 directly (21283762)
Tsr2 は放された eS26 に結合し、分解から守って 90S 前リボソームへ: Tsr2 binds released eS26, protects it from degradation and delivers it to 90S pre-ribosomes (25144938)
Tsr3 は Rio2 が離れた後に結合し、Rio2 の再結合を防いで組み立てを: Tsr3 binds after Rio2 leaves, preventing Rio2 rebinding and advancing assembly (35031584)
Tsr4 は翻訳と同時に Rps2 に結合し（N 末端の伸長部が必要）、Tsr4: Tsr4 binds Rps2 cotranslationally (requiring the N-terminal extension), and impairing Tsr4 reduces Rps2 levels (31182640)
Tti2 を減らすと Tra1・Mec1・Tor1 の量が減り、局在が変わり、そ: Depleting Tti2 reduces the levels of Tra1, Mec1 and Tor1, alters their localization, and impairs their respective stress responses (27172216)
Tub1 と Tub3 はそれぞれ Dyn1 経路と Kar9 経路の要素を呼び: Tub1 and Tub3 recruit components of the Dyn1 pathway and the Kar9 pathway, respectively, to optimize spindle positioning. Main text: without Tub3, accumulation of Bim1 and Kar9 at plus ends decreases (34739032)
Tul1 E3 リガーゼは Tul1・Dsc2・Dsc3・Ubx3 からなり、働: The Tul1 E3 ligase consists of Tul1, Dsc2, Dsc3 and Ubx3, and each subunit is required for its function (25078903)
Tul1 は Zrt3 の一部のユビキチン化に関わり、亜鉛が多いと Zrt3 が: Tul1 is involved in ubiquitination of part of Zrt3, and Zrt3 is degraded under high zinc. Both Tul1 and Rsp5 contribute to Zrt3 degradation (26527740)
Tup1 と Nhp6B の直接の結合を共沈降で確認（11095729）: Direct binding of Tup1 and Nhp6B confirmed by coprecipitation (11095729)
Tup1 の変異の解析で、STE2 の抑制には Tup1 が要り Cyc8 との: Analysis of Tup1 mutations shows that STE2 repression requires Tup1 but not its binding to Cyc8 (12136003). Ssn6 mutations affect repression of the a-specific gene STE2 (10821179)
Tup1 は HMLalpha1 プロモーターへの TBP・Pol II・TFI: Tup1 blocks recruitment of TBP, Pol II and TFIIH to the HMLalpha1 promoter, preventing preinitiation complex formation (18391020)
Tup1–Cyc8 は Sko1 に呼ばれて Sko1 依存の遺伝子 GRE2・: Tup1–Cyc8 is recruited by Sko1 and represses the Sko1-dependent genes GRE2 and AHP1 under normal, stress-free conditions (mutations relieve the repression)
Tus1 の働きと局在は Tus1 と結合する Ypl066w（Rgl1）に大き: Tus1 function and localization depend heavily on Ypl066w (Rgl1), which binds Tus1 (22344253)
Tus1（Rho1 の GEF）は Cln2-Cdc28 と結合し、Cln2-C: Tus1 (a Rho1 GEF) binds Cln2-Cdc28 and is phosphorylated in a Cln2-Cdc28-dependent manner. The CDK sites are required for Rho1 activation and actin polarity at G1/S (18256282)
Tvp23 は Tlg2 を含む区画に局在し、免疫沈降で Yip4・Yip5 と: Tvp23 localizes to Tlg2-containing compartments and forms an interaction network with Yip4 and Yip5 by immunoprecipitation (17178117)
Tyc1 は APC/C に結合して APC/C-Cdc20 と APC/C-C: Tyc1 binds APC/C, inhibits APC/C-Cdc20 and APC/C-Cdh1 activity in vitro, and blocks binding of Cdc20 and Cdh1 to APC/C (29883473)
U1 snRNP のクライオ電顕構造で、補助タンパク質は Prp42/Prp39: In the cryo-EM structure of the U1 snRNP, auxiliary proteins connect to the core via Prp42/Prp39 (29051543)
U3 snoRNP の組み立てを止めると Pwp2 は Dip2・Utp6・Ut: When U3 snoRNP assembly is blocked, Pwp2 accumulates in a complex with Dip2, Utp6, Utp13, Utp18 and Utp21 (15231838)
UAF は RRN5・RRN9・RRN10 がコードするタンパク質を含む多タンパ: UAF is a multiprotein transcription factor containing the proteins encoded by RRN5, RRN9 and RRN10 (8846924)
UAF は RRN5・RRN9・RRN10 にコードされる 3 つのタンパク質を: UAF is a multiprotein transcription factor containing three proteins encoded by RRN5, RRN9 and RRN10 (8846924)
UAF は Rrn5p・Rrn9p・Rrn10p・H3・H4 と p30 からな: UAF consists of Rrn5p, Rrn9p, Rrn10p, H3, H4 and p30, and the gene for p30 was identified as UAF30 (11500378)
UBI4 の熱ショック誘導は HSE と STRE が独立に担い、HSF・Msn: Heat-shock induction of UBI4 is mediated independently by HSE and STRE; it is induced when either HSF or Msn2/4 is missing, and drops sharply when both are missing (10048026)
UBP3 とその補因子 BRE5 を欠くと野生型の Tbp1 の分解が増え、Ga: Without UBP3 and its cofactor BRE5, degradation of wild-type Tbp1 increases and transcriptional activation by Gal4 and Gcn4 is impaired. Purified Ubp3 removes ubiquitin from Tbp1, and polyubiquitinated Tbp1 accumulates in ubp3Δ (in vitro and in vivo). Ubp3 is recruited to the GAL1 and HIS3 promoters upon induction (20738257)
UFD1 の変異で Mga2 の切断が止まり OLE1 の発現が消える（1159: UFD1 mutation blocks Mga2 cleavage and abolishes OLE1 expression (11598205)
UFD1 の変異で Spt23 の切断が止まり OLE1 の発現が消える（115: UFD1 mutation blocks Spt23 cleavage and abolishes OLE1 expression (11598205). Cdc48(Ufd1/Npl4) releases p90 and sends it to the nucleus (11733065)
UGA など窒素異化の遺伝子は Gln3 に正に、Dal80 に負に調節される。: Nitrogen catabolic genes such as UGA are regulated positively by Gln3 and negatively by Dal80. The GATA sites upstream of UGA4 are required for activation by Gln3 and also mediate Dal80 binding and response (8045902)
UGA1・UGA2・UGA4 の GABA による誘導には Uga3 と Uga: GABA induction of UGA1, UGA2 and UGA4 requires two positive transcription factors, Uga3 and Uga35/Dal81 (21708130)
UGA1・UGA2・UGA4 の誘導には Uga3 と Uga35/Dal81: Induction of UGA1, UGA2 and UGA4 requires two positive transcription factors, Uga3 and Uga35/Dal81 (21708130)
UGA2 を含む UGA 遺伝子の誘導には特異的な Uga3 と Uga35/D: Induction of UGA genes including UGA2 requires the specific positive factors Uga3 and Uga35/Dal81 (21708130)
UGA3-GLT1 の双方向プロモーターの転写活性化は Gcn4 と Gln3: Transcriptional activation of the UGA3-GLT1 bidirectional promoter is determined by cooperation of Gcn4 and Gln3, and Gcn5 contributes to its bidirectionality (16904075)
Transcriptional activation of the UGA3-GLT1 bidirectional promoter is determined by cooperation of Gcn4 and Gln3 (16904075)
UGA4 の GABA 誘導には Uga3 と Uga35/Dal81 が必要で: GABA induction of UGA4 requires Uga3 and Uga35/Dal81, and both bind the UGA4 promoter in a GABA-dependent manner (20581295)
ULA1 と UBA3 が一緒に RUB1 を活性化する E1 として働く。RU: ULA1 and UBA3 act together as the E1 that activates RUB1. UBC12 is also required for RUB1 conjugation (9545234)
ULA1 と UBA3 は E1 の N 末・C 末ドメインに似て、ともに RU: ULA1 and UBA3 resemble the N- and C-terminal domains of E1, and together perform an E1-like function in RUB1 activation (9545234)
UPC2 に応答し嫌気条件でも誘導される 9 遺伝子を同定し、そのうち AUS1: Nine genes responsive to UPC2 and induced under anaerobic conditions were identified; deletion of AUS1, PDR11 or DAN1 among them reduces sterol uptake (12077145)
UPF3 を欠くと Atg16 が増え、オートファジーが亢進。ATG16 は N: Without UPF3, Atg16 increases and autophagy is enhanced. ATG16 appears to be an NMD target (41668711)
UPR で eS7A の脱ユビキチン化酵素 Ubp3 が減る原因として、Ubp3: The SCF F-box protein Grr1, responsible for Ubp3 degradation, was identified as the cause of the decrease in Ubp3, the deubiquitinase of eS7A, during the UPR (40038285)
UPR を誘導する薬剤で GPC1 の mRNA が Hac1 依存に増える（3: UPR-inducing drugs increase GPC1 mRNA in a Hac1-dependent manner (37269946)
URA1・URA3 の転写は PPR1 に正に制御される。ppr1 破壊株などで: Transcription of URA1 and URA3 is positively controlled by PPR1. Transcripts were examined in ppr1 disruption strains and others; basal levels do not depend on PPR1 (3900423)
URA3 はウラシル飢餓で 3〜5 倍誘導され、これは転写活性化因子 PPR1: URA3 is induced 3-5-fold by uracil starvation, mediated by the transcriptional activator PPR1 (2204810)
URA8 などの ICRE をもつ遺伝子の制御は活性化因子 Ino2/Ino4: Regulation of ICRE-containing genes such as URA8 is mediated by the activators Ino2/Ino4 and the repressor Opi1. Ino2/Ino4 bind the promoters in vitro (16034810)
URA8 などの ICRE をもつ遺伝子はリン脂質前駆体で制御され、それは活性化: ICRE-containing genes such as URA8 are regulated by phospholipid precursors, mediated by the activators Ino2/Ino4 and the repressor Opi1. Ino2/Ino4 bind the promoters in vitro (16034810)
UTP-A・UTP-B の構成要素を減らすと Rrp36p が前リボソームに取り: Depleting UTP-A or UTP-B components prevents incorporation of Rrp36p into pre-ribosomes and reduces its levels. Depleting Rrp36p does not impair incorporation of each subcomplex (20038530)
UTP-B の構成要素を減らすと Rrp36p が前リボソームに取り込まれず量も: Depleting UTP-B components prevents incorporation of Rrp36p into pre-ribosomes and reduces its levels (20038530)
UV で誘導される Rpb1（RPO21）の分解は Cdc48-Ufd1-Npl: UV-induced degradation of Rpb1 (RPO21) depends on Cdc48-Ufd1-Npl4, Ubx4 and Ubx5. Cdc48 assists degradation at sites of stalled transcription (21211725)
UV や 4-NQO で Rpb1 のユビキチン化と分解が起こり、これには Rs: UV and 4-NQO cause Rpb1 ubiquitination and degradation, which require Rsp5 and the proteasome (10490634). Rsp5 binds the Rpb1 CTD and ubiquitinates it, and lowering RSP5 expression increases Rpb1 (9108033)
UV 照射の後、Snf1 は抑制因子 Mig3 を標的にし、UV で活性化される: After UV irradiation, Snf1 targets the repressor Mig3, and both Snf1 and Rad23 are required to remove Mig3 from the UV-activated HUG1 promoter (19680226). snf1 is sensitive to hydroxyurea, and Mig3 was found as a Snf1 target in this pathway (14993292)
Uba1 を条件的に不活化すると Acm1 が安定化し、ユビキチン経路が直接か間: Conditional inactivation of Uba1 stabilizes Acm1, so the ubiquitin pathway is required directly or indirectly (25072887)
Uba2-Aos1 が Smt3 を ATP 依存的に活性化し、uba2 の条件: Uba2-Aos1 activates Smt3 in an ATP-dependent manner, and conditional uba2 mutations abolish Smt3 conjugation in vivo (9312010)
Uba4 で活性化された Urm1 のチオカルボキシ基が Ncs2/Ncs6 に: The thiocarboxyl group of Urm1 activated by Uba4 is used for 2-thiouridine formation by Ncs2/Ncs6 (19151091)
Uba4 は Urm1 をアデニル化し、硫黄を直接 Urm1 に移す。Urm1: Uba4 adenylates Urm1 and transfers sulfur directly to Urm1. Urm1 acts as a sulfur carrier in tRNA thiolation and is important for responses to nutrient starvation and oxidative stress (19145231). Uba4 is required for attachment of Urm1 to Ahp1 in vivo (14555475)
Ubc1 がないと転写因子 Hcm1 が核に入れない。Ubc1 は転写を介して間: Without Ubc1, the transcription factor Hcm1 cannot enter the nucleus. Ubc1 indirectly regulates SNF1 through transcription (28357323)
Ubc12 の N 末端のアセチル化は、E3 の Dcn1 に依存した Nedd: N-terminal acetylation of Ubc12 determines the Dcn1 E3-dependent attachment of Nedd8 to Cul1. Acetylated Met1 is buried in a hydrophobic pocket of Dcn1 (21940857). Without MAK3, N-terminal acetylation of Ubc12 is lost in yeast, and Nedd8~Cul1 decreases only in strains lacking NatC. In vitro, acetylated Ubc12 greatly enhances Dcn1 E3 activity
Ubc7 の活性化因子 Cue1 の CUE ドメインが Ubc7 による K4: The CUE domain of Cue1, an activator of Ubc7, greatly promotes K48 polyubiquitination by Ubc7 (NMR and in vitro ubiquitination). Disrupting it delays degradation of ERAD substrates (27264873)
Ubc8 の C 末端の CK2 標的配列の多部位リン酸化が E2 を GID: Multisite phosphorylation of the CK2 target sequence in the Ubc8 C terminus tethers the E2 to the GID E3, forming a specific pairing (38113892). Main text: Ubc8 fully phosphorylated by CK2 has increased activity, and lacking either CKA1 or CKA2 delays Fbp1 degradation after glucose addition
Ubc8（Gid3）はグルコースで起こる FBPase のユビキチン化に関わり、: Ubc8 (Gid3) is involved in glucose-induced ubiquitination of FBPase, a prerequisite for proteasomal catabolite degradation (10811607)
Ubp10 は H2B からユビキチンを外し、UBP10 を欠く細胞では H2B: Ubp10 removes ubiquitin from H2B; in cells lacking UBP10, H2B ubiquitination increases and H3 K4 and K79 methylation also increase. Ubp10 localizes to silenced chromatin and supports telomeric silencing. Together with Ubp8 it determines the overall balance of H2B ubiquitination (15988024)
Ubp10 はユビキチン化 PCNA を脱ユビキチン化し、S 期にふつうに起こる: Ubp10 deubiquitinates ubiquitinated PCNA, which normally occurs in S phase. Ubp10 counteracts Rad18 action at PCNA K164, and misregulated expression impairs damage tolerance and causes MMS hypersensitivity (22829782). Ubp10 removes PCNA from chromatin through K164 deubiquitination, allowing timely ligation of Okazaki fragments (39294185)
Ubp10 は核小体にあり、ubp10Δ では pre-rRNA・成熟 rRNA: Ubp10 is nucleolar, and pre-rRNA, mature rRNA and translating ribosomes decrease in ubp10Δ. The largest subunit of RNA polymerase I (Rpa190) is stabilized by Ubp10-mediated deubiquitination, which is required for ribosome levels and growth (22902402)
Ubp12 は Fzo1 を安定にし融合を促すユビキチン鎖を認識して外す（233: Ubp12 recognizes and removes ubiquitin chains that stabilize Fzo1 and promote fusion (23317502). In ubp3 deletion, Ubp12, which removes the fusion-required polyubiquitin chains from Fzo1, is stabilized (29924334)
Ubp12 を失うと Ubp2 が安定になり、Fzo1 の上の融合を妨げるユビキ: Loss of Ubp12 stabilizes Ubp2, promoting removal of the fusion-inhibiting ubiquitin chains on Fzo1 (29309037)
Ubp15 は Pex1/Pex6 複合体の構成要素で、Pex5 からユビキチン: Ubp15 is a component of the Pex1/Pex6 complex and can remove ubiquitin from Pex5. Deletion reduces PTS1 import under stress (21665945)
Ubp2 と Ubp15 が Rsp5 に拮抗して ART の過剰なユビキチン化: Ubp2 and Ubp15 antagonize Rsp5 to prevent excessive ubiquitination and degradation of ARTs; lacking both destabilizes Art4 and impairs Hxt6 endocytosis (28298493)
Ubp2 と Ubp15 を欠くと Art4 が不安定になり Hxt6 のエンド: Lacking Ubp2 and Ubp15 destabilizes Art4 and impairs Hxt6 endocytosis (28298493)
Ubp2 は Fzo1 の分解を始め融合を止めるユビキチン鎖を外す（233175: Ubp2 removes ubiquitin chains that initiate Fzo1 degradation and block fusion (23317502). Ubp2 counteracts Mdm30-mediated degradation of Fzo1 (28607491)
Ubp2 は Mdm30 による Fzo1 の分解に逆らい、Mdm30 は Ub: Ubp2 counteracts Mdm30-mediated degradation of Fzo1, and Mdm30 targets Ubp2 for degradation, triggering Rsp5-mediated fatty acid desaturation (28607491)
Ubp2 は Rup1 を介して Rsp5 と結合し、Rsp5 と拮抗する（ub: Ubp2 binds Rsp5 via Rup1 and antagonizes Rsp5 (ubp2Δ and rup1Δ suppress rsp5-1, and Ubp2 reverses ubiquitination of Rsp5 substrates) (15933713). Ubp2 removes Rsp5 autoubiquitination in vivo and in vitro (24069405)
Ubp3 は Bre5 と組んではじめて活性のある脱ユビキチン化複合体になり、特: Ubp3 becomes an active deubiquitinating complex only when paired with Bre5, and removes ubiquitin from specific substrates (12778054)
Ubp3 は RNAPII、Def1、Spt5、TFIIF と一緒に精製され、試: Ubp3 copurifies with RNAPII, Def1, Spt5 and TFIIF, and deubiquitinates mono- and polyubiquitinated RNAPII in vitro. In ubp3 cells, ubiquitinated RNAPII increases and RNAPII degradation after UV irradiation is faster (18498751). Because the effect is maintenance of levels (preventing degradation), confidence is medium
Ubp3 はプロテアソームによるエルゴステロール合成酵素 Erg1・Erg3 の: Ubp3 enhances proteasomal degradation of the ergosterol biosynthetic enzymes Erg1 and Erg3 (33524398)
Ubp3 は補因子 Bre5 と活性のある脱ユビキチン化複合体をつくり、COPI: Ubp3 forms an active deubiquitinating complex with its cofactor Bre5 and rescues the COPII component Sec23 from proteasomal degradation (12778054). Sec23 ubiquitination is mediated by Rsp5 (20846524)
Ubp6 はプロテアソームの基部とサブユニット Rpn1 を認識する。プロテアソ: Ubp6 recognizes the proteasome base and the subunit Rpn1. Binding to the proteasome activates Ubp6 300-fold (12408819)
Ubp8 も H2B からユビキチンを外し、ubp8Δ の細胞では H2B のユ: Ubp8 also removes ubiquitin from H2B, and in ubp8Δ cells H2B ubiquitination increases about as much as in ubp10Δ. In ubp8Δ, neither H3K4/K79 methylation nor telomeric silencing changes. Lacking both increases H2B ubiquitination synergistically (15988024)
Ubp9 と Ubp13 は Duf1 と直接結合し、Duf1 は組換え Ubp: Ubp9 and Ubp13 bind Duf1 directly, and Duf1 enhances the DUB activity of recombinant Ubp9 and Ubp13 in vitro. duf1Δ has the same respiratory phenotype as ubp9Δ ubp13Δ (22723847)
Ubp9 と Ubp13 は Duf1 と直接結合し、Duf1 は試験管内で両者: Ubp9 and Ubp13 bind Duf1 directly, and Duf1 enhances the DUB activity of both in vitro (22723847)
Ubr2 と直接結合する E2 の Rad6 も Rpn4 のユビキチン依存の分: The E2 Rad6, which binds Ubr2 directly, is also required for ubiquitin-dependent degradation of Rpn4 (15504724)
Ubs1 は Cdc34 の活性の一般的な正の調節因子として働く（過剰発現での抑: Ubs1 acts as a general positive regulator of Cdc34 activity (suppression by overexpression, exacerbation by deletion) (8552096)
Ubx2 の一部は TOM 複合体に結合し、AAA ATPase の Cdc48: A fraction of Ubx2 binds the TOM complex and recruits the AAA ATPase Cdc48 to remove precursors clogging the TOM channel (31118508)
Ubx3 はエンドサイトーシスの被覆の新しい構成要素で、早く来る Ede1 の動: Ubx3 is a new component of the endocytic coat that regulates the dynamics of the early-arriving Ede1 and patch lifetime (26362318)
Ufd2 は U-box で同族の E2 Ubc4 と結合し、Ubc4 の活性部: Ufd2 binds its cognate E2 Ubc4 through its U-box and transfers ubiquitin from the Ubc4 active site (17890322)
Ugo1 の外膜への挿入は Mim1 が中心に担い、TOM の孔は要らない（21: Insertion of Ugo1 into the outer membrane is mainly mediated by Mim1, and the TOM pore is not required (21825074)
Ugo1 前駆体の最初の認識に Tom70（Tom20 ではない）が関わる。挿入: Tom70 (not Tom20) is involved in the initial recognition of the Ugo1 precursor. Insertion is mainly mediated by Mim1 (21825074)
Uip4 の発現は Sch9 の下流で転写因子 Msn2 に制御され、栄養とエネ: Uip4 expression is controlled by the transcription factor Msn2 downstream of Sch9, responding to nutrient and energy status (41757620)
Ulp2 の S734 は Cdc5 と PP2A-Rts1 で制御される。Rt: Ulp2 S734 is controlled by Cdc5 and PP2A-Rts1. Without Rts1, polySUMOylation occurs earlier, and ulp2-S734A suppresses this (41739101)
Ulp2 の S734 は Cdc5 と PP2A-Rts1 で調節され、このリ: Ulp2 S734 is regulated by Cdc5 and PP2A-Rts1; this phosphorylation lowers the affinity of Ulp2 for SUMO chains, leading to polySUMOylation. Non-phosphorylatable ulp2-S734A suppresses polySUMOylation caused by CDC5 overexpression (41739101). 18022565 is a chemical-genetic screen
Ume6 の分解の第 1 段階は Gcn5（SAGA）によるアセチル化と Rpd: The first step of Ume6 degradation is determined by acetylation by Gcn5 (SAGA) and deacetylation by Rpd3. In acetate medium, lacking RPD3 accelerates Ume6 degradation, and non-acetylatable mutations protect it. However, in rpd3Δ on glucose medium Ume6 increases about 2-fold (22438583, main text). Because the effect reverses depending on conditions, confidence is medium
Ume6 は ATG8 の転写を抑える因子で、Sin3・Rpd3 を含むヒストン: Ume6 represses ATG8 transcription, acting with a histone deacetylase complex containing Sin3 and Rpd3. Lacking any of them increases Atg8 and enhances autophagy (22733735). During growth, Ume6-Sin3-Rpd3 represses ATG8 transcription (22960621)
Ume6 は PIS1 の発現の正の調節因子で、イノシトールによる誘導に必要。C: Ume6 is a positive regulator of PIS1 expression and is required for its induction by inositol. ChIP shows that Ume6 directly controls PIS1 (19019152)
Ume6-Sin3-Rpd3 の脱アセチル化複合体が、外から窒素があるあいだ C: The Ume6-Sin3-Rpd3 deacetylase complex represses synthesis of CAR1 and CAR2 while exogenous nitrogen is present (10809695)
UniProt の向きと一致。Mon1-Ccz1 は Rab5 の効果因子で、膜: Consistent with the UniProt direction. Mon1-Ccz1 is a Rab5 effector, and membrane Rab5 promotes Ypt7 activation. This process is regulated by Yck3 phosphorylating Mon1 and blocking its binding to Rab5 (32391792 summary). In the main text, GEF activity of the phosphorylated complex is strongly reduced (in vitro). Release of Mon1 from the vacuole requires Yck3 phosphorylation (24623720)
UniProt の向きと一致。Vac14 は通常時と高浸透圧時に Fab1 の活: Consistent with the UniProt direction. Vac14 regulates Fab1 activity under normal and hyperosmotic conditions, supporting PI(3,5)P2 synthesis (called a Fab1 activator in the title, 11889142). Vac7 and Vac14 regulate Fab1 activity independently (16492811)
UniProt の向きと一致。Vac7 と Vac14 は独立に Fab1 の活: Consistent with the UniProt direction. Vac7 and Vac14 regulate Fab1 activity independently (summary). In the main text, Vac7 is the main activator of Fab1 and further activates Fab1 upon hyperosmotic shock (16492811). PI(3,5)P2 is nearly undetectable in vac7 deletion (11950935)
UniProt の向きと一致。Vma13 は Ynd1 の細胞質ドメインに結合し: Consistent with the UniProt direction. Vma13 binds the cytoplasmic domain of Ynd1, and vma13 deletion greatly increases the ADP-hydrolyzing activity of membrane Ynd1. The presence of Vma13, not V-ATPase function, inhibits Ynd1 activity (10954728)
UniProt の向きと一致。sec14(ts) を 37 度に移すと Nte1: Consistent with the UniProt direction. Shifting sec14(ts) to 37 degrees reduces Nte1-mediated intracellular GPCho accumulation, and Sec14 acts as a positive regulator of Nte1-mediated PC deacylation (15611060)
UniProt の向きと一致。精製 Sst2 は Gpa1 の GTP 加水分解: Consistent with the UniProt direction. Purified Sst2 is a GAP that strongly promotes GTP hydrolysis by Gpa1 and binds most strongly to the Gpa1 transition state (9537998). Sst2 is the main in vivo regulator of Gpa1-mediated signaling, and sst2 deletion increases pheromone sensitivity (16467474)
Upc2 と Ecm22 は ERG2 を含む ERG 遺伝子のプロモーターに結: Upc2 and Ecm22 bind the promoters of ERG genes including ERG2 and activate them upon sterol depletion (16055745)
Upf1 との結合を壊す Nmd2 の変異は NMD を失わせる（8601282: Nmd2 mutations that disrupt binding to Upf1 abolish NMD (8601282)
Ups1 は Mgm1 の特別なプロセシングと正常なミトコンドリアの形に必要（1: Ups1 is required for the special processing of Mgm1 and normal mitochondrial morphology (16754953)
Ups1 は Yme1 とメタロペプチダーゼ Atp23 の両方で分解される（2: Ups1 is degraded by both Yme1 and the metallopeptidase Atp23 (20657548)
Ups2 の分解は i-AAA プロテアーゼ Yme1 が担い、Ups1 は Y: Ups2 degradation is mediated by the i-AAA protease Yme1, and Ups1 is degraded by both Yme1 and the metallopeptidase Atp23 (20657548)
Ure2 は Gln3 に直接作用して転写活性化を妨げる。TOR 依存のリン酸化: Ure2 acts directly on Gln3 to block transcriptional activation. TOR-dependent phosphorylation makes GLN3 bind URE2 and stay in the cytoplasm
Ure2 は Gln3・Gat1 の局在と転写活性化を抑え、窒素が十分な細胞で: Ure2 inhibits the localization and transcriptional activation of Gln3 and Gat1, and is thought to retain them in the cytoplasm as a Ure2-Gat1 complex in nitrogen-replete cells (23184930)
Ure2/Gln3 が窒素カタボライト抑制を通じて IRC7 の転写を制御する（: Ure2/Gln3 control IRC7 transcription through nitrogen catabolite repression (18462383)
Urm1・Uba4・Tum1・Ncs2・Ncs6 が 2-チオ化に必要。Urm1: Urm1, Uba4, Tum1, Ncs2 and Ncs6 are required for 2-thiolation. The thiocarboxyl group of Urm1 is used in the reaction by Ncs2/Ncs6 (19151091)
Urn1 は Prp19 と直接相互作用し、U2・U5・U6 snRNA やスプ: Urn1 interacts directly with Prp19 and copurifies with U2, U5 and U6 snRNAs and splicing factors (21386897)
Usa1 の C 末端に Der1 が結合し、可溶性基質の分解に要る（20005: Der1 binds the Usa1 C terminus, which is required for degradation of soluble substrates (20005842)
Usa1 の N 末端は Hrd1 と結合して Der1 と Hrd1 をつなぎ: The Usa1 N terminus binds Hrd1, linking Der1 and Hrd1 and causing oligomerization of the HRD complex (a prerequisite for membrane protein degradation) (20005842)
Utp12p:Utp13p のヘテロ二量体が Pwp2p・Utp21p の C: The Utp12p:Utp13p heterodimer is incorporated into UTP-B via the C termini of Pwp2p and Utp21p (28600509)
Utp22 と Rrp7 の共結晶構造。Rrp7 は変形した RRM とリンカー: Cocrystal structure of Utp22 and Rrp7. Rrp7 binds Utp22 extensively through a distorted RRM and a linker (24130456)
Utp22 は Tys1 と直接結合し、Tys1 が tRNA と結合していると: Utp22 binds Tys1 directly, and the binding is stronger when Tys1 is bound to tRNA (23194188)
Utp25 の DUF1253 ドメインが Utp3（Sas10）との結合に必要: The DUF1253 domain of Utp25 is necessary and sufficient for binding to Utp3 (Sas10) (20884785)
Utp25 は SSU プロセッソームの構成要素で、共免疫沈降と two-hyb: Utp25 is a component of the SSU processome and binds Mpp10 by coimmunoprecipitation and two-hybrid (20884785)
Utp30 と Nep1 は 90S 前駆体の形成で共に働く（遺伝学と生化学）。: Utp30 and Nep1 work together in 90S precursor formation (genetics and biochemistry). High expression of UTP30 partly restores growth of nep1-1(ts) (22588997)
Utp6 の HAT 領域が Utp21 の特定のペプチドに結合する（Kd 10: The HAT region of Utp6 binds a specific peptide of Utp21 (Kd 10 μM) (18725399)
Utp6 の N 末端領域が Utp18 と結合する（18725399）: The N-terminal region of Utp6 binds Utp18 (18725399)
Utp7 は Sli15 に結合して局在を制御し、後期の前に Sli15 が紡錘: Utp7 binds Sli15 and controls its localization, preventing premature accumulation of Sli15 on the spindle before anaphase (18794331)
Utp8 と Utp9 は直接結合し、その結合で Utp8 が U3 snoRN: Utp8 and Utp9 bind directly, and this binding attaches Utp8 to the U3 snoRNA and SSU processome (20138832)
Utp9 は Msn5 による逆行 tRNA の核外再輸送を助け、Utp8・Gs: Utp9 assists Msn5-mediated nuclear re-export of retrograde tRNA and binds Utp8, Gsp1 and Msn5 directly in vitro (19812255)
V-ATPase の活性が失われると Pma1 が補償的に細胞膜から取り込まれる: When V-ATPase activity is lost, Pma1 is compensatorily internalized from the plasma membrane. The calcium-responsive phosphatase (calcineurin) and the glucose-sensitive Glc7 show negative synthetic interactions with vma mutations, and both are essential for Pma1 ubiquitination and endocytic downregulation (29254995)
V1 の柄のサブユニット Vma7（F）と Vma8（D）の相互作用を示した（9: Showed the interaction between the V1 stalk subunits Vma7 (F) and Vma8 (D) (9334266)
VINE が Glc7 を呼び込み、BLOC-1 の Kxd1 の脱リン酸を導き: VINE recruits Glc7, directs dephosphorylation of the BLOC-1 subunit Kxd1, and strengthens Kxd1 binding to Msb3 (42412525)
VINE は GEF サブユニット Vrl1 のアンキリン反復ドメインを通じてホ: VINE recruits the phosphatase Glc7 through the ankyrin-repeat domain of the GEF subunit Vrl1 (42412525)
VMA11 破壊株の液胞には subunit c（VMA3 産物）も subun: In VMA11 deletion strain vacuoles, neither subunit c (the VMA3 product) nor subunits a and b are assembled, and activity and vacuolar acidification are lost (1837023)
VPS9 ドメインをもつ Muk1 は Vps21・Ypt52・Ypt53 に対: Muk1, which has a VPS9 domain, acts as a second GEF for Vps21, Ypt52 and Ypt53. In vivo it partly overlaps with Vps9, and vps9Δ muk1Δ shows trafficking defects closely resembling the multiple Rab5 deletion (23612966). Consistent with the GO direction (activation)
VTH1・VTH2 の過剰発現で vps10Δ の誤輸送が抑えられるが、VTH1: Overexpression of VTH1 and VTH2 suppresses the missorting of vps10Δ, but disruption of VTH1 and VTH2 does not affect transport of proteinase A (Pep4) (8662642)
Vac14 がないと Fig4-GFP は液胞に局在しない。Fig4 は Vac: Without Vac14, Fig4-GFP does not localize to the vacuole. Fig4 physically binds Vac14 (14528018)
Vac8 のパルミトイル化は液胞の融合に必須。Pfa3 は体内で Vac8 の膜: Palmitoylation of Vac8 is essential for vacuole fusion. Pfa3 promotes membrane binding and palmitoylation of Vac8 in vivo, and partially purified Pfa3 palmitoylates Vac8 in vitro. Lacking Pfa3, vacuoles fragment under stress (16186255). Vac8 palmitoylation is important for its functions such as vacuole fusion (19416974)
Vac8 は Atg13 と結合して Atg1 開始複合体を呼び寄せ、PAS を: Vac8 binds Atg13 to recruit the Atg1 initiation complex and tethers the PAS to the vacuolar membrane. Deletion or mislocalization of VAC8 lowers autophagy activity (32508216). Vac8 and Apg13 (Atg13) bind in two-hybrid and co-precipitation (10837477)
Var1 を欠く小サブユニットには Mrp2 が入らず、Var1 が Mrp2: Mrp2 is not incorporated into small subunits lacking Var1; Var1 is important for Mrp2 incorporation (7770043)
Vhs2 は Cdc14 の新しい基質で、分裂直前に脱リン酸化されセプチンの構成: Vhs2 is a new substrate of Cdc14, is dephosphorylated just before division, and is involved in septin organization (24646733)
Vhs2 は S 期から核分裂までリン酸化され、細胞分裂直前に脱リン酸化される。: Vhs2 is phosphorylated from S phase to nuclear division and dephosphorylated just before cell division. This is controlled by Cdk1 and Cdc14 (24646733)
Vhs3 は生体内で Ppz1 の C 末端の触媒部分に結合し、試験管内で Pp: Vhs3 binds the C-terminal catalytic part of Ppz1 in vivo and inhibits Ppz1 phosphatase activity in vitro. The phenotypes of vhs3 mutation and overexpression resemble Hal3 and are opposite to Ppz1 (15192104)
Vik1 は Kar3 と結合し、栄養増殖期の Kar3 の紡錘体極への集積には: Vik1 binds Kar3, and accumulation of Kar3 at spindle poles during vegetative growth requires Vik1 (not Cik1) (10087265)
Vma12/Vma22 複合体は Vph1 と直接・一過的に結合する（96608: The Vma12/Vma22 complex binds Vph1 directly and transiently (9660861)
Vma12（VPH2）と Vma22 は安定な膜結合の複合体をつくる（96608: Vma12 (VPH2) and Vma22 form a stable membrane-bound complex (9660861)
Vma3p を欠く細胞では HXK2 の発現が下がる（RT-PCR）（28899: HXK2 expression is lowered in cells lacking Vma3p (RT-PCR) (28899778)
Vma5（C）と Vma10（G）はどちらも Vma4（E）と強く結合する。Vm: Vma5 (C) and Vma10 (G) both bind Vma4 (E) strongly. Mutations in the Vma4 N-terminus disrupt binding to Vma5 and are nonfunctional in vivo as well (15751969)
Vma7（F）と Vma8（D）の相互作用を示した（9334266）: Showed the interaction between Vma7 (F) and Vma8 (D) (9334266)
Vms1 はミトコンドリア表面で 60S リボソームに結合して Rqc2 に逆ら: Vms1 binds 60S ribosomes at the mitochondrial surface, antagonizes Rqc2, promotes import and prevents aggregation (29107329)
Voa1 は Vma21 と V0 のプロテオリピドのリングに最も強く結合し、V: Voa1 binds most strongly to Vma21 and the V0 proteolipid ring, and dissociates after V0 assembly (18799613)
Vph1 のテザーを縮めると V0 の d サブユニットが組み込まれず、VMA6: Shortening the Vph1 tether prevents incorporation of the V0 d subunit, restored by adding VMA6 (19473972)
Vps1 の S599 は Pho85 に体内・試験管内でリン酸化され、S599: Vps1 S599 is phosphorylated by Pho85 in vivo and in vitro, and mutation of S599 causes defects in scission of endocytic vesicles (26711254)
Vps2 は MIT ドメインで直接、Vps60 は Vta1 を介して Vps: Vps2 stimulates Vps4 ATPase activity directly via its MIT domain, and Vps60 via Vta1 (18194652)
Vps2 は Vps4 を直接、Vps60 は Vta1 を介して促し、Did2: Vps2 activates Vps4 directly and Vps60 via Vta1, and Did2 activates Vps4 ATPase activity by both mechanisms depending on context (18194652)
Vps20 が Doa4 の N 末端に結合して、ILV 形成を促す Doa4: Vps20 binds the N-terminus of Doa4 and inhibits a non-catalytic function of Doa4 that promotes ILV formation (23444383). Through binding to Vps20, deubiquitination of ILV cargo is inhibited (28057764)
Vps25 の 2 つの PPXY モチーフが Vps22・Vps36 と接し、: The two PPXY motifs of Vps25 contact Vps22 and Vps36, and mutations disrupt ESCRT-II (15469844)
Vps28 の C 末端が Vps36 の NZF-N ドメインにナノモルの親和: The C-terminus of Vps28 binds the NZF-N domain of Vps36 with nanomolar affinity, linking ESCRT-I and ESCRT-II (17215868)
Vps2–Vps24 の下位複合体が Vps20–Snf7 の複合体に結合する（: The Vps2–Vps24 subcomplex binds the Vps20–Snf7 complex (12194857)
Vps3 と Vps39 は Vps11 の C 末端の共通領域で Vps-C: Vps3 and Vps39 bind the Vps-C core via a common C-terminal region of Vps11 (21325627)
Vps33 は Vam3・Vam7・Nyv1 の SNARE ドメインと、四者の: Vps33 binds directly to the SNARE domains of Vam3, Vam7 and Nyv1 and to the four-component SNARE complex (23051737)
Vps5 と Vps17 は C 末端のコイルドコイルで結合し二量体を作る（12: Vps5 and Vps17 bind via their C-terminal coiled coils to form a dimer (12181349)
Vps501 の液胞膜への局在は Sea1 との直接の結合に依存する（35098: Localization of Vps501 to the vacuolar membrane depends on direct binding to Sea1 (35098628)
Vps51p が Vps52/53/54 と t-SNARE Tlg1p の結び: Vps51p mediates the association of Vps52/53/54 with the t-SNARE Tlg1p, binding the N-terminal domain of Tlg1p (12686613)
Vps52・Vps53・Vps54 は 1:1:1 の複合体として共免疫沈降し、: Vps52, Vps53 and Vps54 co-immunoprecipitate as a 1:1:1 complex required for sorting at the late Golgi (10637310)
Vps52・Vps53・Vps54 は 1:1:1 の複合体（10637310）: Vps52, Vps53 and Vps54 form a 1:1:1 complex (10637310)
Vps55 と Vps68 は複合体を作り、ESCRT と共に、あるいはその下流: Vps55 and Vps68 form a complex and regulate endosomal transport together with, or downstream of, ESCRT (18216282)
Vps74 のゴルジへの局在には Pik1 による PtdIns4P の合成が続: Golgi localization of Vps74 requires ongoing synthesis of PtdIns4P by Pik1 (20026658)
Vps74 は Sac1 の触媒ドメインに直接結合（KD 3.8 μM）。vps: Vps74 binds the Sac1 catalytic domain directly (KD 3.8 μM). PtdIns4P in the medial Golgi increases in vps74Δ and sac1Δ (22553352)
Vrg4（GMT）の細胞質側の C 末端ペプチドが COPI の Ret2 に結: The cytosolic C-terminal peptide of Vrg4 (GMT) binds the COPI subunit Ret2, and mutant GMT with weak binding is transported to the vacuole (15494368)
Vrp1 は Las17 結合ドメインで Las17 に結合して、または N 末: Vrp1 localizes to cortical patches either by binding Las17 through its Las17-binding domain or independently of Las17 via its N-terminal side. The binding is essential for actin patch polarization at high temperature (20816901)
Vtc2 は SPX-SPX の相互作用で触媒サブユニット Vtc4 を抑える。: Vtc2 inhibits the catalytic subunit Vtc4 through SPX-SPX interaction. Inositol pyrophosphate binding releases this and activates VTC (37156835)
Vts1 は Ccr4-Pop2-Not による脱アデニル化を介して mRNA: Vts1 promotes mRNA decay via Ccr4-Pop2-Not-mediated deadenylation and binds this complex (18469165)
W303 由来で Ybp1 に終止変異がある株では、Gpx3 ではなく Tsa1: In W303-derived strains with a stop mutation in Ybp1, Tsa1 rather than Gpx3 is required for Yap1 activation (15706081). Tsa1 binds Yap1 via a disulfide bond and drives formation of the Yap1 intramolecular disulfide bond (active form) (19106090). Confidence is medium because it is strain-restricted
WEE1 は H2B Tyr37 をリン酸化する酵素で、その発現を失うか阻害する: WEE1 is the enzyme that phosphorylates H2B Tyr37; loss or inhibition of its expression abolishes this H2B phosphorylation in both yeast and mammalian cells and increases histone gene transcription. In yeast, H2B (Y40) is not phosphorylated in swe1Δ (22885324)
WSC1・WSC2・WSC3 は熱ストレス下で細胞壁の健全性を保つ受容体で、遺伝: WSC1, WSC2 and WSC3 are receptors that maintain cell wall integrity under heat stress and are placed genetically upstream of the MPK1 cascade (11589572)
WSC1・WSC2・WSC3 は細胞壁の維持に要り、遺伝学的に PKC1 の上流: WSC1, WSC2 and WSC3 are required for cell wall maintenance, are positioned genetically upstream of PKC1, and are thought to be involved in PKC1 activation (9391108)
WTM2 の高発現で DNA 損傷なしに RNR3-lacZ が上がり、Wtm2: High expression of WTM2 raises RNR3-lacZ without DNA damage, and Wtm2 binds the RNR3 promoter (likely directly). It amplifies RNR3 induction under replication stress (16980392)
WWM1 の過剰発現は増殖停止とクローン死を起こし、MCA1 の同時の過剰発現で: WWM1 overexpression causes growth arrest and clonal death, suppressed by simultaneous overexpression of MCA1 (12062425)
War1 が PDR12 の転写誘導を担い、WARE に試験管内・生体内で結合す: War1 is responsible for transcriptional induction of PDR12 and binds the WARE in vitro and in vivo. The deletion strain cannot induce Pdr12 with sorbic acid (12588995)
Whi2 は低アミノ酸に応じて TORC1 の活性と増殖を抑えるのに必要な負の調: Whi2 is a negative regulator required to inhibit TORC1 activity and growth in response to low amino acids, but not needed under low glucose (30142151). The Whi2-Psr1-Psr2 complex inhibits TORC1 under low leucine but not in the absence of a nitrogen source (40103213)
Whi3 は CLN3 の mRNA に特異的に結合して細胞質の点に集め、Cln: Whi3 specifically binds CLN3 mRNA, concentrates it in cytoplasmic foci, and negatively regulates Cln3 (11691832). Whi3 binds Cdc28, and in whi3 deletion Cln3 and Cdc28 accumulate in the nucleus from early G1 (14685274). whi3 mutation increases the half-life, level and translation efficiency of CLN3 mRNA, which can explain the small cell size (24386402)
Whi3 は PKA にリン酸化され、S568 のリン酸化は Whi3 の働きを: Whi3 is phosphorylated by PKA, and phosphorylation at S568 inhibits Whi3 function. Phosphorylation reduces binding of Whi3 to the mRNA of the G1 cyclin CLN3 and is required for progression to G1/S. The phosphomimetic S568D prevents switching to sporulation and invasive growth (23471970)
Whi5 の核への取り込みは Kap95 と Cse1 に依存し、N 末端の 2: Nuclear import of Whi5 depends on Kap95 and Cse1 and is mediated by two classical N-terminal NLSs (acting redundantly) (19713766)
Whi5 は SBF に安定に結合する成分で、G1 期の初めに SBF を介して: Whi5 is a stably bound component of SBF; early in G1 it associates with G1 gene promoters via SBF and leaves upon transcriptional activation. It is released by Cln3/CDK phosphorylation (15210110). Whi5 represses G1/S transcription, and CDK phosphorylation relieves this repression. It is delivered to G1/S promoters by binding SBF/MBF (15210111)
Whi5 は SBF/MBF に結合して G1/S の転写を抑え、G1 後期の: Whi5 binds SBF/MBF to repress G1/S transcription, and upon CDK phosphorylation in late G1 it dissociates from SBF and exits the nucleus (15210111). Phosphorylation by Cln3-Cdc28 relieves Whi5 repression and also prevents its binding to HDACs (Hos3, Rpd3) (19823668)
Whi5 は分裂期の終わりに核に入り Start まで核にとどまる。核外輸送は: Whi5 enters the nucleus at the end of mitosis and remains nuclear until Start. Nuclear export depends on Msn5 and phosphorylation of specific Ser residues, and Cdc14 is the phosphatase required for nuclear accumulation of Whi5 (19713766)

Whi5 enters the nucleus at the end of mitosis and remains nuclear until Start. Nuclear export is assisted by Msn5, and Whi5 and Msn5 bind in two-hybrid. Export depends on phosphorylation of specific Ser residues, and nuclear accumulation requires Cdc14 (19713766)
Whi7 は G1 期の後半に G1/S のプロモーターにつき、SBF に依存す: Whi7 associates with G1/S promoters in late G1 and represses SBF-dependent transcription. It cooperates with Whi5 to inhibit Start (28839131). Under cell wall stress, Whi7 is specifically recruited to the promoters of SBF targets (39819572)
Whi7 は不安定なタンパク質で SCF-Grr1 によって分解され、その安定性: Whi7 is an unstable protein degraded by SCF-Grr1, and its stability is regulated in a cell-cycle-dependent manner by CDK1 phosphorylation (28839131)
Whi7（Srl3）は Whi5 の類縁体で G1 後期に G1/S 遺伝子のプ: Whi7 (Srl3), a Whi5 paralog, is an unstable protein that binds G1/S gene promoters in late G1 and represses SBF transcription; its stability is regulated by CDK1 phosphorylation (summary of 28839131). The main text states that Whi7-NP, with all Cdc28 sites changed, is completely stable, and that its function of retaining Cln3 at the ER is inhibited by CDK phosphorylation (quoted from the PMC main text; source reference numbers omitted)
Wsc1・Mid2 の細胞質ドメインが Rom2 と結合し、mid2 変異株の抽: The cytoplasmic domains of Wsc1 and Mid2 bind Rom2, and extracts of mid2 mutant strains cannot promote GTP binding to Rho1
Wsc1（SLG1）・Mid2 の細胞質ドメインが Rom2 と結合し、変異株の: The cytoplasmic domains of Wsc1 (SLG1) and Mid2 bind Rom2, and extracts of the mutant strains cannot promote GTP binding to Rho1
Wss1 はホルムアルデヒドと Top1 依存の DNA 損傷での生存に要り、欠: Wss1 is required for survival of formaldehyde- and Top1-dependent DNA damage, and DNA-protein crosslinks accumulate in its absence. In vitro it cleaves substrates such as Top1 directly in a DNA-dependent manner (24998930). In cells lacking Tdp1, removal of Top1 covalent complexes depends on SUMO and Wss1 (26349035)
X 線結晶構造で Dsl1 複合体の脚の先が Sec20 と Use1 の Ha: By X-ray crystallography, the tips of the Dsl1 complex legs bind the Habc domains of Sec20 and Use1 (32409579). The Dsl1 complex forms a stable complex with Ufe1, Use1 and Sec20 (21550981)
XKS1 の欠失で SOR1/SOR2 の発現が弱まり、キシリトールが溜まる（3: Deletion of XKS1 weakens SOR1/SOR2 expression, and xylitol accumulates (33201998)

Ypi1 を枯渇させると核の PP1 が減り、核の Sds22 が失われる（18: Depleting Ypi1 reduces nuclear PP1 and causes loss of nuclear Sds22 (18172024)
Ypk1 が熱ストレスの信号を Orm のリン酸化として伝え、熱で誘導されたスフ: Ypk1 transmits the heat stress signal as Orm phosphorylation, and heat-induced sphingolipid synthesis causes Orm dephosphorylation, making the induction transient. Cdc55-PP2A is the main phosphatase counteracting Ypk1 action (22535525)
Ypk1 の新しい基質としてセラミド合成酵素の 2 つの触媒サブユニット（Lag: Two catalytic subunits of ceramide synthase (Lag1, Lac1) were found as new Ypk1 substrates. Phosphorylation by Ypk1 increases with sphingolipid depletion and heat shock and is important for survival. Phosphorylation raises specific activity, channeling long-chain bases into complex sphingolipids (25279700)
Ypk1 は Orm1・Orm2 を in vitro で直接リン酸化し、リン酸: Ypk1 directly phosphorylates Orm1 and Orm2 in vitro, and phosphorylation inactivates the Orms
Ypk1 は Rom2 を細胞膜に正しく局在させることで Pkc1 の活性を調節: Ypk1 regulates Pkc1 activity by properly localizing Rom2 to the plasma membrane, which also depends on Fpk1 and sphingolipids (25253719)
Ypk1/2 を阻害すると、カルシニューリンが制御するストレス応答遺伝子の発現が: Inhibiting Ypk1/2 raises expression of calcineurin-controlled stress response genes. Ypk1/2 negatively regulates calcineurin (22307609)
Ypp1 は Stt4 と結合して安定性を調節し、Stt4 の PIK パッチへ: Ypp1 binds Stt4 and regulates its stability, and is required for Stt4 assembly into and recruitment to PIK patches (19075114)
Ypt/Sec4 は II 型ゲラニルゲラニル転移酵素（GGTase-II）によ: Ypt/Sec4 bind membranes through modification by type II geranylgeranyltransferase (GGTase-II). Mutation of the catalytic subunit Bet2 disrupts membrane binding of Ypt1 and Sec4 and stops membrane traffic. Mrs6 is component A and is required for membrane binding of Ypt1 and Sec4 (8183917)
Ypt1 は Atg23・Atg17 に結合し、Ypt1-Atg17 の結合は: Ypt1 binds Atg23 and Atg17, and Ypt1-Atg17 binding contributes to the assembly of Ypt1 and Atg1 at the PAS. Phosphomimetic Ypt1 S174D impairs Atg1 assembly at the PAS and its activation (37635626)
Ypt1 は Atg23・Atg17 に結合する。Ypt1-Atg23 の結合を: Ypt1 binds Atg23 and Atg17. Disrupting Ypt1-Atg23 binding reduces binding of Atg9 to Atg11, Atg13 and Atg17, and Atg9 vesicles fail to gather at the PAS (37635626)
Ypt1 は TOR により S174 でリン酸化される。S174A は TOR: Ypt1 is phosphorylated at S174 by TOR. S174A abolishes TOR phosphorylation and enhances autophagy, whereas phosphomimetic S174D impairs assembly of Ypt1 and Atg1 at the PAS and Atg1 activation, inhibiting autophagy (37635626)
Ypt1 は Yip3 と共精製される。Rtn1 も Yip3 と結合するが Y: Ypt1 co-purifies with Yip3. Rtn1 also binds Yip3 but in a complex separate from Ypt1. Rab localization is unchanged in yip3Δ (16002643)
Ypt11 は Myo2 の尾部と複合体を作り、ミトコンドリアの芽への分配で M: Ypt11 forms a complex with the Myo2 tail and promotes Myo2 function in distribution of mitochondria to the bud (12391144)
Ypt11 はコートマーの Ret2 に結合し、Myo2 と後期 Golgi を: Ypt11 binds the coatomer subunit Ret2, linking Myo2 to the late Golgi (18595704)
Ypt31/32 が Sec2 の働きを調節する証拠（YPT31/YPT32 に: Shows evidence that Ypt31/32 regulate Sec2 function (suppression of sec2-78 by YPT31/YPT32, restoration of localization by overexpression, and binding to Ypt32) (12045183)
Ypt31/32 の過剰発現が sec2-78 の局在を戻し、Ypt32 と S: Overexpression of Ypt31/32 restores sec2-78 localization, and Ypt32 and Sec2 bind biochemically (12045183). Unphosphorylated Sec2 binds Ypt32-GTP, leading to Sec4 activation (24248333). Sec2 is recruited to secretory vesicles by Ypt32 and PI4P (26700316)
Ypt31/32 は Sec7 の交換活性を強く促す（25220393）。本文:: Ypt31/32 strongly stimulate the exchange activity of Sec7 (25220393). Main text: stimulation depends on the GTP form and is reduced by the ypt31-101 mutation. Cargo sorting is disturbed in ypt31/32 mutants
Ypt6 は一時的にゴルジにいて、Ypt32 が来ると細胞質へ離れる。Gyp6: Ypt6 is transiently on the Golgi and leaves for the cytosol when Ypt32 arrives. Gyp6 binds Ypt32 specifically, and with GYP6 disruption or mutants lacking GAP activity Ypt6 remains on the Golgi (24194547). GYP6 encodes a GAP highly specific for Ypt6 (8441469)
Ypt7 の活性化が Vps21 の不活性化を引き起こす Rab カスケード。M: A Rab cascade in which Ypt7 activation causes Vps21 inactivation. Overexpression of Mon1-Ccz1 or active Ypt7 shifts Vps21 to the ER, which is prevented by loss of BLOC-1 or Msb3 (25971802)
Yra1 は Dbp2 の一本鎖 RNA への結合を妨げ、濃度に応じて二本鎖をほ: Yra1 prevents Dbp2 binding to single-stranded RNA and inhibits its duplex-unwinding activity in a concentration-dependent manner (26876600). Yra1 lowers the unwinding efficiency of Dbp2 (23721653)
Yrb1 の核外輸送には RBD が要り、RBD は RanGTP 存在下で X: Nuclear export of Yrb1 requires the RBD, which forms a ternary complex with Xpo1(Crm1) in the presence of RanGTP (10825193)
Yrb1 は核と細胞質を行き来し、CRM1(XPO1) 依存の経路で核外へ運ばれ: Yrb1 shuttles between nucleus and cytoplasm and is exported from the nucleus by a CRM1(XPO1)-dependent pathway (10825193)
Yrb2 は Crm1 に直接結合し、yrb2 欠損で NES に依存する核外輸: Yrb2 binds Crm1 directly; yrb2 deletion delays NES-dependent nuclear export, suppressed by one extra copy of XPO1/CRM1 (10050047). Yrb2 greatly accelerates binding of Gsp1-GTP and NES to Crm1 (structure and in vitro, 25437554)
Yrb30 は Yrb1 と競合して GTP 型の Gsp1 に結合し、RanG: Yrb30 competes with Yrb1 to bind GTP-bound Gsp1 and forms a ternary complex with RanGTP and a karyopherin (12578832)
Yrb30 は Yrb1 と違い、Rna1 による Ran の GTP 加水分解: Unlike Yrb1, Yrb30 inhibits Rna1-mediated GTP hydrolysis by Ran (12578832)
Yrr1 は YOR1 の活性化を通してオリゴマイシン耐性をもたらし、ChIP: Yrr1 confers oligomycin resistance through activation of YOR1 and binds target promoters by ChIP (11134057). YOR1 is a direct target of Yrr1 (11909958)
Ysh1 のユビキチン化は Ubc4 と RING ユビキチンリガーゼの Mpe: Ysh1 ubiquitination is carried out by Ubc4 and the RING ubiquitin ligase Mpe1, and it is degraded by the proteasome (32009536)
Ysp2 とその相同遺伝子 Lam4/Ltc3 は体内で Ypk1 の基質で、Y: Ysp2 and its homolog Lam4/Ltc3 are Ypk1 substrates in vivo, and Ypk1 phosphorylation inhibits their function of promoting retrograde sterol transport from the plasma membrane to the ER. In the full text, the Lam4 sites are S401 and S667 (29927351, 33255682)
Ysp2（Lam2）は生体内の Ypk1 の基質で、リン酸化は細胞膜から ER: Ysp2 (Lam2) is an in vivo Ypk1 substrate, and phosphorylation inhibits retrograde sterol transport from the plasma membrane to the ER (29927351). Phosphorylation prevents binding of Lam2 to Laf1 (33255682)
Ysw1 は two-hybrid で Gip1 と結合し、この結合が gip1: Ysw1 binds Gip1 in two-hybrid, and this binding is required for suppression of the gip1 mutation (19465564)
Ytm1 と Erb1 はβプロペラ同士で結合し、結合面の変異は 60S の成熟: Ytm1 and Erb1 bind via their β-propellers, and mutations at the interface stop 60S maturation (26657628)
Ytm1・Erb1・Nop7 は互いに依存して前リボソームに組み込まれ、互いの相: Ytm1, Erb1 and Nop7 are incorporated into preribosomes interdependently; the domains required for their mutual interactions were identified (18448671)
Yvc1 の脱グルタチオン化は Trx2 による（27708136）: Deglutathionylation of Yvc1 is by Trx2 (27708136)
Yvh1 による Mrt4 の解離が、細胞質での pre-60S への Rpp0: Release of Mrt4 by Yvh1 is an essential step preceding loading of Rpp0 onto pre-60S in the cytoplasm (19797079)
Yvh1 は pre-60S から Mrt4 を放出させるのに必要。yvh1 欠: Yvh1 is required to release Mrt4 from pre-60S. In yvh1 deletion, Mrt4 remains on cytoplasmic pre-60S (19797078). Yvh1 triggers Mrt4 release in the nucleus (27775710)
ZRC1 の転写は亜鉛の制限で、亜鉛に応答する転写因子 Zap1 によって誘導さ: ZRC1 transcription is induced under zinc limitation by the zinc-responsive transcription factor Zap1 (12556516). ZRC1 expression is induced in a Zap1-dependent manner when intracellular zinc falls and is repressed by zinc (11027563)
ZRG8 は ram 欠失の致死の多コピー抑圧因子。Zrg8 は Ssd1 と共: ZRG8 is a multicopy suppressor of the lethality of ram deletion. Zrg8 co-precipitates with Ssd1 and is thought to be a nonessential inhibitor of Ssd1 (15972461)
ZRT2 は低亜鉛で抑えられ亜鉛を補うと誘導される。Zap1 の低親和性 ZRE: ZRT2 is repressed under low zinc and induced when zinc is supplied. A low-affinity Zap1 ZRE (repression) and a high-affinity ZRE (activation) antagonize each other (14976557)
ZWF1 を欠くとストレスの有無に関わらず Yap1 が活性化し、その標的 Ct: Without ZWF1, Yap1 is activated regardless of stress, and its target Ctt1 increases. Deletion of yap1 or ctt1 abolishes the stress tolerance of zwf1Δ (33648021)
Zap1 依存の活性化で RTC4 mRNA は増えるが Rtc4 タンパク質は: Zap1-dependent activation increases RTC4 mRNA but decreases Rtc4 protein. Upstream ORFs in the long 5′ leader impede translation (28971534)
Zds1 と Zds2 はセパレースの下流で核小体からの Cdc14 の放出を助: Zds1 and Zds2 act downstream of separase to help release Cdc14 from the nucleolus, activating Cdc14 at anaphase onset. Ectopic expression of Zds1 lowers PP2A-Cdc55 and promotes Net1 phosphorylation (18762578)
Zds1/Zds2-PP2A(Cdc55) は Rho1 の GAP Lrg1: Zds1/Zds2-PP2A(Cdc55) inhibits the Rho1 GAP Lrg1 to promote polarized growth and cell wall synthesis. In the main text, in cdc55Δ the amount of Lrg1 is unchanged but Lrg1 bound to active Rho1 increases, raising total cellular Lrg1 GAP activity. The glucan synthesis defect of cdc55Δ is due to excessive Lrg1 activity
Zds1/Zds2-PP2A(Cdc55) は Rho1 の GAP Sac7: Zds1/Zds2-PP2A(Cdc55) stabilizes the Rho1 GAP Sac7 to inhibit the cell wall pathway. In the main text, Sac7 protein decreases in cdc55Δ (not transcriptionally) and is restored by proteasome mutation
Zip1 の S75 は Mec1 のコンセンサス部位で、mec1 変異体ではセ: Zip1 S75 is a Mec1 consensus site, and centromere pairing is restored in mec1 mutants. Persistent S75 phosphorylation causes loss of centromere pairing, while synapsis and DSB repair are unchanged (20951350). In early meiosis Mec1/Tel1 are activated and phosphorylate Zip1, destabilizing homology-independent centromere pairing (23775120)
Zip2・Zip4・Spo16 は互いに結合し DNA 結合複合体をつくる。Zi: Zip2, Zip4 and Spo16 bind each other and form a DNA-binding complex. Zip2:Spo16 is a heterodimer resembling XPF:ERCC1 (30566683)
Zip3 は SUMO の E3 リガーゼで、Zip1 は SUMO 結合体に結: Zip3 is a SUMO E3 ligase, and Zip1 binds SUMO conjugates. From mid-prophase onward, Zip1 binds Zip3-dependent Smt3 conjugates (such as Red1) to form the SC (16847351)
Znf1 は細胞壁合成の FKS1・SED1・SMI1 などを活性化する（341: Znf1 activates cell wall synthesis genes such as FKS1, SED1 and SMI1 (34105981)
Zpr1 は eEF1A の生合成専用のシャペロンで、折りたたみに GTP 加水: Zpr1 is a dedicated chaperone for eEF1A biogenesis, and folding requires GTP hydrolysis (37597513)
Zrt3*-GFP の分解には Tul1 と Rsp5 の両方が寄与する（本文、: Both Tul1 and Rsp5 contribute to degradation of Zrt3*-GFP (main text, 26527740)
Zta1p の欠失でアミノ酸合成の遺伝子群の発現が下がり、Zta1p は ARG: Deletion of Zta1p lowers expression of amino acid synthesis genes, and Zta1p extends the half-life of ARG4 mRNA, regulating expression post-transcriptionally (25715111)
Zuo1 の C 末端と Ssz1 の N 末端はそれぞれ単独で Pdr1 を活: The Zuo1 C-terminus and the Ssz1 N-terminus can each activate Pdr1 on their own (22203981). The C-terminal 13 residues of Zuo1 appear to bind Pdr1 directly, resembling xenobiotic-induced Pdr1 activation (23036859)
a 細胞特異的遺伝子は MATα 細胞で α2/Mcm1 により抑えられる。BA: a-cell-specific genes are repressed by α2/Mcm1 in MATα cells. Examining BAR1, nucleosome positioning was shown to be required for full repression (16980406)
ack1 欠失株は CWI レポーター活性が低く、エピスタシスで Ack1 は: The ack1 deletion strain has low CWI reporter activity; by epistasis Ack1 is upstream of Pkc1 and depends on Rom2 and Tus1 (18806213)
adk1 欠損で PHO・ADE 遺伝子が強く誘導される。PHO84 の上昇には: adk1 deletion strongly induces PHO and ADE genes. The rise in PHO84 requires Spl2 (18433446)
adr1Δ で PEX11 の転写の上昇が無くなり、Pex11 の量も大きく減る: In adr1Δ the increase in PEX11 transcription is lost and Pex11 levels are also greatly reduced. The PEX11 promoter has a UAS1-like sequence overlapping the ORE (11431484)
ady1（pfs1）変異株では減数分裂特異的な SPB 構成要素 Mpc54 が: In ady1 (pfs1) mutant strains, the meiosis-specific SPB component Mpc54 localizes to only one or two spindle poles per cell (11553705)
aer2（tup1）変異で CYC7 の発現がすべての条件で大きく上がる。AER: The aer2 (tup1) mutation greatly raises CYC7 expression under all conditions. AER2 is the same gene as TUP1 (1900249)
aim23 欠失で Atp9 の合成速度が上がる（26728900）: aim23 deletion increases the rate of Atp9 synthesis (26728900)
aim23 欠失で Cox1・Cox2・Cox3 の発現が抑えられ、Atp9 の: aim23 deletion reduces expression of Cox1, Cox2 and Cox3, and increases the rate of Atp9 synthesis (26728900)
akr1 欠失で Ste3 の半減期が 5 倍以上に延び、受容体の合成を止めても: akr1 deletion extends the half-life of Ste3 more than fivefold, and cells can mate for a long time even after receptor synthesis is stopped (9243510). Akr1 appears to function in localizing Yck1/Yck2 to the plasma membrane (10866691)
alg12Δ でたまる Man7GlcNAc2 は ALG9 がコードする α1: Man7GlcNAc2 accumulating in alg12Δ was confirmed to be the product of the α1,2-mannosyltransferase encoded by ALG9 (12460943)
alg5-1 は Dol-P-Glc を作れず、alg6-1 は Dol-P-G: alg5-1 cannot make Dol-P-Glc, and alg6-1 cannot transfer glucose from Dol-P-Glc to the lipid-linked oligosaccharide. Also experiments with microsomes (6423630)
alk1Δ では Mih1 の早すぎる活性化で Cdc28-Y19 のリン酸化が: In alk1Δ, premature activation of Mih1 reduces Cdc28-Y19 phosphorylation, and cells enter mitosis even without a bud (33585466)
aly1Δ でも Dip5 のエンドサイトーシスが損なわれるが aly2Δ ほど: Dip5 endocytosis is also impaired in aly1Δ, though less than in aly2Δ (20956561). Dephosphorylation of Aly1 by calcineurin is required for Aly1-mediated transport of Dip5 to the vacuole (23824189)
aly2Δ では Dip5 が細胞膜で安定になりエンドサイトーシスされない。Di: In aly2Δ, Dip5 becomes stable at the plasma membrane and is not endocytosed. Efficient ubiquitination of Dip5 depends on Aly2. Aly2 is an adaptor linking Rsp5 and Dip5 (20956561)
ama1Δ は前胞子膜の閉鎖に欠陥があり、前胞子膜の先端の Ssp1 が ama: ama1Δ has a defect in closure of the prospore membrane, and Ssp1 at the leading edge of the prospore membrane is stabilized in ama1Δ. Inactivating Ssp1 with a conditional mutation partially rescues the sporulation defect of ama1Δ; the essential function of Ama1 is to remove Ssp1 (18946082)
aps1Δ は chc1-ts の生育遅延・α因子成熟の欠陥を強め、Chc を完: aps1Δ enhances the slow growth and α-factor maturation defect of chc1-ts, and also enhances the growth defect of cells completely lacking Chc (8157009)
arc19 欠失細胞では Arp2p・Arp3p・Arc40p が単量体の画分に: In arc19 deletion cells, Arp2p, Arp3p and Arc40p fall into the monomeric fraction; Arc19p is the central scaffold of the complex (10377407)
art3Δ 細胞は Put4 のエンドサイトーシスに欠陥があり、Art3 が P: art3Δ cells are defective in Put4 endocytosis, and Art3 is a key regulator of Put4 endocytosis (32800549)
atp25 変異で ATP9 mRNA と Atp9p が減り、Atp25p は: atp25 mutation reduces ATP9 mRNA and Atp9p, and Atp25p is required for ATP9 mRNA stability (18216280)
avl9Δ でエンドソームの積み荷 Snc1 のリサイクルが損なわれる（4245: avl9Δ impairs recycling of the endosomal cargo Snc1 (42459062, J Cell Sci)
bcy1 変異はアデニル酸シクラーゼ欠損の致死を抑圧する。BCY1 は cAMP: bcy1 mutation suppresses the lethality of adenylate cyclase deficiency. BCY1 is the regulatory subunit of cAMP-dependent kinase (cAMP releases BCY1)
bcy1Δ では Ras2 Val19 と同じく、エタノールへ移しても Hxt3: In bcy1Δ, as with Ras2 Val19, internalization and degradation of Hxt3 do not occur even after shift to ethanol (23227176)
bcy1（PKA が常に働く）では GS-2（GSY2）の mRNA とタンパク: In bcy1 (PKA always active), GS-2 (GSY2) mRNA and protein are greatly reduced. The cAMP pathway regulates both expression and phosphorylation of GS-2 (7961723)
bem1 欠失はフェロモンでの G1 停止と転写活性化に欠陥がある。Bem1 は: bem1 deletion is defective in pheromone-induced G1 arrest and transcriptional activation. Bem1 raises Fus3 activity and binds Ste5 (containing Ste11, Ste7 and Fus3) (8754808)
bi3 の ORF が作るタンパク質はシトクロム b の mRNA のスプライシ: The protein made by the bi3 ORF is a specific maturase acting in splicing of cytochrome b mRNA (2538624)
bir1-17 細胞では Ipl1 が一部局在を失い、キナーゼ活性が大きく下がる: In bir1-17 cells, Ipl1 partly loses its localization and its kinase activity drops greatly (19528231)
blm10Δ では Dnm1 の分解が試験管内でも生体内でも損なわれ、酸化ストレ: In blm10Δ, degradation of Dnm1 is impaired both in vitro and in vivo, and mitochondrial fragmentation increases under oxidative stress (24604417)
bmh 変異株のプロテオームで Gpm1 などの糖新生の酵素の量が増え、多くは転: In the proteome of bmh mutant strains, levels of gluconeogenic enzymes such as Gpm1 increase, mostly without changes at the transcript level (17397208)
bni1Δ の背景で NPF の働きを欠く bud6 変異を調べ、Bud6 が体: Examining bud6 mutants lacking NPF function in a bni1Δ background shows that Bud6 promotes Bnr1 activity in vivo. Bud6 binds Bnr1 directly, but the NPF effect is masked by a short regulatory sequence and revealed by Bil1 binding (23671312). Bud6 strongly relieves Hof1 inhibition of Bnr1 in vitro (30076201)
bni4 欠失でキチン沈着が非局在化し、Chs3 は bni4・chs4・セプチ: bni4 deletion delocalizes chitin deposition, and Chs3 does not localize properly in bni4, chs4 or septin mutants (9314530). Bni4 mutants that can bind the bud neck but not Glc7 cannot deliver CSIII to the bud neck (18480405)
bsd2 欠失株では Smf1 が液胞に入らず安定化する。マンガンの添加だけで: In the bsd2 deletion strain, Smf1 does not enter the vacuole and is stabilized. Adding manganese alone triggers rapid Bsd2-dependent degradation of Smf1 (9988727). Smf1 degradation requires Bsd2, which recruits Rsp5 (16456538)
bud27Δ で RPC128 の転写と RPC160 の翻訳が下がり、Pol: bud27Δ lowers RPC128 transcription and RPC160 translation, impairing Pol III formation (26423792)
bul1Δ bul2Δ の二重変異で Tat2 の定常量が大きく増える（Tat1: The bul1Δ bul2Δ double mutant greatly increases the steady-state level of Tat2 (Tat1 does not increase) (14560004)
cAMP-PKA と CK2 による Sir2 S473 のリン酸化が、Sir2: Phosphorylation of Sir2 S473 by cAMP-PKA and CK2 inhibits Sir2's functions of repressing transcription of PMA1 and others and extending lifespan
cal1-1（CDC43 変異）では Rho1 の修飾が減り、膜の 1,3-β-: In cal1-1 (CDC43 mutation), Rho1 modification is reduced and membrane 1,3-β-glucan synthesis activity decreases. Unmodified Rho1 cannot bind Fks1, and only modified GST-Rho1 restores the activity of rho1-3 membranes (10608882). In cal1-1, soluble Rho1 increases at the restrictive temperature, and it is best suppressed by Rho1 overproduction (8804398)
cat8 変異で ADH2-lacZ の脱抑制は野生型の約 12% に下がる。C: In cat8 mutants, derepression of ADH2-lacZ falls to about 12% of wild type. Cat8 binds CSRE(ADH2) directly (gel shift) (11495982)
cbc2-NΔ42 の二倍体で胞子形成中に MER3・SAE3 のスプライシング: In cbc2-NΔ42 diploids, splicing of MER3 and SAE3 is specifically defective during sporulation, rescued by intronless MER3 (23002122)
cbk1 の凝集表現型の抑圧変異が CRM1 と ACE2 にあり、Ace2-C: Suppressor mutations of the cbk1 clumping phenotype lie in CRM1 and ACE2; they disrupt Ace2-Crm1 binding and block export, so Ace2 accumulates in both mother and daughter nuclei (18076379). Phosphorylation of Cbk1 at two sites prevents binding of Ace2 to the nuclear export machinery (18715118)
cbk1・bck2 変異で熱ショック・細胞壁ストレス時の Mpk1 の活性化と: cbk1 and bck2 mutations abolish Mpk1 activation and Mpk1-dependent expression during heat shock and cell wall stress (phosphorylation is preserved) (22031291)
ccc2 変異株は呼吸と鉄の取り込みに欠陥があり、Fet3 の細胞外側ドメインの: ccc2 mutant strains are defective in respiration and iron uptake and lack the copper-dependent oxidase activity of the Fet3 extracellular domain. Restored by adding copper (7708696)
cdc37 変異株では調べたキナーゼ 65 種のうち 51 種が減り、Cdc37: In cdc37 mutant strains, 51 of 65 kinases examined decrease; Cdc37 protects newly synthesized kinases from degradation and then folds them with Hsp90 (17242065). Main text: Tpk2 and Rim11 taken from cdc37S14A have lowered activity
cdc37-1 では Cak1 の量と活性が大きく下がり、Cdc37 がないと翻: In cdc37-1, Cak1 levels and activity drop greatly, and without Cdc37 Cak1 becomes unstable during translation (10629030)
cdc37-1 では Cdc28 の量が少なく Thr169 がリン酸化されずサ: In cdc37-1, Cdc28 levels are low, Thr169 is not phosphorylated, and it does not bind cyclins. By pulse-chase, Cdc28 and Cak1 become unstable when Cdc37 function is absent during translation (10629030). In cdc37-1, binding of Cln2 and Clb2 to Cdc28 and its activation are impaired (7753858). Previously put on hold based only on one background sentence in 36594787, but decided using the primary paper 10629030
cdc37-S14A では Slt2 の量が減り、細胞壁ストレスでの Slt2: In cdc37-S14A, Slt2 levels decrease and the Slt2-dependent response to cell wall stress (Rlm1 activation) is impaired. Slt2 forms a complex with Cdc37 in vivo (17220467)
cdc42 変異体では exocyst の極性のある局在が失われ分泌が無秩序にな: In cdc42 mutants, polarized localization of the exocyst is lost and secretion becomes disorganized. Sec3 binds GTP-bound Cdc42 directly (11595741). Disrupting Sec3 binding to Cdc42 and to phospholipids stops exocytosis and disturbs exocyst polarity (18195105)
cdh1Δ では Ase1 と Clb2 の分解が損なわれる（Pds1 は損なわ: In cdh1Δ, degradation of Ase1 and Clb2 is impaired (not Pds1) (9334304)
cds1 欠失株で PGS1 プロモーター-lacZ の発現が上がる。CDP-D: Expression of PGS1 promoter-lacZ rises in the cds1 deletion strain. CDP-DAG synthesis capacity affects expression (9565583)
cex1Δ で Wbp1 が誤った場所に運ばれる（33753324）: In cex1Δ, Wbp1 is transported to the wrong location (33753324)
cha4-1 変異でセリン・トレオニンによる CHA1 の誘導が起きない。Cha: In the cha4-1 mutant, induction of CHA1 by serine and threonine does not occur. Cha4 is a positive regulator that binds UASCHA (8889513)
chs6 変異では Chs3 がキトソームに溜まり、Chs6 は Chs3 をキ: In chs6 mutants, Chs3 accumulates in chitosomes; Chs6 is required to transport Chs3 from chitosomes to the plasma membrane (9614194). The Chs5/6 complex transiently binds its cargo Chs3, and in chs5Δ and chs6Δ the Chs3 bound to the complex is greatly reduced (16855022)
cic1 変異で F-box の Cdc4・Grr1 が安定化し、Cic1 は試: cic1 mutation stabilizes the F-box proteins Cdc4 and Grr1, and Cic1 binds Cdc4 in vitro and in vivo (11500370)
cmc2 欠失でミトコンドリアの Sod1 活性が 2 倍、CMC2 過剰発現で: cmc2 deletion doubles mitochondrial Sod1 activity, and CMC2 overexpression lowers it to 60% (20220131)
cmk2 欠失でカルシウム/カルシニューリンのシグナルが強まり、PMR1・PMC: cmk2 deletion strengthens calcium/calcineurin signaling, and expression of PMR1 and PMC1 rises in a Crz1-dependent manner (30665402)
coa4Δ で減る Cox1 の量・COX の組み立て・呼吸が Cox11 の過: The reduced Cox1 levels, COX assembly and respiration of coa4Δ are restored by Cox11 overexpression. Places Coa4 in the copper delivery pathway to Cox1 (35666203)
coa6 と sco2 の二重欠失で Cox2 の生合成が完全に失われ、Coa6: Double deletion of coa6 and sco2 completely abolishes Cox2 biogenesis, and Coa6 interacts with the Sco proteins (26669719)
cof1-8 細胞では細胞壁タンパク質 Bgl2 の分泌が遅れ、後期ゴルジにとど: In cof1-8 cells, secretion of the cell wall protein Bgl2 is delayed and it stays in the late Golgi (22553351)
cog3-202 温度感受性株で Och1・Mnn1 の局在が乱れる（15229: Localization of Och1 and Mnn1 is disturbed in the cog3-202 temperature-sensitive strain (15229219)
coq4 点変異では Coq3p と Coq4 が高分子量の複合体として一緒に泳: In coq4 point mutants, Coq3p and Coq4 no longer co-migrate as a high-molecular-weight complex. Coq4p organizes the Coq complex (19022396)
coq4-1 変異ミトコンドリアでは Coq3p・Coq4p・Coq7p のゲル: In coq4-1 mutant mitochondria, the gel filtration migration of Coq3p, Coq4p and Coq7p is disturbed (19022396)
cox23 欠失の呼吸欠損は高い銅と COX17 多コピーで回復。Cox17 は: The respiratory deficiency of cox23 deletion is rescued by high copper and multicopy COX17. Cox17 acts downstream of Cox23 (15145942)
cox24 欠失では COX1 のイントロン aI2・aI3 の除去が止まる（1: In cox24 deletion, removal of the COX1 introns aI2 and aI3 stops (16339141)
cox7 欠失株では COX1 の産物（サブユニット I）の蓄積が減る（1658: In the cox7 deletion strain, accumulation of the COX1 product (subunit I) is reduced (1658541)
cpr1 欠失で Zpr1 が核にたまり、核外輸送に欠陥。回復は PPIase: cpr1 deletion causes Zpr1 to accumulate in the nucleus, a defect in nuclear export. Rescue correlates with PPIase activity (12242280)
crd1Δ のミトコンドリアでは Ugo1・Scm4・Om14 の量が少なく、新: In crd1Δ mitochondria, levels of Ugo1, Scm4 and Om14 are low, and the capacity to import newly synthesized Ugo1 and Scm4 is low (26149385)
crd1Δ のミトコンドリアは新しく合成した Ugo1・Scm4 の取り込み能が: crd1Δ mitochondria have low capacity to import newly synthesized Ugo1 and Scm4 (26149385)
crm1 変異体で Yap1 は常に核にあり、Crm1 は RanGTP 存在下: In crm1 mutants, Yap1 is always nuclear, and Crm1 binds the NES-like sequence of Yap1 in the presence of RanGTP. Oxidation prevents recognition (9857197). Repressing Crm1 expression localizes Yap1 to the nucleus and induces target genes. Yap1-Crm1 binding decreases under oxidative stress (9797454)
cse1 変異で Srp1 の再輸出と cNLS をもつ蛋白質の取り込みが阻まれ: cse1 mutation blocks re-export of Srp1 and import of cNLS-containing proteins (9744791). Cse1 prevents nuclear accumulation of Srp1 (9857050)
ctf19・mcm21 変異で Nkp2 が誤局在する（24385296）: Nkp2 is mislocalized in ctf19 and mcm21 mutants (24385296)
cwh41Δ で Kre6 が不安定になり、Kre6 の過剰発現で cwh41Δ: In cwh41Δ, Kre6 becomes unstable, and Kre6 overexpression restores the calcofluor sensitivity of cwh41Δ (9763440)
cyc8 の変異株では、Sko1 が制御する GRE2 と AHP1 がストレス: In cyc8 mutant strains, the Sko1-regulated GRE2 and AHP1 are derepressed in the absence of stress. By ChIP, Sko1-Tup1-Cyc8 is at the GRE2 promoter (18201562)
In cyc8 mutant strains, the Sko1-regulated GRE2 and AHP1 are derepressed in the absence of stress (18201562)
cym1Δ で Sod2 の活性が下がり、ミトコンドリアのタンパク質の酸化損傷が: In cym1Δ, Sod2 activity decreases and oxidative damage to mitochondrial proteins increases (30938873). Disruption of CYM1 causes MnSOD to contain subunits retaining the presequence (35997162)
cyt2 変異株はシトクロム c1 の中間体を貯め、CYT2 がシトクロム c1: cyt2 mutant strains accumulate a cytochrome c1 intermediate; CYT2 encodes cytochrome c1 heme lyase (1499554). This enzyme is required for covalent attachment of heme to apocytochrome c1 (8082171)
dal80 変異株では誘導物質なしでも野生型の誘導時と同じ量の DUR1,2 R: In dal80 mutant strains, even without inducer, DUR1,2 RNA is present at the same level as in induced wild type (3025621)
dal81 変異株では誘導下でも DUR1,2 の RNA がほぼ検出されない。: In dal81 mutant strains, DUR1,2 RNA is barely detectable even under induction. DUR1,2 is transcriptionally regulated by DAL80 and DAL81 (3025621)
deh1(gzf3) 破壊株で DAL80 の発現が上がる（9171383）: DAL80 expression rises in the deh1(gzf3) disruption strain (9171383)
deh1(gzf3) 破壊株で GAP1・DAL80・UGA4 の発現が上がり、: In the deh1(gzf3) disruption strain, expression of GAP1, DAL80 and UGA4 rises, and Deh1 binds UGA4 and GAP1 promoter fragments. It acts only when glutamine is present (9171383)
deh1(gzf3) 破壊株で UGA4 の発現が上がり、Deh1 は UGA4: UGA4 expression rises in the deh1(gzf3) disruption strain, and Deh1 binds a UGA4 promoter fragment (9171383)
dhh1 欠失で接合の転写因子 Ste12 のタンパク質量が大きく下がり接合が強: dhh1 deletion greatly lowers protein levels of the mating transcription factor Ste12 and strongly impairs mating. Suppressed by overexpression of STE12 or CAF20 (18182159). The increase in Ste12 protein during filamentous growth is partly prevented by caf20 and dhh1 mutations, and both regulate STE12 translation (17041186)
djp1Δ でミトコンドリアの Mim1 が減り、過剰発現した GFP-Mim1: In djp1Δ, mitochondrial Mim1 decreases and overexpressed GFP-Mim1 mislocalizes to the ER (23959800)
dmc1Δ では Rad51 が積極的に抑えられ、この抑制は Mek1 に依存し: In dmc1Δ, Rad51 is actively inhibited; this inhibition depends on Mek1 and prevents Rad51-Rad54 complex formation by two mechanisms: Mek1 phosphorylation of Rad54 and binding of the meiosis-specific Hed1 to Rad51 (27483004)
dmo2 では Cox2 の分解が速く、Dmo2 は Cox2・Sco1・Sco: In dmo2, Cox2 is degraded quickly, and Dmo2 co-precipitates with Cox2, Sco1 and Sco2 (39932033)
dot1 欠失では Rad9 と Rad53 の活性化が起こらず、DSB への: In dot1 deletion, Rad9 and Rad53 activation does not occur and Rad9 binding to DSBs decreases. In dot1 deletion, the G1 and S phase checkpoints do not function after irradiation (16166626). Binding of the Rad9 Tudor domain to methylated H3-K79 is required for checkpoint activation (17243194)
dph6 変異で eEF2 にジフチンがたまり、最後のアミド化ができない。Dph: In dph6 mutants, diphthine accumulates on eEF2 and the final amidation cannot occur. Dph6 binds eEF2 (23468660)
dun1 欠失で DIN7 の発現が上がる。Dun1 による抑制は DNA 損傷: dun1 deletion raises DIN7 expression. Repression by Dun1 is relieved by DNA damage (18540090)
eEF1B の γ サブユニット（TEF4・TEF3/CAM1）と α（TEF5: The γ subunits of eEF1B (TEF4, TEF3/CAM1) and α (TEF5/EFB1) were found as multicopy suppressors of the synthetic growth defect of SUP45 and SUP35 mutations (19545407)
eEF1Bα は eEF1A からの GDP・GTP の解離を 320 倍・25: eEF1Bα accelerates dissociation of GDP and GTP from eEF1A 320-fold and 250-fold, respectively (17925388)
eEF3 の過剰発現でアミノ酸飢餓での増殖と eIF2α のリン酸化が下がり、リ: eEF3 overexpression lowers growth under amino acid starvation and eIF2α phosphorylation, and worsens the phenotype of Gcn1-M7A, which has low ribosome affinity. eEF3 interferes with Gcn1 function on the ribosome (22888004)
eIF2(αP) による eIF2B の抑制を失わせる SUI2・GCD7 の変: Mutations in SUI2 and GCD7 that abolish inhibition of eIF2B by eIF2(αP) also impair binding of phosphorylated GST-SUI2 to the regulatory subunits (11438658)
eIF2A はエキソヌクレアーゼ Xrn1 などの mRNA 分解因子と物理的・: eIF2A is physically and functionally associated with mRNA decay factors such as the exonuclease Xrn1 (38011112)
eIF2A 複合体は Ssd1 と強く結合し、一部の mRNA への eIF2A: The eIF2A complex binds Ssd1 strongly, and eIF2A binding to some mRNAs is mediated by Ssd1. eIF2A inhibits translation of cell wall proteins (38011112)
eIF2B は eIF2 の GEF で、eIF2-GDP を活性型の eIF2: eIF2B is the GEF for eIF2, converting eIF2-GDP to active eIF2-GTP. The Gcd6 C-terminus is required for catalytic activity and eIF2 binding, and mutations impair the essential function of eIF2B (10805739). eIF2Bε is the only subunit with catalytic activity on its own (12356745)
